fdroid:com.akylas.aard2.name: OSS-Dict
fdroid:com.akylas.aard2.description:
OSS‑Dict is a fast, privacy-friendly offline dictionary reader — a modern fork of Aard 2 with Material design and enhanced features for comfortable reading and lookup.
Highlights
* Blazing fast searches: punctuation, diacritics and case insensitive — find entries instantly.
* Bookmarks & history: save and revisit important articles quickly.
* Dictionary management: import, enable/disable and organize multiple dictionary files.
* Customizable article appearance: add your own CSS to change fonts, colors and layout.
* Beautiful math rendering: scalable, styleable formulas that look great on any screen.
* Random article for discovery, volume-button navigation, and fullscreen reading mode.
* Clipboard auto-paste and easy external link sharing for fast lookups from other apps.
Why OSS‑Dict? OSS‑Dict is designed to work entirely offline — your dictionaries stay on your device for fast lookups and better privacy. It’s lightweight, configurable, and ideal for travelers, students, and anyone who needs reliable dictionary access without an internet connection.
Network access The app requests the INTERNET permission for internal use by the built-in renderer and to open external links. This permission is not required for core dictionary lookups — the app functions offline with local dictionary files.
Open source OSS‑Dict is open source and available on GitHub. Contributions, bug reports and feature requests are welcome.
Get started Install or import your offline dictionaries, customize the look with CSS if you like, and start searching — fast and offline.

fdroid:com.jemcik.jemrec.name: JemRec
fdroid:com.jemcik.jemrec.summary: Records phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber and Meet calls, both sides, no root
fdroid:com.jemcik.jemrec.description:
A call recorder for unrooted Android — phone and messenger calls. One APK. No root, no Shizuku, no companion app, no computer: the phone sets itself up.
 How it works. Android's voice-call audio source carries both sides of a call, but only system identities may read it, ADB's shell user among them. JemRec embeds an ADB client and pairs with the phone's own Wireless debugging over 127.0.0.1. Nothing leaves the phone.
In a short ADB session the app starts a shell-privileged daemon that writes each call to a file; the app is never on the audio path. Connections are authenticated both ways.
 Recordings are Ogg Opus files, about 12 MB an hour, in the phone's Recordings/JemRec folder. A recording starts at the answer; a call nobody answered is not kept. Automatic mode records every call; ask-first records nothing until you tap Record. Messenger calls (WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Viber) and Google Meet can be recorded too, both sides, app by app, Android 14+; all but Signal tested. It warns of a silent or cut-short recording, a recorder down, a call not recorded, or a setting in its way.
 Playing, finding, keeping. A call plays as its waveform, both sides in both ears, through the earpiece at your ear, and goes on with the screen off, its caller kept off the lock screen. A Calls tab shows each call: its recording, or why not; both lists have search. Deleted recordings wait 30 days in Recently deleted; auto-delete, off by default, clears old and very short ones, never kept ones. Keep only some people's calls; name files with the caller or their number, or as Honor's Phone app plays them.
 Three looks : Memo; Deck, a pocket recorder; Multitrack, a sound editor - each light, dark or as the phone.
 Answering machine , off until you switch it on: it answers phone calls you don't take, plays your greeting, your microphone muted, and keeps the caller's message, by the same rules as recording; you can still take the call. It pauses for a day after an emergency call. Experimental: checks and a test call say if it works on yours.
 Setup takes two things by hand, once: turn on Developer options, then USB and Wireless debugging (one more switch on ColorOS, OxygenOS, realme UI), and type the pairing code into JemRec's notification. The pairing survives reboots, and Android's 7-day limit if you let it; the recorder restarts on the next Wi-Fi if the phone lets JemRec run on its own - setup asks; JemRec warns if it is stopped.
 What stays on. USB debugging, turned back on if it goes off: the recorder needs it. Wireless debugging is on only while JemRec starts the recorder; then a paired computer can connect on Wi-Fi. For banking apps, turning JemRec off can also hide Developer options, or turn all debugging off. Uninstall JemRec to turn debugging off for good. Start without Wi-Fi, off by default, opens port 5555 to all networks, to start JemRec with no Wi-Fi until a reboot.
 Requirements. Android 12 or newer, and a phone whose audio hardware hands over the voice-call source. Both sides recorded on an Honor Magic 8 Pro, Galaxy S20, S23, M34 and a OnePlus on LineageOS. Settings → Diagnostics has a self-test for yours.
 Recording calls is your responsibility. Consent law differs by country and state. This app records what you tell it to and warns nobody on your behalf.
 What it does not ask for: no RECORD_AUDIO, no phone state. INTERNET is needed for any TCP socket, even to 127.0.0.1, the only address JemRec uses. READ_MEDIA_AUDIO (on Android 12, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) is asked only to list recordings made before a reinstall. READ_CALL_LOG and READ_CONTACTS are optional: they tell JemRec who a call was with, and let it notice an unrecorded one. MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS, allowed by the recorder while exact call tracking is on, tells JemRec when a call is answered and ends. Notification access, if you ask, hides Android's debugging notification or names a messenger caller; nothing else.

fdroid:com.pebblerecorder.app.name: PebbleRecorder
fdroid:com.pebblerecorder.app.summary: Turn a Pebble watch button into a remote start/stop trigger for audio recording.
fdroid:com.pebblerecorder.app.description:
PebbleRecorder turns your Pebble watch into a remote start/stop trigger for audio recording on
your phone. Press a button on the watch, and this app records straight to a folder you choose -
no need to touch your phone.
The watch has no microphone logic of its own - it just sends a start/stop command over Pebble's
AppMessage protocol (relayed through the Pebble/Core companion app) and displays whatever status
comes back, with a mic/record/stop icon and a live elapsed-time timer. All recording happens here,
on the phone, via MediaRecorder, writing AAC/M4A files into a folder you pick through the standard
Android folder picker (Storage Access Framework) - the app only ever writes inside that folder.
Optional features, both off by default:
* Location tagging: attaches a reverse-geocoded location line to each recording's transcript.
* Gemini transcription: sends a finished recording to Google's Gemini API (using your own API key)
 and saves the returned speaker-labeled transcript alongside the recording. This talks to a
 non-free cloud service and is entirely opt-in - the app works fully without it.
Requires a Pebble smartwatch, paired via a Pebble/Core companion app (e.g. Core Devices' official
app), and the matching PebbleRecorder watchapp installed on the watch (see the project's source
repository for the watch app and its own installation instructions).

fdroid:com.stefdp.zipline.name: Zipline
fdroid:com.stefdp.zipline.summary: An Android app to manage your self-hosted Zipline V4 instance.
fdroid:com.stefdp.zipline.description:
Zipline is an app that allows you to manage the files & URLs and shorten URLs & upload files to your self-hosted Zipline instance (Requires Zipline v4.2.3 or greater).
Upload Files:
You can upload any file to your Zipline instance along with all of its settings such as hide the file behind a password, limit the amount of views it can receive or delete it after a specified amount of time.
Manage Files:
You can see, download, edit and delete all the files on your Zipline instance.
Shorten URLs:
You can shorten any URL through your Zipline instance with an optional vanity ID, password or max views.
Manage URLs:
You can open, edit and delete all the shortened URLs on your Zipline instance.
Manage Folders:
You can create, edit, delete, view and upload files to the folders you own on your Zipline instance.
View Metrics:
You can view the stats of your uploads such as storage used, views, total files and URLs.
Manage your own User:
You can change your username, password, avatar and any other personal setting (except for OAuth and sessions).
Manage other Users:
If you are an admin, you can create, edit, delete and view the files of any user on your Zipline instance.
Manage Settings:
If you are a Superadmin, you can view and modify the settings of your Zipline instance such as maximum file size, rateilimits etc.
The app is open source and available on GitHub: https://git.stefdp.com/Stef/Zipline-Android-App.

fdroid:com.tomcooks.reccoon.name: RECCoon
fdroid:com.tomcooks.reccoon.summary: Offline recorder with on-device Parakeet transcription
fdroid:com.tomcooks.reccoon.description:
RECCoon is a minimal, private audio recorder that transcribes on the device.
Record in uncompressed WAV, or switch to small AAC (.m4a) files.
Everything stays on your phone: there is no account, no analytics and no upload.
Features:
* One big record button: tap to start, tap to stop and save.
* Live waveform and left/right peak meters with a clip indicator.
* MONO/STEREO radios and a Swap L/R icon button for devices whose channels are reversed.
* MIC and SPK pickers: auto, built-in, wired, USB or Bluetooth, with a refresh entry.
* WAV/M4A, MONO/STEREO and Silence alerts fit on one compact line.
* Live monitoring: hear the microphone through the output you choose (headphones recommended).
* Markers: add labelled cue points while recording; they are embedded in the WAV and shown in the player.
* Discard button (with confirmation) to throw away a bad take without saving.
* Recordings list and a player with scrubber, +-10 s jumps, speed control and per-word tap-to-seek.
* Export transcripts as .txt or .srt next to Transcribe, or share/rename/delete recordings.
* Recordings are stored in Downloads/RECCoon.
Transcription uses NVIDIA Parakeet v3 (multilingual) through sherpa-onnx and
runs fully offline. The model is about 670 MB and is downloaded once, on first
use, over the internet; after that no network is needed.
Free software, released under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

fdroid:com.wmstein.transektcount.name: TransektCount
fdroid:com.wmstein.transektcount.summary: A butterfly monitoring app for transect counters.
fdroid:com.wmstein.transektcount.description:
TransectCount supports the species-specific counting of butterflies per transect section according to the European Butterfly Monitoring Scheme method. It is meant for transect counters to ease registering butterflies and day-flying moth during transect surveys.
New in Version 5.1.6:
- Code improvements
- GPX file import recognizes also files having 1 track with n track segments instead of having n tracks
- Entering species notes proposed with predefined wordings like "Photo", "Flyby", "New species", …
- Cloud %-values rounded to multiples of 10
- More restrictive plausi for input of metadata numbers
- Name composition for exported files changed
- "Help" text updated
- Docs updated
- Bugfix for importing a species list
Features:
- Data collection is based on a transect inspection.
- Databases refer to a transect and can be individually created and customised within the app with regard to metadata, transect sections and expected species.
- The app contains an internal list with many European species and has a prepared database for a transect section with the most common species to be expected in Germany as a starting point for direct use.
- Export of the current species list for later re-import by TransektCount or import by the complementary app TourCount.
- Separate counters for internal/external counting areas and separately for ♂-♀-indeterminate, ♂, ♀, pupa, caterpillar or egg.
- Results page with prepared presentation for transfer to the input mask of Butterfly Monitoring Germany (web.app.ufz.de/tagfalter-monitoring/).
- The results can be exported in formatted XLSX or CSV format, as well as in an SQLite database file (e.g. to transfer them to a PC, for easier reading in a spreadsheet program, or for further processing).
- The help contains detailed user instructions.
- TransektCount supports counting in German, English, French, Italian and Spanish language and provides locale species names in these languages.
Functions:
- Duplicate and delete transect sections.
- Editing the transect section lists (adding and deleting species and editing terms).
- Editor for metadata in preparation for an inspection.
- Counter page per section with scroll-down list for species selection.
- Species editor for annotation and bulk counter entries.
- Optionally, GPS support for an info to change the current section.
- The results page shows metadata, notes, totals and counting results per species and transect section.
Prerequisites:
The app requires permits for
- storage access for importing and exporting counting data, results, species lists or track data,
- preventing the sleep mode und
- (optionally) the GPS controlled signaling of the current transect section.
The device screen should have a minimum resolution of 1024 x 1920 pixels.
The app can be used with Android version 11 or newer.
Documentation is provided under:
https://github.com/wistein/TransektCount/tree/master/docs.
TransektCount is one of two apps for monitoring European butterflies. 
The second app, TourCount, supports the species-specific and individually GPS-localised counting of butterflies on any walk in nature. 
Both apps use the coding scheme of Karsholt/Razowski for European butterflies and thus contain only European butterfly pictures.

flathub:com.sweethome3d.Sweethome3d.name: Sweet Home 3D
flathub:com.sweethome3d.Sweethome3d.description:
Home 3D is a free interior design application that helps you place your furniture
 on a house 2D plan, with a 3D preview.
 This program is aimed at people who want to design their interior quickly, whether
 they are moving or they just want to redesign their existing home. Numerous visual
 guides help you draw the plan of your home and layout furniture. You may draw the
 walls of your rooms upon the image of an existing plan, and then, drag and drop
 furniture onto the plan from a catalog organized by categories. Each change in the
 2D plan is simultaneously updated in the 3D view, to show you a realistic rendering
 of your layout.

flathub:in.cinny.Cinny.name: Cinny
flathub:in.cinny.Cinny.summary: Yet another Matrix client with simple, elegant and secure interface.
flathub:in.cinny.Cinny.description:
Cinny is a matrix.org client focusing primarily on simple, elegant and secure interface protected by e2ee with the power of open source.
 Features: User-friendly design, Login and register, Full space support, Encryption and emoji verification, Ability to create new rooms and tweak settings, Support replies, markdown, message editing, Dark, light, and black themes.

flathub:io.github.accessory.minus_games_.name: Minus Games
flathub:io.github.accessory.minus_games_.description:
Minus Games offers an efficient solution for downloading, synchronizing, and
 running your games. It keeps your game files managed and up-to-date with the latest
 patches and updates from a Minus Games Server Instance. With seamless synchronization
 across devices, you can effortlessly continue your progress no matter where you are.
 This setup ensures a reliable and straightforward way to enhance and manage your gaming
 experience.

flathub:io.github.dman95.SASM.name: SASM
flathub:io.github.dman95.SASM.summary: Simple cross-platform IDE for NASM, MASM, GAS and FASM assembly languages
flathub:io.github.dman95.SASM.description: SASM (SimpleASM) - simple Open Source cross-platform IDE for NASM, MASM, GAS, FASM assembly languages. SASM has syntax highlighting and debugger. The program works out of the box and is great for beginners to learn assembly language. SASM is translated into Russian, English, Turkish (thanks Ali Goren), Chinese (thanks Ahmed Zetao Yang), German (thanks Sebastian Fischer), Italian (thanks Carlo Dapor), Polish (thanks Krzysztof Rossa), Hebrew (thanks Elian Kamal), Spanish (thanks Mariano Cordoba). Licensed under the GNU GPL v3.0. Based on the Qt.

flathub:lol.janjic.Splitcat.description: Simple file splitting and merging application with predefined presets for popular apps.

flathub:net.worldofpadman.WoP.name: World of PADMAN
flathub:net.worldofpadman.WoP.description:
The earliest PadMaps for Quake 3 Arena gave rise to the mod PadWorld, which was followed by the colorful evolution, World of PADMAN. Developed by 
 cartoonist and illustrator ENTE, PadWorld Entertainment presents a colorful, freeware, fun shooter for the young and the young at heart, powered 
 by an enhanced id Tech 3 graphics engine.
 WoP is the domain of ENTE's comic strip superhero PADMAN and his motley crew. Their mission is to make your gaming experience seriously addictively 
 fun, no matter your skill level or character role you jump into. Over the years, the maps have been revamped, the bots improved, the KillerDucks have 
 been kept hungry, and the weapons have been re-polished. In all, there are 24 maps. Each supports up to nine game types, including WoP's unique Spray 
 Your Color, Last Pad Standing, Big Balloon, Catch The KillerDuck, Freeze Tag, and, of course, Capture the Lolly. Explore scaled-up, richly detailed 
 environments of everyday places where imaginative characters go berserk with colorful plastic weaponry and power-ups. Start rockin' to the Dieselkopf 
 and Neurological soundtracks, and listen to the Pad Anthem performed by Green Sun. Grab your earphones!
 Not enough human players on public servers? Practice with bots, and join the community on the official PadWorld server for Padday community events 
 every first Sunday of the month at 7:00 pm CET.
 Additional license information: The game code is publicly developed and released under the GNU GPL v2.0. The game assets, however, are protected by 
 copyright.

flathub:org.flozz.yoga-image-optimizer.name: YOGA Image Optimizer
flathub:org.flozz.yoga-image-optimizer.summary: Convert and optimize JPEG, PNG and WebP images
flathub:org.flozz.yoga-image-optimizer.description:
YOGA Image Optimizer is a free tool to convert and optimize images. It currently
 supports JPEG, PNG and WebP as output formats and much more image formats
 are supported as input.
 With YOGA, you will be able to save about 30 % of space on JPEGs and 20 % on PNGs.
 On WebP images, you will only save few percents... but converting a
 JPEG to a lossy WebP can reduce image size to a half and converting
 a PNG to a lossy WebP can save you 35 % on average.
 Please note that image optimization can be slow and may require a lot of RAM, especially
 for JPEGs. For example, the JPEG encoder needs 300 MB of RAM and 3 min
 per Mpix (PNG and WebP encoders are less resource hungry).

flathub:org.openjkdf2.OpenJKDF2.name: OpenJKDF2
flathub:org.openjkdf2.OpenJKDF2.summary: A cross-platform reimplementation of “Jedi Knight™: Dark Forces II”
flathub:org.openjkdf2.OpenJKDF2.description:
OpenJKDF2 is an open-source re-implementation of “Jedi Knight™: Dark Forces II” (JKDF2).
 OpenJKDF2 removes the hassle of rendering and input compatibility shims, while also
 providing in-app guided installation steps, cross-platform multiplayer, and a host
 of graphical (and other) improvements.
 “Jedi Knight™: Dark Forces II” is Copyright © Lucasfilm Ltd. 1997-2009.
 An original “Jedi Knight™: Dark Forces II” game disk, or original licensed assets from Steam or GOG, are required in order to play OpenJKDF2.

flathub:org.recoll.recoll.name: Recoll
flathub:org.recoll.recoll.description:
Recoll is a document indexer. It finds keywords inside documents text as well as file names.
 It can search most document formats.
 It can reach any storage place: files, archive members, email attachments, transparently
 handling decompression.
 One click will open the document inside a native editor or display an even quicker text preview.

flathub:org.texstudio.TeXstudio.name: TeXstudio
flathub:org.texstudio.TeXstudio.description:
TeXstudio is an integrated writing environment for creating LaTeX documents. It integrates editing,
 building and viewing into a single, user-friendly interface.
 Our goal is to make writing LaTeX as easy and comfortable as possible. This means you can focus
 on your content with the help of a powerful set of features:
 Easy source code navigation: A structure view, clickable links and a cursor history
 Detailed syntax highlighting
 Auto-completion
 Live checking for spelling, grammar, citations, references, syntax and packages
 Innovative table editing
 Clear display of LaTeX errors and warnings (in-editor and as a list)
 Integrated PDF viewer with (almost) word-level syncing
 Live-updating inline preview for formulas and code segments
 Scripting support
 Requires either TeX Live being installed on the system from your distribution's repositories
 or the TeX Live Flatpak which you can install by running 'flatpak install flathub org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.texlive//25.08'

flathub:page.codeberg.jaerrib.attack-vec.name: Attack Vector Alpha
flathub:page.codeberg.jaerrib.attack-vec.description: Attack Vector Alpha is a retro arcade game built around a single orbital mechanic: player movement is limited to a path around a central core. Waves of enemies escalate in increasing danger while players defend the core from waves of enemies for as long as possible. The health of the core is all that matters: players themselves have no HP, no extra lives, no continues, and no way to win (high scores only). When the core is destroyed, the run ends.

fedora-packages:erlang-redbug/erlang-red.name: erlang-redbug
fedora-packages:erlang-redbug/erlang-red.description: redbug is a tool to interact with the Erlang trace facility. It is intended to be run from the erlang shell, but it can also be run from an OS shell as an escript (see below). It will instruct the Erlang VM to generate so-called 'trace messages' when certain events (such as a particular function being called) occur. It uses a safe subset of the tracing functionality, and exits if it feels overloaded, e.g. if it gets flooded by trace messages. It runs in the background, collecting trace messages, until it reaches one of its termination criteria (number of messages/file size or elapsed time). The trace messages are either printed (i.e. human readable) to a file or to the screen; or written to a trc file. Using a trc file puts less stress on the system, but there is no way to count the messages (so the 'msgs' opt is ignored), and the files can only be read by special tools (such as 'bread'). Printing and trc files cannot be combined. By default (i.e. if the 'file' opt is not given), messages are printed.

fedora-packages:ghc-network-bsd/ghc-netw.name: ghc-network-bsd
fedora-packages:ghc-network-bsd/ghc-netw.description: This package provides Haskell bindings to the the [POSIX network database (<netdb.h>) API](http://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/009696699/basedefs/netdb.h.html). === Relationship to the 'network' package The 'network' package version 2.* series provides "Network.BSD" but it is removed starting with 'network' version 3.0. This package provides the "Network.BSD" module split off from the <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/network network package>. If in addition to the 'network''s modules also "Network.BSD" is necessary, add 'network-bsd' to your dependencies like so: > library > build-depends: network >= 2.7 && < 3.1 > , network-bsd >= 2.7 && < 2.9 I.e. you can control the version of the 'network' package independently. __NOTE__: Starting with 'network-bsd-2.8.1.0' the APIs of 'network' and 'network-bsd' evolve differently, and consequently the versioning doesn't match up anymore! Moreover, also starting with version 'network-bsd-2.8.1.0' this package requires 'network >= 3' in order to avoid module name clashes with 'network < 3''s "Network.BSD" module. However, 'network-bsd-2.7.0.0' and 'network-bsd-2.8.0.0' passes thru the "Network.BSD" module from 'network-2.7.*' and 'network-2.8.*' respectively in a non-clashing way via Cabal's <https://www.haskell.org/cabal/users-guide/developing-packages.html#pkg-field-library-reexported-modules reexported-modules> feature while ensuring a well-defined <https://pvp.haskell.org/ API versioning> of the observable API of 'network-bsd'. This is why the example above supporting a wide range of 'network' versions works by including version 2.7.0.0 in the required version range of 'network-bsd'.

By using this extension, we can define a set of rules: allow a specific set of credentials reject a certain type of credentials deny password that can be easily cracked enforce use of an expiration date with a minimum of day for a password define a password reuse policy define the number of authentication failure allowed before a user is banned This extension provides all the checks as configurable parameters. The default configuration settings, will not enforce any complex checks and will try to allow most of the credentials. By using SET credcheck.<check-name> TO <some value>; command, enforce new settings for the credential checks. The settings can only be changed by a superuser.

- 281 blocking rules across 3 rulesets

- Per-site control with one-click toggle
- Light and dark theme support

firefox-addons:2998081.name: djset-webtools
firefox-addons:2998081.summary: YouTube ↔ 1001tracklists integration for DJ set listeners
firefox-addons:2998081.description:
This add-on tries to improve your DJ set listening experience by giving you: 
 a simple 1 click access to the 1001tracklists page that best matches the title of the current >30 minutes video on youtube, right under the youtube video title
 pop-out an always visible, resizable, youtube player on 1001tracklists, that anchors to one of the four page corners, so you can have the video visible even when scrolling away from the top of the page (alternatively you can disable this feature and use Firefox native pop-out)
 1001tracklists auto-scrolls page to the current track at track switch, so that it's always visible, when you didn't scroll manually as the set progresses
All features are optional and can be disabled in the add-on options.
Note: the title of the youtube page is used to call 1001tracklists search under the covers to find a matching tracklist. This is the reason for the "Required data collection" note below. No data is collected by this extension in and on itself.

bluejetty:00000001:ios:0.name: Ping
bluejetty:00000001:ios:0.summary: Ping is a personal relationship management app that helps you stay consistently connected with friends, family, and professional contacts using customized outreach cadences and milestone tracking.
bluejetty:00000001:ios:0.description:
Ping helps you stay connected with the people who matter most.
In a busy world, it’s easy to lose touch — even with your closest friends, family, mentors, and professional relationships. Ping gives you a simple, thoughtful system for keeping important connections warm without stress, spreadsheets, or forgotten reminders.
Whether you want to strengthen personal relationships, maintain your professional network, or simply be more intentional with the people in your life, Ping makes it easy.
WHY PING?
Life gets busy. Relationships shouldn’t slip through the cracks. Ping helps you stay meaningfully connected by giving you clarity, structure, and gentle reminders — all in one clean, modern app designed for real humans.
KEY FEATURES
• Add Your Most Important Contacts
Create a focused list of the people you want to stay connected with — friends, family, mentors, clients, coworkers, and more. Each contact includes space for notes, relationship context, important dates, and personal details you never want to forget.
• Smart Cadences and Check-In Scheduling
Set how often you’d like to reach out, and Ping will calculate when your next touchpoint should be. The app organizes contacts into Overdue, Due Today, and Upcoming so you always know exactly who needs attention.
• Log Interactions Effortlessly
Record calls, texts, emails, meetings, and other meaningful moments. Ping updates timelines and next outreach dates automatically, helping you see your relationship progress at a glance.
• A Clean, Modern Dashboard
Your home screen summarizes everything:
How many contacts are up to date
Who needs attention
Your upcoming outreach schedule
Quick actions for calling, texting, or emailing
It removes overwhelm and makes staying connected feel natural.
• Build a Habit of Meaningful Connection
Ping isn’t a social network. It doesn’t track your messages or require your private data. Instead, it empowers you to build real relationships — intentionally, privately, and consistently.
WHO IS PING FOR?
Ping is perfect for:
• People who want to strengthen friendships or family connections
• Partners trying to be more thoughtful in their daily communication
• Founders, creators, and professionals managing personal networks
• Anyone who struggles to remember outreach timing or track relationship history
• Those who value meaningful human connection in a digital world
If you’ve ever said “We should talk more often,” Ping is for you.
DESIGNED WITH PURPOSE
Ping is intentionally simple. No complex CRM features. No clutter. No distractions. Just the tools you need to nurture relationships with clarity, consistency, and care.
Your relationships deserve attention — and Ping helps you give it.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your relationship data belongs to you. Ping does not share or sell your information. Ever.
START NURTURING YOUR RELATIONSHIPS TODAY
Download Ping to build a more connected, intentional life — one thoughtful touchpoint at a time.

bluejetty:00136189:ios.description:
Beat Boxing Fitness is a non-stop fat burning cardio class that combines punching, kicking, boxing style moves, and dance moves to today's hottest music from all genres. 
How Beat Boxing Fitness Works
Our dance cardio classes will help you burn calories & tone all at the same time.. we have workouts without weights that will help with weight loss & toning your whole body. 
We also have workouts with weights for added toning & maximum benefits. 
So, whether your trying to build muscle, lose weight, gain confidence, or all of the above..we have the workouts for you!!
Back Story
Beat Boxing Fitness was created by Beverly Thomas in 2015. She fell in love with dance fitness and wanted to create something easy to follow but effective & FUN. It was a hit and people from all over the area quickly fell in love with it as well. A few years later her daughter fell in love with the classes & concept of it. It then became a family business and now her and her daughter own a hometown fitness studio together in West Virginia. They started online on tiktok sharing routines & success stories and gained 330,000 virtual fans/followers in just months. Now Beat Boxing Fitness offers online classes & workouts to people all over the world. 
We have an amazing fit family & would love for you to join us!!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Beat Boxing Fitness on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://beatboxingfitnessworkouts.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://beatboxingfitnessworkouts.vhx.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00186424:ios.description:
A fast paced Mental Maths game for kids where they can compete with their friends and even class mates. 
Build confidence and speed with mental maths. 
Free the monsters from their cages - how many monsters can you collect?
Swipe the monster with the correct answer to break down the wall to get to the next level.
Earn coins to release new lively monsters from their cages.
The faster you are with the answer the more damage to the wall and coins you will collect. 
But be careful! Get the wrong answer and your health will quickly run out.
Who will be the champion in each maths area? And who will be the overall Top Player? 
Children can compete against all their school friends, with our great new Made For Schools mode. Schools can register with Mental Math Monsters and provide students with their own logins to enable them to compete against all their school friends. You might be the Top Player at home but can you rise to the challenge against your entire class!
- Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication and Division modes.
- Made for children 4 and up. 
- Compete with your class mates as well as friends at home. 
- Grow your collection of rowdy monsters, who will you release next?
- Maths questions advance as you progress through the levels.
- Many colourful landscapes to discover.
- Play on Apple TV, iPad and iPhone.
- iCloud sync and Made For Schools login lets you continue where you left off no matter which device you last used.
- Fully COPPA compliant (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act).
Our aim is to design apps where the kids have so much fun, they don't even realise they are learning!
We hope you enjoy Mental Math Monsters.

bluejetty:00152812:ios.name: Free PDF Scanner App For Doc
bluejetty:00152812:ios.summary:
Free PDF Scanner App for Doc
Need to scan a document, save it as a PDF, or share important paperwork? Free Scan makes it easy to scan, edit, sign, and organize documents right from your iPhone. You can also scan QR codes, barcodes, IDs, an
bluejetty:00152812:ios.description:
Free PDF Scanner App for Doc
Need to scan a document, save it as a PDF, or share important paperwork? Free Scan makes it easy to scan, edit, sign, and organize documents right from your iPhone. You can also scan QR codes, barcodes, IDs, and passports, all the features in one app.
Enjoy all premium features free for 3 days. Cancel anytime before your trial ends.
KEY FEATURES
Versatile Scanning Modes: Instantly scan documents, receipts, photos, and notes. Access dedicated modes for QR code and barcode scanning, as well as secure ID card and passport scanning.
AI-Powered Quality: Automatically detect edges, remove shadows, and optimize scans for perfect clarity and readability. Intelligent light detection can also activate your flashlight when focusing on a document in low-light conditions.
Advanced Editing Suite: Seamlessly crop, rotate, and adjust colours with ease. Apply professional filters to enhance any document and use digital signing features to complete forms and paperwork directly from your device.
OCR Text Recognition: Extract text from scanned documents using Optical Character Recognition (OCR). Recognize printed information and make it easier to work with digitally, without manually retyping everything.
PDF Management, Sharing & Export: Combine files from your gallery, iCloud, Google Drive, or Dropbox into a single PDF. Organize scans for easy access, then share PDFs and images via iMessage or other sharing options, export them to cloud storage, or print documents with a single tap. 
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How do I scan a document and save it as a PDF on my iPhone?
Open Free Scan and point your camera at the document you want to scan. Capture the page, adjust the crop if needed, and let the app enhance the image. Save your scan as a PDF to keep it, share it, or print it whenever you need it.
What is OCR, and how can I use it to scan documents?
OCR stands for Optical Character Recognition. It identifies text in scanned documents, helping you access and work with printed information digitally instead of manually typing it all out.
Can I edit and sign documents on my iPhone?
Yes. Free Scan provides tools to crop, rotate, and adjust scanned documents, along with digital signing capabilities. You can prepare documents and complete paperwork directly from your device.
How can I scan a QR code or barcode with my phone?
Free Scan includes dedicated QR code and barcode scanning modes. Open the relevant mode and scan the code with your device's camera to access its encoded information.
How do I share a scanned PDF with someone?
After scanning and saving your document, use the app's sharing or export options. You can share files through iMessage and other available sharing options, export them to supported cloud services, or print them directly.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS:
Weekly Subscription: $4.99
(Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in other countries, and are subject to change without notice.)
SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS
Your Free Scan journey begins with a complimentary 3-day trial period.
After the 3-day trial, your subscription will begin and payment will be automatically charged to your iTunes Account unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial. 
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation and again within 24 hours of renewal. Manage subscriptions or turn off auto-renew via Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://www.freelabs.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.freelabs.ai/freescan/terms

An easy-to-use app for creating pixel art and 8-bit style artwork.
8bit Painter is a simple pixel art drawing app that beginners can start enjoying right away.
With intuitive controls, you can easily create pixel art for social media icons, game skins, illustrations, patterns, and more. It is also great for making designs for Perler beads, cross-stitch, knitting, and other handmade projects.
Key Features
- Simple controls that are easy for anyone to use
- Clear, focused tools for creating pixel art
- Perfect for beginners
- Great for making social media icons and game skins
- Import photos and convert them into pixel art
- Choose colors intuitively with a color wheel, sliders, and palettes
- Export transparent images in PNG format
- Export and import your artwork data
Canvas Sizes
16x16 / 24x24 / 32x32 / 48x48 / 64x64 / 96x96 / 128x128 / 160x160 / 192x192
Choose the right canvas size for your project, from small social media icons to detailed pixel art and craft patterns.
Image Import
Import your favorite photos and automatically convert them into pixel art.
It is also useful for creating social media icons, game skins, and pixel art assets.
Color Selection
Choose a base color with the color wheel, then fine-tune it with sliders or HEX input. You can also pick colors quickly from preset palettes, or save frequently used colors to your custom color palette for reuse.
Artwork Data Management
Export artwork data saved in your Gallery from the Settings screen, and import it again when needed. This is helpful for keeping your pixel art safe, preparing for a device change, or reinstalling the app.
Artwork Storage
- The initial artwork storage limit is 30 artworks
- Expand the limit up to 600 artworks by watching rewarded video ads or purchasing the Remove Ads add-on
Image Export
- Choose from 3 export sizes
- Supports transparent PNG images
- Useful for social media posts, game skins, and exporting assets
Remove Ads Add-On
- Hides all ads
- Expands the artwork storage limit to 600 artworks
- Can be restored after reinstalling the app
- One-time purchase
How to Expand Your Storage Limit
- Each rewarded video ad you watch increases your artwork storage limit by 5 artworks, up to 600
- Purchasing the Remove Ads add-on expands your artwork storage limit to 600 artworks
Recommended For
- Anyone who wants to start creating pixel art
- People who want to make their own social media icons
- Anyone who wants to create game skins easily
- People making designs for Perler beads or cross-stitch
- People designing knitting patterns or handmade projects
- Anyone who wants to turn photos into pixel art
- People looking for a simple pixel art editor
- Anyone who wants to manage their artwork data and keep using the app over time
Enjoy creating pixel art and 8-bit style artwork with 8bit Painter!

Key fe
bluejetty:00079444:android.description:
CodePen brings the world’s best HTML/CSS/JS experiments to your pocket. Browse trending Pens, follow creators, preview live demos and open, edit or publish your own front‑end projects — all with a fast, polished UI built for mobile.
Key features
• Live preview & editor — real-time HTML/CSS/JS preview with syntax highlighting, console and resource management. Tweak code and see results instantly.
• Browse & discover — Trending, Popular, Collections, Blogs and Authors; curated feeds make it easy to find inspiration.
• Publish & share — Create new Pens, save drafts, publish to your account and share beautiful preview images or direct links.
• Code editor tools — multi‑tab editor, code panes, keyboard toolbar, inspector overlay and dark/light editor themes for comfortable coding.
• Multimedia support — embedded video, images and full‑screen galleries for immersive previews.
• Offline cache & sync — local caching for faster browsing and offline access; favorites sync across devices.
• Social features — like, comment, follow authors and join the community from inside the app.
• Membership & purchases — upgrade to remove ads and unlock premium features (in‑app purchases supported).
• Notifications & updates — get notified about new activity, posts and updates (push notifications supported).
• Accessibility & localization — translated UI and adjustable fonts/themes for a global audience.
Why CodePen mobile?
• Instant experimentation — launch prototypes fast and iterate on the go.
• Full‑featured mobile editor — a surprisingly powerful editor tailored for touch and productivity.
• Learn from creators — discover real‑world front‑end patterns, UI tricks and animation ideas.
• Built for performance — efficient caching, smooth UI and integrated previews that respect bandwidth.
Who is this for?
• Front‑end developers who want to test, demo and tinker away from the desktop.
• Designers who prototype micro‑interactions or share visual experiments quickly.
• Students and learners exploring HTML, CSS and JavaScript with immediate visual feedback.
Permissions & monetization
• Requires internet access, push notifications and Play Billing for in‑app purchases. Ads are included (can be removed via membership).
Support & privacy
• Help and feedback available in the app. Privacy policy & terms are accessible from the settings screen.
Download CodePen and carry creative front‑end experiments everywhere — code, preview and publish from your phone.

bluejetty:00140285:ios.name: Strike Force: Tank Shooter
bluejetty:00140285:ios.summary:
Strike Force: Tank Shooter – an exhilarating arcade shooter game that thrusts you into battle with your war tank.
This shooter game, inspired by retro classics, mixes the fun of old arcade games with the fast-paced action of modern warfare
bluejetty:00140285:ios.description:
Strike Force: Tank Shooter – an exhilarating arcade shooter game that thrusts you into battle with your war tank.
This shooter game, inspired by retro classics, mixes the fun of old arcade games with the fast-paced action of modern warfare. As a soldier in the Strike Force, you'll drive through dangerous landscapes, avoid constant attacks from heavy weapons, and destroy enemy tanks and fuel tanks.
Whether you're a seasoned tank commander or new to tank games, Strike Force: Tank Shooter offers an unforgettable shooting experience.
HOW TO PLAY
Your objective is to eliminate enemy forces, including tanks, soldiers, and artillery units while completing mission objectives. Here’s a step-by-step guide to get you started:
- Select Your Tank: Choose from a variety of tanks, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Upgrade your tank as you progress to enhance its firepower and durability.
- Mission Briefing: Before each mission, you'll receive a briefing outlining your objectives.
- Controls: Use the joystick to maneuver your tank and shoot.
FEATURES
- Retro Arcade Style: Enjoy the nostalgic feel of retro arcade games with modern graphics and smooth gameplay.
- Diverse Tank Selection: Choose from a wide range of tanks, each upgradeable.
- Challenging Missions: Complete a variety of missions that test your strategic thinking and shooting skills.
- Power-Ups and Upgrades: Enhance your tank with powerful upgrades and collect temporary power-ups to gain an edge in battle.
- Intuitive Controls: Easy-to-learn controls ensure that players of all skill levels can jump into the action.
Join the Strike Force today, take command of your tank, and become a legend on the battlefield. Prepare for an arcade shooting experience like no other in Strike Force: Tank Shooter!

*** Privacy policy:

bluejetty:00184375:ios.name: open פועלים
bluejetty:00184375:ios.summary:
אפליקציית פועלים open מאפשרת לכם לפתוח חשבון בנק בכל רגע ומכל מקום. בנוסף, תוכלו לבצע באמצעותה מגוון פעולות בחשבון הקיים, כמו שחזור קוד משתמש וסיסמה ועוד. כל זאת בלי להגיע לסניף, בלי ניירת ובלי לעמוד בתור!
איך פותחים חשבון בנק בפועלים open
bluejetty:00184375:ios.description:
אפליקציית פועלים open מאפשרת לכם לפתוח חשבון בנק בכל רגע ומכל מקום. בנוסף, תוכלו לבצע באמצעותה מגוון פעולות בחשבון הקיים, כמו שחזור קוד משתמש וסיסמה ועוד. כל זאת בלי להגיע לסניף, בלי ניירת ובלי לעמוד בתור!
איך פותחים חשבון בנק בפועלים open? ממש פשוט וממש מהר!
מורידים את האפליקציה ופותחים חשבון באמצעות טכנולוגיית זיהוי פנים. לאחר סיום התהליך, מורידים את אפליקציית "בנק הפועלים״ ונכנסים לחשבון החדש שלכם!
תוכלו לנהל את החשבון החדש באפליקציה, באתר, בטלפון ובכל סניף שתבחרו.
אז מה צריך בשביל לפתוח חשבון בדיגיטל? לא הרבה...
- תעודת זהות מקורית
- מכשיר טלפון עם מצלמה ומיקרופון תקינים
ניתן לפתוח חשבון באמצעות אפליקציית פועלים open מגיל 16 ומעלה.
ניתן לפתוח חשבון לאדם יחיד או חשבון משותף. 
פעולות נוספות שניתן לבצע בחשבון הקיים שלכם דרך אפליקציית פועלים open:
שינוי סוג חשבון קטין לחשבון בגיר
פתיחת החשבון באמצעות אפליקציית OPEN מיועדת ללקוחות תושבי ישראל בגיל 16 ומעלה, כפופה לתנאי הבנק והשירות ותתאפשר במכשירים תומכים בלבד
חשבון סטודנט
"מועדון סטודנט" מיועד לסטודנטים הלומדים במוסד להשכלה גבוהה או מוסד על תיכוני מוכר או מוסד להשכלה גבוהה בחו"ל. במסלול לימודים בן שנה ומעלה בגילאי 35 - 18 . בין ההטבות - 100% הנחה בעמלת פעולה ע"י פקיד או בערוץ ישיר. ו-100% הנחה מדמי כרטיס, בתוקף למשך 3 שנים מיום הפעלת הכרטיס לכרטיס חדש שהונפק לאחר שהחשבון צורף ל-"מועדון פועלים סטודנט". הנפקת הכרטיס מותנית באישור המנפיקה ו/או הבנק ועל פי שיקול דעתם. אי עמידה בפרעון ההלוואה או האשראי בכרטיס אשראי, עלולה לגרור חיוב בריבית פיגורים והליכי הוצאה לפועל. שם המלווה (מעמיד האשראי): בנק הפועלים בע"מ. הבנק רשאי לשנות את התנאים ו/או ההטבות מעת לעת
חשבון חייל
מועדון "פועלים חייל" מיועד לחיילים, משרתים בכוחות הביטחון או מג"ב בשירות סדיר, מתנדבים בשירות לאומי ושנת שירות בגילאי 17-35. בין ההטבות 100% הנחה בעמלת פעולה ע"י פקיד ובעמלת פעולה בערוץ ישיר, 100% הנחה בעמלת הזמנת פנקס שיקים רגיל, ו-100% הנחה בעמלת דמי כרטיס לכרטיס חדש שהונפק לאחר שהחשבון צורף ל-"מועדון פועלים חייל". הנפקת הכרטיס מותנית באישור המנפיקה ו/או הבנק ועל פי שיקול דעתם. אי עמידה בפרעון ההלוואה או האשראי בכרטיס אשראי, עלולה לגרור חיוב בריבית פיגורים והליכי הוצאה לפועל. שם המלווה (מעמיד האשראי): בנק הפועלים בע"מ. הבנק רשאי לשנות את התנאים ו/או ההטבות מעת לעת
חשבון פועלים YOUNG
חשבון פועלים Young הוא חשבון שניתן לצרפו להסדר ההנחות "מועדון פועלים צעיר". לפרטים נוספים, תנאים והטבות, ראו אתר הבנק והתעריפון. 100% הנחה בעמלת פעולה ע"י פקיד ובעמלת פעולה בערוץ ישיר. הנפקת כרטיס החיוב המיידי היא לגילאי 16 ומעלה או לנוער עובד מגיל 15 וכפופה לאישור הבנק על פי שיקול דעתו ולתנאי הסכם כרטיס החיוב. הבנק יהיה רשאי לשנות ו/או לבטל את התנאים ו/או ההטבות מעת לעת.
חשבון זוגי "מתחתנים"
פתיחת חשבון זוגי וקבלת ההטבות בכפוף לתנאי הבנק ואישורו, הטבות לזכאים שיצטרפו ל"הטבות מתחתנים" בערוצים הדיגיטליים, בתוקף ל 12- חודשים מעת ההצטרפות כמפורט באתר הבנק וכוללות: 100% הנחה מעמלת פעולה ע"י פקיד ופעולות בערוץ ישיר, עמלת טיפול במזומנים ע"י פקיד שטרות מעל 10,000 ₪. מתן ההלוואה כפוף לאישור הבנק ותנאיו.הפקת הכרטיס מותנית באישור המנפיקה ו/או הבנק ועל פי שיקול דעתם. אי עמידה בפירעון ההלוואה או בפירעון האשראי בכרטיס אשראי, עלולה לגרור חיוב בריבית פיגורים והליכי הוצאה לפועל. שם המלווה (מעמיד האשראי): בנק הפועלים בע"מ. פועלים וונדר: למחזיקים בכרטיס אשראי משתתף של בנק הפועלים ומצורפים ל-"פועלים באינטרנט". בכפוף לתקנון ולתנאי השימוש באפליקציית .Poalim Wonder . הבנק רשאי לשנות ו/או לבטל את התנאים מעת לעת

Jot it down.
Enjoy checking it off.

■ A thought, a note, a
bluejetty:00074399:ios.description:
Jot it down.
Enjoy checking it off.
Groceries on the way home. A deadline you don't want to miss. A habit you'd like to keep. Do! gives your everyday to-dos a simple home: add a task, then double-tap when it's done.
■ A thought, a note, a satisfying checkoff
Catch a task while it's on your mind. Finished? Double-tap to mark it done. Even a small task deserves that little moment of satisfaction.
■ Make it a list you like coming back to
Choose your themes and fonts, with sounds inspired by pen and paper. Like picking a favorite notebook, make your daily list feel like yours.
■ A place for every part of your day
Keep work, study and shopping in their own groups. Add color to tell things apart, and pin the tasks you want to keep in sight.
■ Less to remember, every time around
Set tasks to repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. Add reminders for the things you don't want to miss.
■ A quick look from your home screen
Keep your to-dos close with home screen widgets. Check your list during a busy morning without opening the app.
■ Put your keyboard to work
Use an external keyboard to add tasks and give longer notes room to breathe.
• Add a task: Command(⌘) + N
• Insert a line break: Option(⌥/Alt) + Enter
■ Your list, on your other devices
Use the same app and sign in with the same account to sync your tasks across devices. Pick up your familiar list when you switch devices.
■ App lock and backups
Lock access to the app with a passcode or Face ID on supported devices. Back up your data through Dropbox or email and restore it when needed.
It doesn't have to be a big plan.
Start with one thing you'd like to do today.
■ About ads
This app includes ads. An in-app purchase is available to remove them.
Questions and suggestions: do@simplerion.com

SPADES WITH CHAT

- Select your bid! Just like in the real game. How many books do you see? lol

- Our card game is automatically saved at each turn, so you can continue on your own time. Play anytime you want to!
Do you like free card games? Download Spades Jogatina for Free, NOW!
This free card game is a must-have for all Spades and card game addict players! Bid, trump and be the ace in Spades Jogatina!

Ready to expand your vocabulary and learn a new language?
Join thousands of language learners who use Karteto as their go-to vocab builder and flashcard maker. Karteto makes learning different languages fast, fun, and easy. Whether you're looking to practice Spanish, English, Korean, Japanese, French, German, or 100+ other languages, Karteto has got you covered.
Karteto is designed to help you learn languages effectively with interactive language flashcards. Studies show that learning needs to be fun to be effective. Karteto ensures every lesson keeps you engaged and motivated. Practice vocabulary in over 100 languages, including Hebrew, Chinese, Russian, and Arabic.
Why Choose Karteto?
Karteto isn’t just another language app. It’s a powerful vocab builder that adapts to your learning style and helps you memorize words effortlessly. Using spaced repetition, Karteto predicts the optimal time to review a word, ensuring long-term retention.
• Flashcard maker: Create personalized decks and tailor your learning experience.
• Language flashcards: Memorize new words with interactive and image-supported cards.
• Expand vocabulary: Learn new words daily and track your progress.
• Learn a new language: Choose from beginner to advanced levels for each language.
• Learn different languages: Study multiple languages at once and compare words.
• Vocab builder: Unlock achievements and earn rewards as you progress.
• Foreign language immersion: Listen to pronunciation, learn word meanings, and use words in context.
• Learn to speak languages like: English, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, German, French, Portuguese, Russian, Italian, Arabic, Tagalog, Hebrew, Icelandic, Polish, Mandarin Chinese, Turkish, Cantonese Chinese, Dutch, Norwegian, Thai, Swedish, Vietnamese, Maori, Farsi (Persian), Hungarian, Greek, Hindi, Danish, Samoan, Indonesian, Finnish, Serbian, Croatian, Esperanto, Estonian, Ukrainian, Yoruba, Bosnian, Swahili, Igbo, Sanskrit, and even Ainu.
Amazing Features You’ll Love:
• Personal card decks – Organize your vocabulary efficiently.
• Spaced Repetition – Improve retention and recall.
• Audio List – Listen to words and perfect your pronunciation.
• Audio Stories – Learn words in context through engaging audio content.
• Word map – Visually explore connections between words.
• Public decks – Access shared vocab lists for different topics and languages.
• Custom word themes – Focus on specific topics like travel, business, or daily conversation.
• Integrated dictionary – Instantly look up word meanings and translations.
• Flexible learning settings – Adjust speed, difficulty, and focus areas.
• Card pair mode – Reinforce learning with fun matching exercises.
• Images for all words – Enhance memory retention with visual associations.
• Word pronunciation – Listen to native speakers for accurate pronunciation.
• Learning reminders – Stay on track with timely notifications.

In Lumber Chopper, you’re not just cutting trees — you’re building a
bluejetty:00165806:ios.description:
▶ Run Powerful Timber Machinery & Build Your Lumber Empire
Ever dreamed of managing your own logging business — from deep forest harvesting to fully automated factories?
In Lumber Chopper, you’re not just cutting trees — you’re building a thriving lumber company. 
Enjoy the relaxing flow of idle simulation or dive into factory management as your empire expands. Hire skilled lumberjacks, upgrade machinery, and turn raw timber into profit to dominate the wood market.
▶ Chop Trees & Stack Up
Start your journey by cutting trees manually and gathering raw wood. Unlock powerful tools and machinery to automate your logging process. 
Hire experienced lumberjacks to speed up production and clear forests more efficiently. Explore diverse tree types—each offering different values and benefits. 
Some grow faster, while others yield premium timber and higher-quality wood. Watch your yard fill with neatly stacked wood logs, ready to enter your lumber production simulation pipeline. 
Whether you're managing manually or enjoying idle wood harvesting, progress always continues.
▶ Build & Upgrade Your Lumber Factory Inc 
Improve your factory setup by upgrading sawmills and optimizing stations to handle more wood efficiently. 
Increase cutting speed and output by hiring specialized workers and assigning seasoned lumberjacks to key operations. Assign tasks wisely to create a well-oiled tycoon inc operation. 
Enhance automation through strategic upgrades — from energy-saving tools to turbocharged machinery built for serious logging and timber simulation. 
The more you automate, the better your idle income grows, even when you're away!
▶ Manage Logistics & Maximize Profit 
Load processed wood, streamline delivery routes, and manage truck dispatches to generate gold. 
Expand storage and unlock special deals to move larger wood shipments. Reinvest smartly to unlock faster systems and stronger tools. Make efficient decisions that grow your lumber inc with balance and strategy. 
Watch as your logging inc becomes a rising star in the tycoon world.
▶ Expand Into New Logging Zones
Grow your timber empire by unlocking diverse regions — from lush forests to icy timberlands. Each zone introduces unique tree types, fresh layout challenges, and valuable logging opportunities. 
Build advanced facilities like processing plants, expanded storage, and logistics hubs to power your growth. Hire elite lumberjacks to conquer tough terrain and master the art of idle strategy.
▶ No Wi-Fi Needed – Free to Play!
Play anytime, anywhere — no Wi-Fi required. Your lumberjacks keep chopping, machines keep running, and profits keep growing even while you're away.
Optimized for smooth performance across all devices, Lumber Chopper is perfect for both casual players and tycoon lovers looking for deep idle strategy.
Whether you’re starting small or expanding a global wood empire, the progress never stops.
▶ Download Now and Build Your Timber Empire!
Step into the boots of a bold lumber boss and turn a tiny logging site into a thriving lumber inc.
Upgrade your factory, hire expert lumberjacks, and manage powerful machines as you scale your operations and dominate the timber market.
Become the strategist, the builder, the tycoon — and grow the wood business of your dreams.
Your idle lumber logging adventure begins now.

bluejetty:00083650:ios.description:
Welcome to an exciting and educational cleaning game!
Learn how to clean and organize different areas of the house by completing fun and interesting tasks! In this game, you can help with cleaning the kitchen, living room, bedroom, and even the attic! Each task teaches you how to take care of the house and adds a fun atmosphere to daily chores.
Kitchen cleaning: Clear the table, wash the dirty dishes, and organize the refrigerator! Throw away spoiled food, clean the fridge, fill it with fresh products, and decorate it with fun magnets. Don’t forget to clean the stove after cooking so everything shines with cleanliness!
Bedroom cleaning: Make the bed, organize items in the closet, and prepare the desk for new activities! Make your room cozy and tidy, so it's always pleasant to stay in it.
Living room cleaning: Pick up toys, organize them in their places, and vacuum the room! Also, tidy up the shoe cabinet so everything is neat and clean.
Attic cleaning: Clean the attic from dust and cobwebs, fix the chimney, and gather broken furniture to make this abandoned place clean and cozy.
Bathroom and hallway cleaning: In the bathroom, thoroughly clean the floors, and in the hallway, organize shoes and hang everything in its place to keep the house tidy from the entrance.
This cleaning game helps to:
Develop cleanliness and neatness skills.
Enjoy doing household chores.
Improve concentration and responsibility.
Cleaning becomes a fun and exciting process for the whole family! Help the characters tidy up, collect rewards, and improve your skills! Each level brings new tasks and challenges.

bluejetty:00131878:ios.description:
PhotoLeaf : Explore creativity by sleight of hand
 PhotoLeaf is a powerful, full-featured, layer-based photo editing app at your fingertips.
Photo Leaf and a little imagination can make beautiful photo even more beautiful.
PhotoLeaf is a photo editing app for everyone : whether you are novice, a pro user or mobile graphic designer.
PhotoLeaf app will easily create amazing multi-layered creative with touch of your fingers. 
Enjoy All rendering, adjustments, brushes and filters are fully hardware accelerated.
Overview:
• Blend your photos, combine multiple images using layers
• Superimpose photos using complex blending modes.
• Remove unwanted objects from your image easily.
• Custom overlay supported for more flexibility.
• Add text layers, shapes and images to create stylish design creative.
• Blur, sharpen, lighten, or darken portion/area of an image
• Multiple mask modes can be applied on an area. Brush Mask, Color Mask, radial mask, Luminance mask
Color correction Like A Pro:
• Adjust the brightness and saturation of a color using Hue, Saturation, Lightness
• Single-tap color correction presets with color balance, Temperature, Tint, Vibrance, Saturation.
• Control the intensity of the respective color channels in the image with Curves: RGB, blue, red, green channels
• Color correction with Levels
• Tonal color correction with : Highlight and shadow tone, Tone balancing
Light Adjustments:
• Light: Exposure, Brightness, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks,
• Vignette: Amount, Highlights, Roundness
General tools & features: 
1. Cutout and Photo Background Changer 
• Use Lasso tool to recognise similar regions and change photo background
• You can superimpose your cutout on any photo background and create new content
2. Color Splash Photo Effects
• Selectively apply different color, light and gray photo effects on different regions of photos
• Smart lasso tool to automatically select similar color splash regions
• Powerful brush to selectively edit images
3. Merge photos 
• Mix photo to create impressive photo effects
• Merge photos using different blend modes like darken blend, lighten blend to create double exposure, multiple exposure photo effects
4. Doodle and drawings
• Use different doodle brush options to draw on your images
• Change color, thickness and size of your doodle brush
5. Text on photo
• Add different text on your images and create text memes as well
• Option to change thickness, color, font, opacity of the added text
6. Blur Photo Editor
• Apply different blur effects like lens blur, bokeh blur and use mask to blur background.
• Apply vignette effect on inner and outer regions.
7. Unlimited social fun
• Create your own stickers and cartoonize them
• Superimpose stickers on different background images to wow your friends
• Instantly share on Facebook,Twitter, WhatsApp, WeChat,Instagram and other social networks
8. Standard Editing
• Apply global adjustments to your image by changing lighting, tonality and color of your image

- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. 
- The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
- Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. 
- Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
- Terms of use: https://www.photoleaf.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00071270:ios.name: OM Image Share
bluejetty:00071270:ios.summary: OM Image Share (OI.Share) is an app required for wirelessly importing photos captured on an OM Digital Solutions camera. In addition to importing photos, you can use your smartphone as a remote controller for remote shooting. This smartphon
bluejetty:00071270:ios.description:
OM Image Share (OI.Share) is an app required for wirelessly importing photos captured on an OM Digital Solutions camera. In addition to importing photos, you can use your smartphone as a remote controller for remote shooting. This smartphone app makes photography more enjoyable than ever, and offers new ways to use your camera.
1. Easily Import Photos to Your Smartphone
With OI.Share, you can view photos stored on the camera and import them to your smartphone. Simply select photos you want to share ahead of time on the camera (Share Order) to automatically import them when connected to your smartphone via Wi-Fi. With a Bluetooth and Wi-Fi ready camera, you can use OI.Share on its own to import photos for greater convenience.
2. Two Remote Shooting Modes
With remote shooting, you can view Live View images on your smartphone screen while executing shooting techniques in Live View, and in Remote Shutter, you can adjust shooting settings on the camera while using your smartphone to activate the shutter release.
3. Camera How To Offers Shooting Techniques with Tutorial Videos
Camera How To shows how to create beautiful bokeh, how to use Art Filter, and other shooting techniques in easy-to-understand videos. You can also view the camera manual.
* Supported on some models only.
4. Easy Connection
To connect your camera and smartphone, simply scan the QR code displayed on the camera LCD screen with OI.Share. That is all you need to do to complete setup.
* The camera whose QR code is scanned is registered to the app.
* To connect another camera, you must repeat the QR code is scanned step.
5. Display images and track data on your smartphone
During your journey, send your camera's track data by Wi-Fi to your smartphone and you will be able to check the progress that you have made on your journey thus far. Track data will be displayed together with images for easy identification.
* Display of movies and altitude/depth data is only possible when using compatible cameras. Compatible cameras: OM-D E-M1X, TG-6, TG-5, TG-Tracker
6. Organize track data and images on your smartphone
Manage your images and track data imported to your smartphone as single Activities. Relive the excitement of the moment and the feeling of accomplishment by viewing the track data together with your images.
7. Add location information
By simply transferring the GPS log recorded with a smartphone to the camera, location information can be added to photos captured with a compatible camera with built-in Wi-Fi.
When connected via Bluetooth, geotags are added during shooting.
* Supported on some models only.
8. Art Filter
Select from 31 different filter options and 8 supplemental effects to expand your range of expression. Add Art Effects to your Art Filter photos for even more expressive imagery.
* Available Art Effects may differ depending on the Art Filter applied.
9. Colour Creator
With Color Creator, you can control the hue and color saturation for more dramatic photo finishes. Operate the Color Ring that appears on the screen to adjust the hues (30 levels) and saturation (8 levels) of the colors in your photo.
10. Highlight and Shadow Control
Highlight & Shadow Control lets you add variation to photos by controlling light and shadow sections of the image. Highlights, mid-range, and shadows can be individually adjusted using the tone curve that appears on the screen.
11. Dehaze and Clarity
You can use popular OM Workspace functions "Dehaze" and "Clarity" to easily enhance photo textures and give images a clearer finish.
* This app is not guaranteed to work on all Smartphone and tablet devices.
* Available functions will differ by camera.
* Wi-Fi is a registered trademark of the Wi-Fi Alliance.
* The Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Logo is a certification mark of the Wi-Fi Alliance.
* The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by the Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by OM Digital Solutions Corporation is under license.

bluejetty:00074232:ios.description:
Kids App Qustodio is the companion app to Qustodio Parental Control App. Please only download this app to a device being used by a child or teen.
How to get started
1. Download the Qustodio Parental Control App onto your own device (usually your mobile phone or laptop). 
2. Then download this Kids App Qustodio onto any of your child’s devices you want to monitor. 
3. Together, the two apps allow you to seamlessly manage your child’s daily screen time allowance on linked mobile, tablet, or desktop devices.
Features include:
• Daily screen time limits set by the Parent App.
• Website, search and app usage monitoring on the child’s device.
• Website blocking and category blocking (block games and lockout unwanted content) on the child’s device
• Location tracking of the child's device
• Safe search on the child’s device
• Unsupported browser blocking on the child’s device

bluejetty:00186631:ios.description:
Pinksy — Creative Art & Coloring Game for Kids Ages 2–8
Welcome to Pinksy — a unique creative universe built for girls aged 2–8! It's a safe, ad-free, inspiring place where your child can paint, decorate, design, and bring her favorite characters to life!
What Makes This Educational Coloring App So Special?
This easy drawing app for kids and preschool painting game for toddlers brings pure joy and endless possibilities for self-expression. Young artists can experiment with colors, shapes, and styles while discovering their own creative voice. Children explore emotions through art, try new ideas, and feel proud of their creations in this interactive drawing game for young children.
A Huge Variety of Themed Characters
Try drawing princesses, unicorns, cute animals, and simple anime characters:
• Regal princesses ready to decorate
• Magical unicorns and fairies
• Adorable chibis and playful pets
• New content added regularly
Magical Beauty Salon & Dress-Up Fun
This kid-friendly nail salon and makeup game offers gentle creative play:
• Design manicures and apply makeup
• Dress up characters and paint outfits
• Mix colors and accessories for unique looks
Full Set of Artistic Tools
Everything young artists need in this simple coloring game:
• Markers, crayons, pencils, and glitter brushes
• Stickers, prints, and decorative patterns
• Guided lines and big areas for comfortable coloring
Interactive Magic
Every finished picture comes alive! Characters move, react, and play — turning drawings into mini stories full of fun.
Skills to Explore
This art game helps improve fine motor skills while children practice:
• Noticing shapes and choosing colors
• Staying inside lines and filling areas smoothly
• Developing basic line control and early drawing abilities
Why Parents Love This No Ads Art App
This safe offline drawing app turns screen time into meaningful learning. Parents can feel confident their daughter is exploring creativity in a positive, supportive environment.
Download Pinksy today and watch your little princess create!
Please note: only part of the content in the screenshots is available in the free version of the app. To gain access to all app content, you need to make an in-app purchase.
ABOUT BINI GAMES 
Bini Games (ex-Bini Bambini) was started in 2012 by four parents with experience in children's education. And today, we are a 250-people team of dedicated designers, artists, animators, and educators. To date, we have more than 30 apps, with our user base having reached 98M.
We are inspired by the idea of bringing fun into early education and enhancing a child's natural love of learning through educational apps for kids.
If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at:
feedback@bini.games
https://teachdraw.com/

 "Auto" mode 
- Erase similar pixels automatically.

- Smart and easy to use, users just need to select part of the object and the edge detection algorithm will find the boundary.

- A regular brush tool with the capability to adjust its size, hardness and opacity.
#Add Background Photo - Remove & Change your photo background
 it's very important to make a picture's background transparent accurately
if you want to superimpose photos and make good composite photos.

bluejetty:00065989:ios.description:
Create a brighter future…underground! Take on your role as Overseer in this base-building and post-apocalyptic simulation game from the Fallout franchise. Build the perfect vault under 2,000 feet of bedrock. Manage your Dwellers, explore the hostile Wasteland, and defend your base against radioactive threats.
Lead Dwellers on the quest to true happiness as you expand your vault. Outfit your Dwellers with specialized gear, help them find ideal jobs, and train them to improve S.P.E.C.I.A.L. abilities. Play matchmaker to repopulate your underground fortress. Protect your Dwellers from the dangers of the Wasteland as you oversee your thriving community.
Send Dwellers above ground on quests to explore the blasted surface that was left behind. Find adventure, search for life above, and collect survival loot to take back to your vault. 
Unlock new shelter Seasons featuring limited-time vaults. Craft experimental underground vaults, separate from your main vault, for a chance to win Season-specific, in-game rewards.
Download today to take control of your vault and start your underground adventure.
FALLOUT SHELTER FEATURES
BUILD YOUR PERFECT VAULT
- Build a brighter future…underground! You’re in control of a state-of-the-art Vault from Vault-Tec.
- Select from a variety of modern-day rooms to turn an excavation beneath 2,000 feet of bedrock into the very picture of underground Vault Life.
- Build a Radio Room to recruit new Dwellers or play matchmaker to expand the population.
OVERSEE A THRIVING UNDERGROUND COMMUNITY
- Get to know your Dwellers and lead them to happiness.
- Find their ideal jobs and watch them flourish.
- Provide Dwellers with outfits, weapons, and training to improve S.P.E.C.I.A.L. abilities.
- Customize the look of any Dweller in the Barbershop.
- Prepare your Dwellers to protect against threats from the outside…and within.
EXPLORE THE WASTELAND WITH A VARIETY OF QUESTS
- Send Dwellers on quests above ground to explore the blasted surface left behind.
- Find new armor and weapons, gain experience, and earn Caps.
- Encounter new Dwellers to bring back to your vault.
- Complete missions to earn handy survival loot, or fail and meet unspeakable death...
- Open lunchboxes for a chance to collect Legendary Dwellers, including Lucy MacLean, Sarah Lyons, and Abraham Washington.
Vault-Tec has provided the tools, but the rest is up to you. What are you waiting for? Get started building your Vault today for FREE.
*** App Store Best of 2015 ***
Mobile Game of the Year - 2016 DICE Awards
Winner 2015 Golden Joystick Best Handheld/Mobile Game
“Bethesda's first entry into iOS gaming is awesome. Game of the Week" - TouchArcade 
"Probably the best game of E3 2015” – Gizmodo 
"Fallout Shelter is simple to play and addictive as hell." - GameZone
** Requires iOS 10 or later. Requires at least an iPhone 6S Plus, iPad Air 2, or iPad mini 4 **
This app offers in-app purchases. Please note that you may disable in-app purchasing directly from your device. For more information, visit http://support.apple.com/kb/HT4213.

bluejetty:00119736:ios.description:
The Verifyle app allows you to share files and send messages securely and privately to anyone.
Our patented encryption technology, Cellucrypt®, uses a combination of 6 unique encryption keys for each individual item stored or shared in Verifyle (most other cloud storage apps use a single “master” key).
And this technology happens entirely behind the scenes. All you need to know is your password. Once inside, storing and sharing is as simple as a few taps.
We’ve built an app that is extremely simple to use, yet delivers world-class security... for free.
How it works:
Verifyle automatically creates one-on-one Private Message threads between you and each one of your contacts that you can use to securely share documents and send messages. Inside Verifyle you can also organize your communications into Workspaces, where you can create Workspace Threads (group threads) for sharing documents and messages with one or more Guests related to a specific topic or project. Search for us on YouTube to see Verifyle in action.
Features:
1.) Digital document signing on your mobile device
2.) Cellucrypt® patented encryption key management technology
3.) Biometric authentication
4.) Two-factor authentication
5.) Ability to disable password reset
6.) Real-time streaming encryption (no temporary directories)
7.) Total control permissions system
8.) 5GB storage for free users, 100GB for Pro users
9.) SSL/TLS encryption, HTTP strict transport security and perfect forward secrecy
10.) Verifyle is HIPAA, GDPR, UETA, ESIGN, CSA, FINRA, FERPA, NIST and PCI compliant
11.) Protects files from ransomware
Bulk-access vulnerability? Not with Cellucrypt®.
A lot of cloud-based storage services use master keys to encrypt information in bulk, whereas our unique process, Cellucrypt®, automatically encrypts every single document, thread and note individually.

bluejetty:00042246:ios.summary: Take a photo of any schedule, forward an email or paste a link, and Scoot adds every event to your family calendar. Every morning and evening, everyone gets a reminder of the day's events and what to bring. Grandparents and sitters can even
bluejetty:00042246:ios.description:
Take a photo of any schedule, forward an email or paste a link, and Scoot adds every event to your family calendar. Every morning and evening, everyone gets a reminder of the day's events and what to bring. Grandparents and sitters can even get text reminders without the app.
Families have counted on Scoot since 2019. More than 50,000 people have used it to get out the door on time.
ANY SCHEDULE, ADDED FOR YOU
• Take a photo of a team schedule, school flyer or class calendar
• Forward an email or paste a website link
• Scoot finds the dates, times and details and adds the events for you
• When an imported schedule changes, the affected events are flagged so you can review the update
KNOW WHAT TO BRING
• Morning and evening notifications list everyone's events: "Emma has Soccer Practice at 5:30pm."
• Add a checklist to any event, like shin guards or a library book, and it shows up in the reminder
• Each family member picks their own notification times
TEXT REMINDERS FOR EVERYONE
• Send text message reminders to grandparents, sitters and carpool drivers
• They don't need the app, just a phone number
• They can reply STOP at any time
ONE CALENDAR FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Color-code by family member, then tap a name to see just their events
• Changes sync in real time to everyone's phone and iPad
• Keep events simple: just a date, or a start time with no end time
• Mark events as important or done, and circle the big days
• Shared lists for groceries, packing and chores
KEEP THE CALENDARS YOU ALREADY USE
• See your work, school and personal calendars alongside Scoot
• Import their events into Scoot, or keep them separate
MAKE IT YOURS
• Colorful themes and gradient event colors, mixing up to 3 colors
• Choose how big events look on the calendar
• Home screen widgets show today and tomorrow at a glance
FREE AND FULL VERSION
The shared calendar and morning and evening notifications are free. The Full Version subscription unlocks schedule imports from photos, emails and websites, text reminders, lists, themes, widgets, search, quick add, calendar sync and no ads.
