bluejetty:00168482:ios.summary: Cash Advance - Wehi Cash helps you explore instant cash advance options and make informed borrowing decisions without pressure. If you need flexibility and clarity, the app lets you Borrow Money Instantly by guiding you through available ch
bluejetty:00168482:ios.description:
Cash Advance - Wehi Cash helps you explore instant cash advance options and make informed borrowing decisions without pressure. If you need flexibility and clarity, the app lets you Borrow Money Instantly by guiding you through available choices in a simple, transparent way.
Instead of guessing how much to request, you answer a short questionnaire and receive recommendations designed to support responsible borrowing. Whether you are comparing an instant cash advance or reviewing a payday cash advance, Wehi Cash focuses on helping you understand the numbers before you move forward.
For many users, the goal is not just speed, but confidence. That is why Wehi Cash combines loan matching with education, so you can Borrow Money Instantly while staying in control.
What You Can Do with Wehi Cash
• Find loan matches quickly – Complete a short form and review potential instant cash advance and payday cash advance offers in just minutes.
• Get smart amount guidance - Based on your answers, the app suggests a reasonable cash advance range to help avoid borrowing more than you need.
• Compare before deciding - See estimated APRs, fees, repayment timelines, and total cost clearly laid out.
• Move forward on your terms - There is no obligation to accept an offer, even if you choose to Borrow Money Instantly.
Why People Use Wehi Cash
• No credit check performed by Wehi Cash
• No fees to view matched offers
• Clear and practical experience for everyday financial needs
• Secure data handling with modern encryption
• Built for people who want to Borrow Money Instantly with better understanding
Additional Features
• Smart Tips - Short educational cards explaining how a payday cash advance works, how repayment impacts credit health, and how to avoid common mistakes.
• Loan Education – Easy explanations to help you understand cash advance terms, repayment habits, and long-term effects.
• Simple Navigation - Clean screens designed so you can Borrow Money Instantly without confusion or financial jargon.
Important Information
Wehi Cash is a loan matching platform. When you select an offer, you complete the process directly with a third-party provider. Loan availability, payday cash advance terms, and amounts depend on your profile and state regulations.
APR ranges for financial products available through the Wehi Cash app may be up to 35%.

小编精心总结优质书籍内容，分享给热爱读书的你，带你领阅每一本书籍的精彩，高效、高质地吸收内容精华，陪伴你10天读完一本书。

行业顶尖知名导师分享专业干货技能，助力快速成长。
课程涵盖：升职加薪、变美变瘦、人文社科、精致女性成长、家庭亲子教育、生活美学、高效成长等各领域，全方位提升个人品质。

搜罗全网精品有声书畅快听，热门书籍享不停。
- 书目类别包括都市情感、世情社会、历史军事、悬疑推理、古风武侠、儿童文学、科幻奇幻、传奇探险等。

- 知名作家：刘慈欣、顾西爵、刘震云、陈忠实、王姁睿、严歌苓、张宏杰、迟子建、王安忆等。
【优质十点号】
关注导师、主播、好友的十点号，精彩动态不可错过。

bluejetty:00163760:ios.description:
The TD Authenticate™ app is a Two-Step Verification method for your EasyWeb®, WebBroker® or TD Business Central™ Canadian online banking applications.  
Simply download the app and follow the registration process to connect your account and device to the TD Authenticate app.
Once you've registered, you can generate a security verification code in the TD Authenticate app while online or offline (not connected to Wi-Fi or a mobile network), without the need for texts or phone calls.
This confirms it's really you accessing your EasyWeb, WebBroker or TD Business Central online banking.
The TD Authenticate app is for use with EasyWeb, WebBroker and TD Business Central. For other TD apps or digital platforms, please use the Two-Step Verification services they provide. We are working on enhancing the TD Authenticate app, as well as onboarding new businesses and platforms within TD. 
Note: Text or Voice One Time Passcode is required to register for the TD Authenticate app on your device.
By tapping "Get", you consent to the installation of the TD Authenticate™ app* and any future updates that can perform the functions described. The TD Authenticate app is for use by customers with an active EasyWeb®, WebBroker®, and/or TD Business Central™ online banking profile. You may withdraw your consent at any time by removing your device from the list of registered devices under Password & Security within the applicable online banking profile.
*Provided by The TD Bank Group which includes The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its affiliates, who provide deposit, investment, loan, securities, trust, insurance and other products or services.

bluejetty:00175050:ios.name: Dashlane Password Manager
bluejetty:00175050:ios.summary: Dashlane is more than just a password manager. It's automated protection that stays on guard, so you don't have to. Dashlane actively monitors for password leaks and scams so you can browse with total confidence. Whether you're at home or o
bluejetty:00175050:ios.description:
Dashlane is more than just a password manager. It's automated protection that stays on guard, so you don't have to. Dashlane actively monitors for password leaks and scams so you can browse with total confidence. Whether you're at home or on the go, it provides worry-free access to your accounts anywhere you need it.
Trusted and recognized: PCWorld 2025 "Best Password Manager," PC Mag "Editors' Choice Award," Webby Award "People's Voice Best Mobile Services & Utilities App," Kiplinger's "Best Identity Theft Prevention Tools," Inc.com's "Best for Passwords and Checkouts," and Techlicious "The Best Security Apps."
Get effortless and secure password management
- Skip the typing: Dashlane identifies and instantly fills your saved logins, credit cards, and sensitive personal info, including driver's licenses and government IDs, across apps and browsers. You can even securely store and access your Wi-Fi network details in an instant.
- Get alerted when your data is involved in a breach: We scan the dark web for your data and alert you if your information is found in a leak.
- Take control of your password health: Track your security status with a personalized Password Health score and get actionable steps to strengthen weak, reused, or compromised passwords.
- Avoid getting locked out: Sync your passwords, passkeys, and personal info across an unlimited number of devices and operating systems.
- Stay organized: Group your logins and data into custom categories with Collections.
- Share safely: Effortlessly share passwords and Secure Notes with family or friends without exposing your credentials.
- Generate new passwords effortlessly: Create and save unique, random, and complex passwords for every account in a single tap with Dashlane's built-in Password Generator.
- Keep your most important files handy: Securely encrypt and store important documents, IDs, and receipts directly within your Secure Notes.
- Simplify your security: Generate and easily find your OTP (one-time password) and 2FA codes directly within Dashlane for all your 2FA-protected accounts.
Stay protected, without staying on high alert
- Get personalized security recommendations: "For You" is a dedicated space for security advice and actionable steps tailored to your digital footprint.
- Stay ahead of phishing attempts: Vault phishing alerts appear when you try to autofill or copy and paste login info on a suspicious site or an app not associated with your account, ensuring you only share info with sites you trust.
- Keep your data private: Dashlane's zero-knowledge security architecture means your information is encrypted on your device and never visible to us.
- Protect your personal data on public Wi-Fi networks: Browse privately with a VPN (virtual private network), provided in partnership with Hotspot Shield.
Note: all features listed above require a Dashlane Premium or Friends & Family plan subscription. Some limitations may apply.
Join the millions who stay secure with our proactive password protection.

bluejetty:00099150:ios.summary:
Welcome to Farm Block Escape! 
The ultimate mix of cozy countryside charm and brainy challenge where every puzzle helps adorable farm animals break free and every move sparks joy. Slide, unblock, and rescue your furry and feathery friends
bluejetty:00099150:ios.description:
Welcome to Farm Block Escape! 
The ultimate mix of cozy countryside charm and brainy challenge where every puzzle helps adorable farm animals break free and every move sparks joy. Slide, unblock, and rescue your furry and feathery friends in a soothing world of logic and strategy.
A Farm Full of Puzzles, A Game Full of Heart
The barnyard is in chaos! The animals are trapped and only you can help. From sneaky cats and curious chickens to playful pigs , each creature has a quirky personality and each puzzle is a new opportunity to set them free.
Whether you’re into brain teaser games, block puzzles, or simply relaxing games that give your mind space to breathe, Farm Block Escape offers a soothing escape filled with smart fun and colorful satisfaction.
Why You’ll Love Farm Block Escape:
● Adorable Characters – Slide pigs, cats, chickens, and more through tight spots!
● Hundreds of Satisfying Levels – Easy to learn, hard to master, always delightful.
● Smart Mechanics – Explore new layouts, obstacles, and logic-based designs.
● No Rush, No Stress – Play at your own pace and enjoy pure puzzle joy.
● Offline Play Supported – Farm your brainpower anytime, anywhere.
● Aesthetic Country Vibes – Immerse in cozy visuals and gentle sounds.
Block Puzzle With a Twist!
Farm Block Escape draws inspiration from beloved gamesbut adds its own cozy personality. With no countdown clocks and no forced rush, it offers the perfect combination of focus, creativity, and calm. Whether you’re clearing blocks, sliding animals, or unlocking new challenges, you’ll find something refreshingly different here.
Perfect for All Ages
Whether you're a casual gamer, a strategy fan, or a parent looking for a safe, educational option for kids this game is designed for every age and every level. It’s intuitive for beginners and satisfying for pros.
As you slide each block into place, you’ll experience the satisfaction of solving without stress.
Every completed level is a small achievement a quiet reward for your brain and mood.
Who Is This Game For?
● Puzzle lovers seeking something cute, calm, and clever
● Fans of block puzzle games, relaxing logic games, and brain training
● Players who enjoy offline puzzle games and stress-free gameplay
● Animal lovers who enjoy lighthearted, cozy themes
● Anyone looking for a delightful way to pass time mindfully
Features at a Glance:
● Satisfying puzzle gameplay with intuitive controls
● A farm-themed logic escape that blends fun and focus
● Relaxing music and ASMR-inspired feedback
● Designed for mindful gameplay no rush, no pressure
● Great for brain games lovers of all ages
● Offline puzzle mode perfect for travel, breaks, and bedtime
● Join Thousands of Happy Players
Farm Block Escape is more than just a puzzle game it’s your daily digital retreat. Whether you're playing during a coffee break, on a long commute, or to wind down at bedtime, you'll always find something rewarding in every tap.
Ready to become the hero of the barnyard?
Download now and start sliding your way to freedom. Let the animals roam free and let your mind unwind.

bluejetty:00180159:ios.name: Coordinates – GPS Converter
bluejetty:00180159:ios.summary: Coordinates is a powerful and user-friendly tool for anyone working with geographic locations — from travelers and surveyors to engineers and GIS professionals. Instantly view, convert, and manage coordinates in a wide range of global forma
bluejetty:00180159:ios.description:
Coordinates is a powerful and user-friendly tool for anyone working with geographic locations — from travelers and surveyors to engineers and GIS professionals. Instantly view, convert, and manage coordinates in a wide range of global formats and datums, all within a clean and intuitive interface. Whether in the field or at the desk, Coordinates is your all-in-one solution for precise location work.
# User-friendly Design 
Your current location is displayed at the intersection of two grey lines, with clear latitude and longitude readouts. You can manually set the location using map taps, coordinate input, or place search. 
Intuitive buttons give quick access to measurement tools, map layers, location bookmarking, shape drawing, and annotation — all from a clean, compact interface.
# Various Coordinate Formats
Supports formats like UTM, MGRS, Georef, and more alongside Longitude/Latitude.
# Batch Converter 
Quickly convert multiple coordinates or files in one streamlined action.
# Rich Object Details 
Add notes, photos, and media to any saved object — pins, shapes, or measurements — to keep your data organized and context-rich. Easily share your saved content across devices using backup and export tools.
# Datum Conversion
Transform coordinates using EPSG, ESRI, and IAU2000 references. Supports X/Y, geodetic, and projected systems.
# PROJ.4 Calculator 
Convert coordinates between systems using the PROJ.4 library, with support for datum shifting and custom projections.
# Navigation & Tracking
Real-time bearing and distance updates are provided with a large coordinate readout, ideal for on-the-field usage.
# Speedometer 
Track your current speed in real time.
# Unit Converter
Convert 40+ units (distance, pressure, radiation, etc.)
# Signal Board
Send big bold messages on-screen
# Elevation Support
Altitude data is available for land areas
# Import / Export
- .gpx .geojson .kml file supported
# Distance, Bearing & Area
Mark points or draw lines to measure distance, bearings, and area.
# Offline Map Tiles
Download tiles for offline use. Pick a city or define your own area.
# Custom Map Tile Selector
Choose from Apple Maps, OSM, or add your own tile server with {z}/{x}/{y} format.
# Supported Input / Output #

bluejetty:00080556:ios.description:
Find people who want to go where you want to go and do the things on your bucket list.
Fairytrail is a friend-making app for people who love travel and adventure. Meet travelers nearby or around the world, discover things to do, save adventures to your bucket list, and connect with people who want to experience them too.
Over 5 million connections have been made on Fairytrail.
FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Meet solo travelers, digital nomads, backpackers, expats, and adventurous locals. Search by location, destination, interests, travel style, and more to discover people you actually have something in common with.
BUILD A SHARED BUCKET LIST
Discover activities and travel ideas from the community, save the ones you love, or create your own.
See who else has the same adventure on their bucket list and turn “we should do this someday” into an actual plan.
CHAT AROUND AN ADVENTURE
Every activity can bring people together. Join activity group chats, message your connections, coordinate meetups, and make plans with people who are excited about the same things you are.
TRAVEL FRIENDS, NOT JUST MATCHES
Fairytrail is built around friendships and shared experiences.
Find someone to:
• Explore a new city with
• Go hiking or sightseeing
• Grab coffee while traveling solo
• Join you on an adventure
• Meet up in your next destination
• Become part of your global circle of friends
A MORE GENUINE COMMUNITY
Fairytrail combines AI-driven fraud detection, verification, image recognition, human moderation, and community reporting to help keep the community authentic.
You can also control your discovery preferences, privacy, blocking, and reporting directly from the app.
KEEP YOUR TRAVEL STORY
Your adventures don’t end when the trip does. Keep memories and moments of kindness in your Fairytrail Notebook, exchange virtual postcards, and stay connected with friends you meet around the world.
Travel creates better stories when you have someone to share them with.
Find your next adventure and the people to experience it with on Fairytrail.
If verification cost is a barrier, contact team@fairytrail.app to ask about assistance.
Website: https://www.fairytrail.app
Terms & Privacy Policy: https://www.fairytrail.app/terms/

3. "Fluency Calculator - Measurement of Stuttering" provides the following results:
* SPM: Number of Syllables Per Minutes
* SWPM: Number of Stuttered Words Per Minutes
* %SS: Percentage of Stuttered Syllables 
4. A Settings screen: user can customize almost everything: Change button to any colors by Color Picker, vibrate or highlight when touching.

6. SHAKE to PAUSE without touching button

- Easy browsing
- Fast search

- Save time

Play the hidden object game and enjoy the spirit of Christmas! Immerse yourself in a magical puzzle adventure full of сhristmas mysteries, hidden objects, and unsolved puzzles. Seek objects and find hidden clues to solve the mysterious tale of Santa's toy factory!
Can you solve the unsolved mystery of Christmas Stories: The Legend of Toymakers? In this exciting mystery hidden object game, you’ll travel through Santa’s factory, restore сhristmas toys, and uncover the secrets of a powerful magic that threatens to erase Christmas forever. Seek objects and find hidden objects to gather clues and solve the puzzles blocking your way!
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects christmas game.

On the day he comes of age, Fizzy the Elf receives a magical tool and the position of junior toy maker. However, due to a series of unfortunate events, he drops the magical tool and discovers its power in the factory basement. This ancient magic has awakened long-dormant evil forces. Can Fizzy resist the sinister power that wants to destroy Christmas forever?
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED AT THE TOY FACTORY
Seek objects through fairy tale settings in Santa’s workshop and investigate the cause behind the malfunction of toys. Solve mini-games, search for christmas hidden objects, and traces of dark magic. Will you crack the mystery in this santa adventure?
DISCOVER HOW TO SAVE CHRISTMAS FROM THE EVIL MAGIC
Fizzy learns the secrets behind the origins of Christmas mysteries and the history of the elves. Join him on a quest to restore the magic of Christmas, seek objects, and defeat the evil forces that threaten the holiday season. Solve puzzles and unravel unsolved clues as you journey to save Christmas from an impending disaster!
VISIT CATSTOWN AND RESTORE ORDER
Play as Sugarplum the Elf, Santa's reindeer herder, and explore a fairy tale Christmas quest. Travel to Catstown and solve an unsolved mystery that connects to missing сhristmas reindeer. Prepare for an exciting santa adventure filled with hidden objects, puzzles, and surprises!
Christmas Stories: The Legend of Toymakers is a mystery hidden object game where you will seek objects and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth. Explore hidden object scenes, enjoy replayable hidden object puzzles (HOPs), and engage in mini-games.
Unveil the unsolved Christmas mysteries in a world filled with holiday cheer and thrilling challenges. Be the detective and find out who is behind the magic that is threatening to erase Christmas!
Enjoy exciting puzzles, replayable HOPs, and exclusive bonus content like wallpapers, soundtrack, and concept art. Zoom in on scenes to help find hidden objects, and use hints if you get stuck. Get ready for an christmas puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00129672:ios.description:
Home Garden Lulu is a cozy greenhouse simulator in kawaii and forest style. In this game you can create a beautiful garden with frogs, rare flowers and plants.
What you can do in this game:
* Learn the history of each frog and collect a unique album with illustrations
* Play cute mini-games about making coffee, smoothies, watering plants, fish pond, flower bouquets.
* Complete unique achievements and daily tasks (Collection section)
* Discover +250 plants and study the herbarium book
* Open 5 rooms in the greenhouse and +500 decorations
* Enjoy the peaceful music and atmosphere of the garden
Turn your greenhouse into a cute and favorite home for frogs by decorating the interior with beautiful items:
*Greenhouse
You can grow many rare plants in your greenhouse. The more flowers in your greenhouse, the bigger your herbarium book becomes, where you can learn plant care tips. Each flower gives you 15 coins every 12 hours.
* Cafe
All the frogs in your greenhouse love warm and flavorful coffee and smoothies. Make the frogs happy with your wonderful drinks! Remember that new recipes are given for completing daily tasks :3
*Lulu's House
Lulu the frog loves the fish in her garden, but sometimes garbage gets into the lake. Take care of the fish and nature in Lulu's garden.
*Flower Shop
In your small but cozy flower store you can grow and make bouquets for customers according to your taste. You can grow many wonderful flowers: roses, cornflowers, sunflowers, chrysanthemums, lavender, carnations.
*Cinema
In the movie theater, you can give movie screenings to the frogs, and earn rewards in the vintage slot machine
Home Garden Lulu is a free offline game, but some game elements, such as income boosts and in-game currency, can be purchased with real money. The game has subscriptions. Please read the EULA requirement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Astrology by date of birth is the key to predicting your future based on the ancient wisdom of Veda, as it takes the year, time, and place of birth into account to draw the exact birth chart. KNVBC is where you'll find a blend of music meticulously selected to maintain a conservative tone without the influence of rock and contemporary Christian music (CCM).
Why Choose KNVBC?
• Live Radio 24/7: Tune in to non-stop, Christ-honoring Christian music and broadcasts that uplift your spirit throughout the day.

• Win Exclusive Merchandise: Participate in contests and activities to win KNVBC merchandise.

• Stream live conservative Christian music and on-demand preaching effortlessly.

• Stay connected with other KNVBC listeners and the North Valley Baptist Church.
Join the KNVBC Radio Family:
Be part of a growing family that cherishes good music and Bible messages. The KNVBC app offers more than just listening—it's an interactive experience where you connect with a community that shares your values for traditional Christian music and values.
Optimized for Your Lifestyle:
• User-friendly interface for easy navigation.
• Quick and easy access to both live and on-demand content.
Support & Feedback:
• Your feedback drives continuous improvement of the KNVBC app. Contact us within the app for support or suggestions.
Download the KNVBC Christian Radio app today and bring uplifting Christian radio into your daily life!
KNVBC is a ministry of North Valley Baptist Church in Santa Clara, CA ~ Dr. Jack Trieber, Pastor.

If you are a word game fan, try this challenge, take the quizze
bluejetty:00073366:ios.description:
A new simple and fun word game emerges as a word trivia family game! Test your general knowledge, vocabulary, intelligence, and ingenuity with a relaxing design and gameplay. 
If you are a word game fan, try this challenge, take the quizzes, and discover Popular Words. Find out the most popular answers to short everyday questions in life. Hours and hours of fun are guaranteed with this simple and addictive word trivia game! Get everyone's heads up in your family and ready to play this engaging family game of guessing words to fill in the blanks.
Your awareness of your daily routine will also increase with games for family. Additionally, researchers have found that adults who regularly solved word puzzles and trivia games requiring familiarity with a more extensive vocabulary might have better brain function later in life.
Popular Words is inspired by the TV shows such as America Says, Family Feud, and Jeopardy. You have to guess what most people say to certain questions. Each level presents a fill-in-the-blank question and five possible answers. There would be several correct answers, but you have to find the most common 5 of them whose first letters are shown to give players a hint. Blank length indicates the length of the correct word. If you like headbands games, people games and guess the word games you will enjoy this fun word trivia game too.
FEATURES
• Hundreds of unique questions, thousands of word challenges. 
• Free Daily challenges and bonus rewards.
• Simple & easy to play. Autocorrect system to help players in typing the answers.
• Level list to allow players to gain rewards for the completed chapters. 
• Leaderboards to compete with others.
• Completely free to play word trivia. Guess up now!
• Boost brain functions and improve memory.
• Train your brain with addicting trivia games free to play.
• Enjoy fun family games and show games with family and friends.
• Test your knowledge and enjoy hours of entertainment with this trivia quiz game for the whole family.
Gather your family and friends to play this word party game and recreate the popular TV shows in your house. Make the social gatherings exciting again! If you enjoy trivia quiz games and show games, bring your friends together and guess their answers in this fun trivia game for free.
Popular Words is developed by the creators of fan-favorite word games such as Word Pearls and Brain Test. Enjoy the next iteration of our rapidly expanding word game library. 
Download for free now and start playing to have limitless fun, improve your knowledge, enhance your brain functions and discover yourself.

bluejetty:00073686:ios.name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland
bluejetty:00073686:ios.summary:
Characters inspired by Disney villains weave wicked schoolyard schemes in this magical adventure featuring rhythm games and RPG-style battles!
■Concept, main story, and character designs by Yana Toboso (Original creator of "Black Butler")
bluejetty:00073686:ios.description:
Characters inspired by Disney villains weave wicked schoolyard schemes in this magical adventure featuring rhythm games and RPG-style battles!
■Concept, main story, and character designs by Yana Toboso (Original creator of "Black Butler")
SUMMARY
Perhaps there's more to "villains" than meets the eye...
Summoned by a magic mirror to Twisted Wonderland, a world altogether unlike your own, you arrive at Night Raven College, a prestigious arcane academy.
With nowhere else to go, you accept the masked headmaster's hospitality and begin searching for a way home.
You quickly find that the students of this school are as talented as they are dysfunctional—bickering and competition are the perpetual order of the day.
Will you be able to work with them and eventually return from whence you came?
And what secrets lie within the villainous hearts of these students?
■Enjoy simple turn-based battles and rhythm games!
GAME OVERVIEW
You will take History of Magic, Alchemy, and Flight classes alongside the students of Night Raven College.
As you dig deeper into your studies, you will unlock more of the story, which has gameplay divided into three parts:
—Story segments, in which you advance through the tale of Twisted Wonderland
—Battles, in which characters fight by slinging spells
—Twistunes, in which you play a rhythm game and tap along to the music
A deliciously dark and enchanting drama awaits you.
■Featuring characters and dorms inspired by classic Disney movies!
Night Raven College has seven dorms, each of which is home to unique characters:
Heartslabyul Dorm—Twisted from Alice in Wonderland
Savanaclaw Dorm—Twisted from The Lion King
Octavinelle Dorm—Twisted from The Little Mermaid
Scarabia Dorm—Twisted from Aladdin
Pomefiore Dorm—Twisted from Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
Ignihyde Dorm—Twisted from Hercules
Diasomnia Dorm—Twisted from Sleeping Beauty
STAFF
Concept, main story, and character designs: Yana Toboso
Supported by SQUARE ENIX
Development and management: f4samurai
Logo, user interface, emblem, and icon design: Wataru Osakabe
Backgrounds: Atelier Musa
Planning and distribution: Aniplex
Music: Takumi Ozawa
Opening animation: TROYCA
Audio production: HALF H-P STUDIO
RECOMMENDED DEVICES
iPhone 6s or later, iPad Air (third generation) or later, iPad mini (fifth generation or later), iPad Pro (first generation or later)
Note 1: Please use the above-listed recommendations rather than what is listed on the App Store.
Note 2: Please be aware that we will not be able to provide support or compensation to players using devices other than our recommended devices.

bluejetty:00015984:ios.name: Aparillo
bluejetty:00015984:ios.summary:
The Cinematic Machine
Aparillo is an advanced 16 voice FM synth tailored for complex sound structures , majestic motions, moving and evolving soundscapes and atmospheres that are perfect for film, TV or games.
It‘s not limited to the conve
bluejetty:00015984:ios.description:
The Cinematic Machine
Aparillo is an advanced 16 voice FM synth tailored for complex sound structures , majestic motions, moving and evolving soundscapes and atmospheres that are perfect for film, TV or games.
It‘s not limited to the conventional fm sounds but also delivers a huge range of styles from basses to brasses, pads to leads to even percussion.
••• SYNTH •••
It is based on two interacting FM Synthesizers capable of forming the most complex timbres. A clever arrangement of synthesis, wave shaping, filtering, FX and modulation unfolds into a serious sound design tool for epic sonic creation. Aparillo uses many parameters that can be modulated for individual adjustments PER voice. Each of the sixteen voices interact with almost two dozen targets in a variety of ways for a continuous transformation and to create endless rhythms and melodic progressions.
••• FX •••
The integrated effects include a free-signalflow Filter/Spacial Comb device, a polyphonic Auto Pan with multiple waveforms, the obligatory Delay, our finest Reverb algorithm, and a Sugar Bytes innovation, the Spacializer. This is a very special breed of delay based effect, which can work as a delay, reverb or tuned comb filter and can add room, plucked strings or even pinged percussion to your sound.
••• ORBITER •••
The superstar of Aparillo is the Orbiter, an instinctual "mass-controller" you move through Aparillo's endless sonic universes for one-touch sound morphing. That finally gives you unlimited control over new grounds of sound manipulation. Aparillo for iPad will seamlessly integrate with your mobile studio setup. 
We built in MIDI support (Virtual, Network, External, Bluetooth), Audio Unit v3 and Ableton Link. 
Syncing your presets to use them accross other devices couldn't be easier with iCloud. 
Enjoy Aparillo, the more you dig into it the more you fall in love with it!
Features:
• Standalone & Audio Unit v3
• FM Synthesizer with 16 Voices
• Formant Shifting, Wave Folding & Shifting
• Multi-Mode Filter with Spacializer
• Orbiter for one-touch Sound Morphing
• 500 handpicked Presets
• Ableton Link Support
• Full MIDI Support (Virtual, Network, External, Bluetooth), MIDI Learn & Host Automation
• Preset iCloud Sync
• Preset Share

bluejetty:00136362:ios.description:
A fresh, healthy take on grocery shopping just got easier with our updated Sprouts Farmers Market app!
Browse your neighborhood store’s amazing array of better-for-you groceries, from responsibly sourced meat and seafood and farm-fresh produce to unique Sprouts Brand discoveries and a huge variety of vitamins and supplements, you’ll find everything you need to find your healthy at an incredible value. Plus, you can browse or filter your product selection—from organic and plant-based to gluten-free and keto-friendly, there’s something for every dietary preference.
Simply login to view the latest specials and build a personalized shopping list, then clip scan and save even more with digital coupons.
See What’s on Sale
Save big every week with Weekly Ad savings, exclusive promotions and digital coupons.
Clip, Scan & Save More
To redeem your “clipped” coupons simply scan your Sprouts account barcode at checkout. With product look-up, find out if there’s a qualifying digital coupon or add the item to your list.

bluejetty:00015042:ios.description:
Early Reading with Live Letters: Fun Alphabet and Number Learning App for Kids!
Introduce your child to the magic of early reading with fun letter games for kids to learn their ABCs. This engaging app, featuring smiling and playful Live Letters, makes learning an exciting and joyful adventure!
Interactive Learning with Funny Alphabet Characters
Meet our silly, animated letters who keep your child entertained and engaged. These characters star in delightful animations and scenes, making letter writing practice for kids and memorizing the alphabet fun and easy.
Comprehensive Early Childhood Education App
With over 400 fun learning games for preschool, your child will explore letters, syllables, and words through expertly designed content. From recognizing letters to reading independently, each step is a fun-filled educational journey.
ABC Learning Path & Early Spelling Games
Our structured, step-by-step ABC learning path guides your child from basic alphabet recognition to reading full words. Engage in playful early spelling games and enjoy entertaining scenarios that effortlessly build foundational literacy skills.
Learn First Words with Pictures and Sounds
Children develop vocabulary quickly through our interactive first-word activities, enriched with colorful animations and funny scenarios that aid memorization and comprehension.
Multilingual Fun
Perfect for multilingual families, the app offers a variety of languages, enabling your child to explore and learn beyond their native language.
Why Parents Trust Live Letters:
Child-safe app for early learning
Letter writing practice for kids
Enjoy offline games anytime, anywhere
Alphabet flash cards, tracing, spelling, and word games
Completely ad-free, a trusted toddler app with no ads experience
Comprehensive alphabet and phonics content
Engaging animations suitable for preschool and home learning
Transform early reading into an adventure filled with laughter and learning .Live Letters make learning the alphabet irresistibly fun!
Please note: only part of the content in the screenshots is available in the free version of the app. To gain access to all app content, you need to make an in-app purchase.
ABOUT BINI GAMES
Bini Games (ex-Bini Bambini) was started in 2012 by four parents with experience in children's education. And today, we are a 250-people team of dedicated designers, artists, animators, and educators. To date, we have more than 30 apps, with our user base having reached 98M.
We are inspired by the idea of bringing fun into early education and enhancing a child's natural love of learning through educational apps for kids.
If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at feedback@bini.games
http://teachdraw.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00091756:ios.description:
Neighborly®: Your Hub for Home Services™
Find, book, and manage trusted home services in one simple app. The Neighborly App is your all-in-one home services hub, designed to help homeowners take care of their house, repairs, cleaning, and maintenance with confidence and ease.
From everyday home cleaning to specialized repairs, Neighborly connects you to reliable local professionals through a network of well-known service brands — all in one place.
Why Choose the Neighborly App
Managing your home shouldn’t be complicated. Neighborly makes it easy to discover, schedule, and book home services without the stress of searching, calling, or comparing endless options.
With the Neighborly App, you can:
• Simplify home care with all services in one app 
• Hire with confidence using trusted local professionals 
• Save time with quick booking and job tracking 
• Stay ahead with smart reminders and seasonal checklists 
• Stay organized with records, documents, and exclusive offers
Whether it’s routine maintenance or a last-minute fix, Neighborly helps you get the job done right.
Home Services by Trusted Brands
Neighborly makes it easy to find the right service — delivered by a brand that specializes in exactly what your home needs.
• Molly Maid® – Professional house cleaning and recurring home maintenance
• Mr. Handyman® – General home repairs, installations, and maintenance services
• Mr. Electric® – Residential electrical services, repairs, and upgrades
• Mr. Rooter Plumbing® – Plumbing and drain services, repairs, and maintenance
• Mr. Appliance® – Appliance repair and maintenance for major home appliances
• Aire Serv® – Heating and cooling services, including AC and furnace care
• Five Star Painting® – Interior and exterior house painting services
• Glass Doctor® – Glass repair and replacement for home and property
• Lawn Pride® – Lawn care and maintenance services
• The Grounds Guys® – Landscaping and outdoor property services
• Mosquito Joe® – Pest and mosquito control for outdoor spaces
• Junk King® – Junk removal and hauling services
• Precision Door Service® – Garage door repair and installation
• Rainbow Restoration® – Restoration services for water, fire, and mold damage
• ShelfGenie® – Custom storage and organization solutions
• Window Genie® – Window cleaning, pressure washing, and exterior services
• Dryer Vent Wizard® – Dryer vent cleaning and safety services
• HouseMaster® – Home inspections and property evaluations
• Real Property Management™ – Property management services
• Portland Glass® – Residential glass services and replacement
All services are delivered by professionals from Neighborly’s family of trusted brands — giving you confidence from booking to completion.
How It Works
Getting help for your home is simple:
1. Find the home service you need
2. Choose a trusted brand or professional
3. Schedule and book your service in just a few taps
4. Track your appointment from start to finish
5. Never miss a reminder with your checklist
6. Save and organize home documents
7. Enjoy peace of mind knowing your home is in good hands
What Homeowners Are Saying
5 Stars - “Great service: Best way I have found for all my home services when needed" 
5 Stars - “Great Services: Excellent way to find high quality providers of just about anything you need done around your home or business.”
About Neighborly
Neighborly is a leading home services company dedicated to helping people care for their homes with confidence. For decades, Neighborly and its family of brands have supported homeowners by providing reliable home services, professional expertise, and a better way to manage life at home.
Our mission is simple: make home care easier, more accessible, and more trustworthy — all through one powerful app.
Get Started Today
Take control of your home with one easy-to-use app.
Download the Neighborly App and experience a smarter way to manage your home services, cleaning, and repairs.
Service availability may vary by location.

bluejetty:00068499:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068499:ios.description:
fotocasa, find your place among more than 1,5M properties.
The online real estate portal where you can find the perfect home. If you want to buy a flat or house, look for rental properties or share a room, this app is for you. With our app you can easily find the flat, flat, house, room, office, garage, storage room or land that best suits your needs, because "everyone has a place".
◉ SORT YOUR FAVORITES WITH THE NEW LISTS 
New functionality alert! Fotocasa launches in exclusive the Wishlist, a new feature to help you organise better your favorite flats or houses and help you while apartment hunting. You can also share the lists of favorite homes with your loved ones and thus find your future home in a more comfortable and simple way.
◉ A HOME FINDER FOR EVERYONE
If you are looking to buy or rent a property, fotocasa offers you the largest real estate offer of properties in Spain, with more than 1.5 million properties at your disposal.
You can search by province, municipality, neighbourhood, points of interest or proximity to your current location, you can even draw on the map the exact area where you want to find properties. The results will appear in the form of a list or on a map, from which you can see all the available properties.
Find detailed information about the available properties: photos, characteristics, how to get to the property, energy certification level, extras, etc. Apply filters to your search to refine your search even more and find exactly what you are looking for in the quickest way.
> Transaction: Rent, buy, share, rent to buy, rent to own, etc.
> Type of property: Housing, new construction, premises, garage, office, etc.
> Type of property: Apartment, attic, semi-detached house, chalet, duplex, studio, loft, flat, ground floor, etc.
> Price.
> Number of rooms.
> Bathrooms.
> Surface area (m²).
> Extras of the property.
> Condition of the property.
◉ EXPRESS VISIT, THE NEW WAY TO FIND A FLAT OR HOUSE
We combine the best of in-person and virtual visits in the new Fotocasa Express Visit: a guided virtual visit with which you will save time in your search, you will be able to make a more efficient selection and, moreover, without leaving your home.
Fotocasa Express Visit, remote, guided and quick visits.
◉ MORTGAGE CALCULATOR
You can now make a mortgage calculation for the property you like the most, with the new mortgage simulator available in the fotocasa app.
Choose your mortgage conditions for your flat or house and obtain the payment instalments quickly and easily.
◉ FAVOURITES
Save as favourites those flats, houses and properties that you have liked the most, to keep them close at hand and be aware of any changes that may occur. Consult your favourite searches and ads from any device.
◉ ALERTS
Through the fotocasa app, activate alerts to be notified when ads similar to the searches you have previously made are published. This way you will be able to manage any changes in the properties you have in your favourites.
◉ DIRECT MESSAGES WITH ADVERTISERS
Find your favourite houses and flats, and contact the advertisers directly. Arrange visits to the flats through direct messages and resolve any doubts that may arise.
◉ THE BEST IDEAS FOR DECORATING YOUR HOME
And if all the above is not enough for you, or if you are not considering buying a flat or renting a house at the moment, in the fotocasa blog, which you can access through the same app, you will find lots of home decoration tips, renovations, advice on buying and renting a home and the latest news on the real estate market.
Download our FREE app, rate us and give us your opinion at movil@fotocasa.es

bluejetty:00086658:ios.description:
Нові офіційні тести ПДР України (оригінал) — це актуальна база офіційних тестів 2026 року з Правил дорожнього руху України, затверджених Головним сервісним центром МВС України.
Користуйся додатком навіть коли немає доступу до інтернету! Складай іспит легко та без хабаря! Запитай у викладача ПРОМОКОД, щоб приєднатись до своєї групи в автошколі!
Всі запитання в додатку співпадають на 100% з офіційною базою запитань до іспиту в сервісних центрах МВС України. Оновлення запитань відбувається щодня, як тільки вони оновились в державній базі МВС (НАІС).
З нашим додатком Нові Офіційні тести ви отримуєте доступ до тестів ПДР 2026, теоретичного матеріалу, включаючи відеолекції та пояснення від експертів. Також доступний повний каталог дорожніх знаків України з поясненнями – попереджувальні, заборонні, інформаційно-вказівні, сервісні та інші. Знаки згруповані за категоріями, тож вивчати їх легко та зручно.
ЗАВАНТАЖУЙ додаток Нові Офіційні тести ПДР і БЕЗКОШТОВНО:
- отримуй доступ до більше ніж 2000 актуальних і офіційних запитань для тестів ПДР з бази МВС України, чим підвищуй свої шанси успішно скласти теоретичний іспит з першого разу;
- будь в курсі всіх оновлень в запитаннях — ми повідомляємо про будь-які зміни, оновлення запитань відбувається щодня при завантаженні додатка;
- зможеш склаcти "ІСПИТ" необмежену кількість разів у такому ж режимі, як і при здачі теоретичного іспиту в сервісному центрі (20 хвилин і максимум 2 помилки);
- вивчати теорію легко та зручно: ПДР, дорожні знаки та дорожню розмітку, сигнали регулювальника;
- вивчати офіційні маршрути для практичного водіння.
Цей додаток підходить для кожного, хто прагне самостійно вивчити і пройти офіційні тести ПДР онлайн та успішно скласти теоретичний іспит!
Для ефективного вивчення ПДР і підготовки до здачі іспиту ми підготували набір функцій, які входять до Premium підписки (запитай у свого викладача ПРОМОКОД на знижку):
ВІДЕОЛЕКЦІЇ українською мовою з ПДР 2026
Зрозумілі та доступні відео для легкого вивчення правил від найкращих викладачів України.
РЕЖИМ: ВЧИ ПО ТЕМАХ
Всі запитання з тестів ПДР згруповані по темах, що зручно для закріплення теоретичних знань з правил дорожнього руху.
Можна проходити будь-яку тему необмежену кількість разів.
РЕЖИМ: ТРЕНУЙСЯ ПО БІЛЕТАХ
Дозволяє проходити іспит за схемою: 20 випадкових запитань, без обмежень за кількістю і часом. Окрім правильної відповіді, є пояснення від викладачів.
РОЗДІЛ: НОВІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
У цьому розділі ви знайдете спеціально розроблені нові та цікаві запитання, які допоможуть глибше зрозуміти правила та ще краще підготуватися до реальних ситуацій на дорозі.
МОЇ ПОМИЛКИ
При вивченні матеріалів в додатку ми зберігаємо запитання, з якими виникли проблеми, в окремому розділі.
В будь-який час можна повернутися до цього запитання і детальніше його пропрацювати.
НАЙСКЛАДНІШІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
Ми зібрали найпопулярніші помилки користувачів нашого додатка при проходженні іспиту.
На ці запитання варто звернути увагу і ще раз закріпити знання.
ЗБЕРЕЖЕНІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
Зберігайте запитання, що викликають труднощі.
Ви зможете повернутись до них пізніше й розібратись уважніше у зручний для вас час.
СТАТИСТИКА
Відстежуйте свій прогрес у навчанні:
результати іспитів та правильність відповідей
прогрес по темах і кількість пройдених тестів
збереження статистики протягом дії підписки + 1 місяць
Інтерактивна шкала підкаже, коли ви готові до іспиту в СЦ МВС.
9. ЄДИНИЙ ДОСТУП ДЛЯ ВСІХ ПЛАТФОРМ: реєструйся в додатку або на нашому сайті https://pdr.infotech.gov.ua/ і вивчай теорію та проходь тести з будь-якого пристрою.
10. ОФФЛАЙН ДОСТУП - всі тестові запитання і правила ПДР завантажуються на мобільний пристрій, і доступні до вивчення навіть без доступу до інтернету.
Наш застосунок — це найкращий спосіб вивчити правила дорожнього руху України та скласти іспит у СЦ МВС з першого разу. 
Ми готові допомогти тобі у підготовці до іспиту. Якщо у тебе є питання, зв'яжися з нами через кнопку Підтримка в додатку або напиши нам: team@testpdr.com

ЗАВАНТАЖУЙ додаток Нові Офіційні тести ПДР і БЕЗКОШТОВНО:
- отримуй доступ до більше ніж 2000 актуальних і офіційних запитань для тестів ПДР з бази МВС України, чим підвищуй свої шанси успішно скласти теоретичний іспит з першого разу;
- будь в курсі всіх оновлень в запитаннях — ми повідомляємо про будь-які зміни, оновлення запитань відбувається щодня при завантаженні додатка;
- зможеш склаcти "ІСПИТ" необмежену кількість разів у такому ж режимі, як і при здачі теоретичного іспиту в сервісному центрі (20 хвилин і максимум 2 помилки);
- вивчати теорію легко та зручно: ПДР, дорожні знаки та дорожню розмітку, сигнали регулювальника;
- вивчати офіційні маршрути для практичного водіння.

Цей додаток підходить для кожного, хто прагне самостійно вивчити і пройти офіційні тести ПДР онлайн та успішно скласти теоретичний іспит!
Для ефективного вивчення ПДР і підготовки до здачі іспиту ми підготували набір функцій, які входять до Premium підписки (запитай у свого викладача ПРОМОКОД на знижку):
ВІДЕОЛЕКЦІЇ українською мовою з ПДР 2026
Зрозумілі та доступні відео для легкого вивчення правил від найкращих викладачів України.

РЕЖИМ: ВЧИ ПО ТЕМАХ
Всі запитання з тестів ПДР згруповані по темах, що зручно для закріплення теоретичних знань з правил дорожнього руху.
Можна проходити будь-яку тему необмежену кількість разів.

РЕЖИМ: ТРЕНУЙСЯ ПО БІЛЕТАХ
Дозволяє проходити іспит за схемою: 20 випадкових запитань, без обмежень за кількістю і часом. Окрім правильної відповіді, є пояснення від викладачів.

РОЗДІЛ: НОВІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
У цьому розділі ви знайдете спеціально розроблені нові та цікаві запитання, які допоможуть глибше зрозуміти правила та ще краще підготуватися до реальних ситуацій на дорозі.

МОЇ ПОМИЛКИ
При вивченні матеріалів в додатку ми зберігаємо запитання, з якими виникли проблеми, в окремому розділі.
В будь-який час можна повернутися до цього запитання і детальніше його пропрацювати.

НАЙСКЛАДНІШІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
Ми зібрали найпопулярніші помилки користувачів нашого додатка при проходженні іспиту.
На ці запитання варто звернути увагу і ще раз закріпити знання.

ЗБЕРЕЖЕНІ ЗАПИТАННЯ
Зберігайте запитання, що викликають труднощі.
Ви зможете повернутись до них пізніше й розібратись уважніше у зручний для вас час.

СТАТИСТИКА
Відстежуйте свій прогрес у навчанні:
результати іспитів та правильність відповідей
прогрес по темах і кількість пройдених тестів
збереження статистики протягом дії підписки + 1 місяць
Інтерактивна шкала підкаже, коли ви готові до іспиту в СЦ МВС.

9. ЄДИНИЙ ДОСТУП ДЛЯ ВСІХ ПЛАТФОРМ: реєструйся в додатку або на нашому сайті https://pdr.infotech.gov.ua/ і вивчай теорію та проходь тести з будь-якого пристрою.

10. ОФФЛАЙН ДОСТУП - всі тестові запитання і правила ПДР завантажуються на мобільний пристрій, і доступні до вивчення навіть без доступу до інтернету.

bluejetty:00070812:ios.description:
Ski Tracker & Ski Tracks is an application for all who love snow and winter sports. Useful for skiers and snowboarders. Measure the maximum skiing speed, tracks, distance, mark the slopes on the map and provide full statistics of your winter sports activity.
Inside the app you can activate premium app version, which is extended on many additional and useful functions.
Ski Tracker includes the following features:
- measure and recording the maximum skiing speed
- measurment ski tracks distance, divided into downhill skiing and lifts
- time measure, skiing, lifts and rest
- marking your ski tracks on the map
- monitoring the height above sea level, with recording min. and max. values
- special feature "Fast Ride" to make a separate measurement of maximum speed, time and distance to any section and time
- all data and statistics you can record all day and later view history
- with this app you can take pictures with data on it and share them with friends,
- our idea is - any ski statistics, maps, graph and others data in one app
To use this app do not need a mobile roaming data, just GPS is enough. Remember that the GPS work poorly inside the buildings and can generate wrong data. Sometimes outdoors GPS may need more time to catch the good signal, especially in bad weather conditions.
Snow tracker application can also be used to training cross-country skiing, skitouring, skating, snowboarding, alpine skiing or other sports practiced in the open. This app is useful for experienced professionals, but also novice skiers will have while using it a lot of fun.
With Exa Ski Tracker, you can compare ski sports results with friends, organize sports competitions and other forms of competitive winter sports.
Ski Tracker can also help you navigate on the ski slopes, in finding routes or touch with your friends.
You're going skiing in Zermatt or Chamonix? Or maybe Aspen? Check the weather and instal Ski Tracker app. No matter where you'll be, this app certainly give you a lot of fun and impressions!
Over 30 millions satisfied worldwide users have installed our apps - join them and have fun!
Information
This app is continuously developed and improving. We still have been working to develop and improve it. If you see something that can be improved, we will be grateful for e-mail help@examobile.pl. We want to make our apps the best in Apple Store - thanks you.

bluejetty:00087876:ios.description:
Joga’s app for amateur soccer measures your performance on the field and keeps you sharp even off it, with games, challenges and exclusive tactical classes.
Test your knowledge and decisions and learn soccer tactical concepts with games and free classes, track your matches using your smartphone GPS or smartwatch and get to know your strengths and weaknesses on the field at a professional level.
Joga prepares you for any environment, use the app during your soccer matches and you will be able to measure your position, movement, sprints, calories, distance covered and much more. In addition, you can analyze your heatmap and minute-by-minute pace, keep track of your endurance and assess your progress. off the field, increase your confidence learning about the best tactical decisions with our Training feature.
Take your soccer to the next level, in and off the field.
What the soccer app offers
Experience the feeling of being a professional player. Improve your conditioning and your playing style with exclusive metrics for soccer. Also learn and challenge your decisions with exclusive games. The Joga app is your coaching staff and it will help you become a better player.
Improve your positioning on the field
Playing soccer with a GPS allows you to create your heat map and assess your field positioning at several time points during the match. You can use either your cellphone or your smartwatch. Stand out as defender, midfielder, winger or striker.
Discover your average speed
Joga is not just another running or sports app but a technology developed to help you improve your soccer practice by teaching you about your game. Playing soccer with a smartwatch or mobile shows your average speed and helps taking your performance to the next level.
Test your endurance
Play with Joga soccer app and discover your stamina and the pace of your match. Keep track of your effort perception and closely monitor improvements in your physical performance.
Watch your evolution
Joga app soccer data shows your real progress. Track your performance game by game, understand your style within the field, your barriers and improvement points. See your achievements and watch as your score increases after each match.
Fit and comfort
Personalized sports science with your mobile device
Use our Joga smartvest or an armband and play soccer with your smartphone's GPS in a fitting and comfortable way. Professionals use Joga smart vests daily during training and official matches.
Try playing soccer with a smartwatch
The soccer app is compatible with smartwatches.Use your wearable to monitor your soccer match and get accurate results with even more comfort.
Joga Premium
Every soccer player deserves to live the experience of being the best in the world. Enter into the Joga Premium environment and live that experience with us.
With Joga Premium you will have access to exclusive metrics to improve your performance and you will be able to access extra games and classes. On the field, sprints and high speed metrics will guide you to reach a new level.
Joga Premium is available with a monthly or annual subscription. The monthly subscription is US$ 3,99 and the annual subscription is US$ 34.99 (price may vary according to location). You can subscribe direct with your iTunes Account, where the payment will be charged at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turned off the auto-renew by going to the 'Manage Subscription' page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
Terms of use: https://wearejoga.com/user-terms/user-terms-en.html
Privacy Policy: https://wearejoga.com/user-terms/privacy-en.html

bluejetty:00149406:ios.description:
Think of FlexRide Milwaukee as a whole new way to get to jobs in the Menomonee Falls area — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. Eligible users can also pay using pre-tax transit dollars through approved commuter benefit debit cards. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
Questions? Reach out at support-milwaukee@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00150186:ios.description:
Nurture a small pot of succulents that grow in real time.
Viridi is a safe haven, a place you can return to for a moment of peace and quiet whenever, and wherever you need it.
While not fully realistic (they're very forgiving), your succulents will require some maintenance and can die from over- or under-watering. Name your favorite plants, give them special care and attention, and they might even flower for you.
Viridi is free to try and comes with your choice of plant assortment. If you think it has a place in your life, you can buy your favorite plants from the in-game nursery for just a few cents a piece. Remember to visit the nursery occasionally for your weekly free seeding!
--
"Designed to be the ideal happy place game ... Viridi is a primer, a simulation, and a love letter to this branch of botany, all rolled into one" 
- Fast Company
"Yes, you do need an ultra-zen video game about growing succulents ... tending to these digital plants offers a seriously calming experience"
- The Huffington Post
"The most chilled out and peaceful game I've ever seen"
- Upworthy
"In addition to learning about real-life varieties of succulents, what you are learning when you play games of this type is how to create a quiet, mindful moment in your day using unusual tools" 
- National Geographic

bluejetty:00153550:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a pocket Pokémon TCG card scanner.
Identify any Pokémon card, check its value, and track your entire collection with ease.
Perfect for collectors, TCG players, and anyone managing trading cards, decks, or a growing card portfolio.
[Features]
- Instant Pokémon Card Scanner: Scan Pokémon TCG cards in seconds
- Real-Time Card Value: Get up-to-date price estimates based on condition
- Identify Rarity & Details: View set, number, edition, and rarity for your Pokémon portfolio
- Pokémon Collection Tracker: Save and organize cards you collect
- Track Collection Value: See the total value of your TCG portfolio anytime
- Manage Trading & Decks: Keep your cards organized for trades or deck building
[Notes]
This app is designed to scan and recognize Pokémon and TCG cards, and help users track and collect their personal TCG collections.
It is not affiliated with, endorsed, or approved by any card game companies or copyright holders.
All trademarks, images, and names belong to their respective owners.
This app does not use or distribute copyrighted material.
[Subscription Pricing & Terms]
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
- Subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00040011:ios.description:
3 GIÂY VỚI APP DICAMON - HỌC ONLINE CHƯA BAO GIỜ HIỆU QUẢ ĐẾN THẾ! 
*** Ở thời đại 4.0, để học tốt giữa online và offline vừa tạo ra cơ hội vừa là thách thức cho người học. Kiến thức nguồn internet luôn đa dạng nhưng để tìm được 1 địa chỉ tin cậy không hề dễ dàng. Trước những trăn trở đó, Giainhanh.vn đã cho ra đời App Dicamon, ung dung hoc tap - Giúp học sinh HỌC TỐT tối ưu học tập, giải bài tập, giải toán , soạn văn, văn mẫu, giúp học sinh học tốt môn tiếng anh. Sách bài tập, sách nâng cao các môn Toán, Vật Lý, Hoá Học, Sinh Học, Ngữ Văn, Lịch Sử, Địa Lý, Tin Học, GDCD, Luyện Viết, Tiếng Việt, và đầy đủ các lớp: lớp 6, lớp 7, lớp 8, lớp 9, lớp 10, lớp 11, lớp 12, ôn thi đại học
Ưu điểm của ứng dụng giải bài tập Dicamon:
1. Giải bài tập bằng camera kết quả lời giải chỉ trong 3 giây
Giải bài tập vô cùng đơn giản chỉ cần bật camera chụp ảnh câu hỏi sau 3 giây có ngay lời giải và 10 bài tập tương tự.
Giải bài tập nhanh bằng camera, bài tập về nhà, bài tập ôn thi.
Nhận diện hình ảnh bằng công nghệ camera chụp hình chữ viết tay và chữ in hoa.
Nguồn bài tập chất lượng cao luôn được kiểm duyệt, cập nhật bám sát giáo trình và phù hợp với chương trình giáo dục hiện tại.
Lời giải bài tập chi tiết, rõ ràng, chính xác phù hợp, có cả các dạng bài và đáp án tương tự để học sinh luyện tập
2. Cộng đồng hỏi đáp bài tập uy tin nhất và miễn phí

Trying to lose weight?
Fasted is the perfect app for you! It was designed by intermittent fasting experts to help you track your progress, set goals, and see results. You’ll be able to easily lose weight with this app – without ever feeling hungry. 
You can use Fasted for free men & women, but if you want to achieve your goals rapidly try Fasted plus for one week for free.
Plus, we have delicious recipes that will make your mouth water.
Fasted: the fasting method - seguidor de ayuno - интервальное голодание - تطبيق تتبع الصيام
With Fasted, you can finally achieve the body you’ve always wanted. This app makes intermittent fasting simple and straightforward so that you can get on the fast track to a healthier lifestyle. And it’s all backed by science – so you know it works.
Download Fasted today and start seeing results!
FEATURES OF FASTED:
- Intermittent Fasting Timer
Our app includes an Intermittent Fasting Timer that helps you stay focused and motivated throughout your fasting period.
The timer works by tracking your fasting and eating hours and alerting you when it's time to break your fast.
- Intermittent fasting for Women & Men Plans
Choose the program that is suitable for you. Start with the easy and choose the harder option when you’re used to it.
- Learn About the Fasting Method
Learn everything about the intermittent fasting method and its benefits. What is it, how it works and how it can help you to lose weight and have a healthy life, and more...
- Water Intake Tracker
Tap on the water icon whenever you drink water and input your water intake. Track your water intake in the Me tab. Your need for water depends on various factors including if you’re active and how much water you lose (i.e if you sweat a lot you will need more water)
- Weight Watcher App
You can log and track your weight and also edit your current weight to achieve your goals.
- View my Statistics
Track your progress on the Me screen. View the summary of your stats: total fasts, averaging time, total time, longest fasting, current weight, and total weight loss. You can also see your weight goal, fast history, water intake, how much weight you lose in 7 days, and the Timeline. Get badges for completing tasks and view them on your Achievement tab.
NOTE:
If you have any health issues or experience health issues during your fasting program, please consult with your doctor.
We also include many free functionalities such as a free fasting timer, water intake, free plans, etc...
SHARE:
If you know someone who will benefit from this app, please share the Fasted app with them so they can also enjoy using Fasted in their intermittent fasting program.

• Start a war against the United States, and win
• Marry a human or an advanced robot, and start a family

bluejetty:00122883:ios.description:
LandingsCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with LandingsCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the LandingsCU app, you must be enrolled as a Landings Credit Union Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00026796:ios.description:
A faster, easier way to get hired for permanent nursing and healthcare jobs
Incredible Health is the #1 AI-powered career marketplace for nurses, technicians, and healthcare workers. Whether you’re an experienced RN or NP, a newly licensed nurse, or looking for per diem work, this is built to support your career at every stage.
Used by 1 in 3 nurses in the United States and trusted by over 1,500 top hospitals and health systems like Johns Hopkins, Cedars-Sinai, and Kaiser Permanente, Incredible Health helps you land permanent jobs with less stress and better results.
---
Find the right job, faster
- Get matched with personalized job openings in hospitals, outpatient clinics, home health, and surgery centers
- Employers apply to you, not the other way around
- Manage interviews and offers with built-in tracking
- Explore full-time, part-time, and per diem roles in one place
This is permanent job matching designed for nurses and healthcare professionals.
---
Gale, your personal AI career partner
Gale is an AI voice agent trained exclusively on healthcare career data from millions of real career journeys. Built with proprietary insights from nurses and technicians across specialties, Gale understands clinical pathways and job requirements inside and out.
Use Gale to:
- Practice interviews with real clinical questions and instant feedback
- Generate a polished, specialty-specific resume in minutes
- Auto-complete job applications using your profile
- Discover trending roles and continuing education resources in your field
You care for others every day. Gale is here to support your next step.

Lyn: smarter hiring support for employers

---
A supportive nurse and medical community, built just for you

---
Continuing education that keeps your career moving
Track your CEU progress, find state-specific continuing education resources, and stay ready for what’s next. Whether you're earning CE hours or preparing for your NCLEX, we help you invest in your future.
---
Smarter tools to grow your career
- Resume Wizard tailored to your license and clinical experience
- Personalized salary estimator to know what nurses really earn
- Marketplace updated daily with active, verified job listings
---
Incredible Health is where nurses and healthcare workers find their next step with speed, confidence, and support.
Download the Incredible Health app and get matched today.

bluejetty:00078187:ios.description:
Step back in time and explore Miami's rich Art Deco heritage on our Art Deco Walking Tour. Written and Narrated by experienced guides, this tour takes you through the streets of Miami Beach to admire the city's most stunning examples of Art Deco architecture. Get an introduction to the Art Deco, Mediterranean Revival, and Miami Modern (MiMo) styles found within the Miami Beach Architectural Historic District. Explore hotels, restaurants, and other commercial structures with a visit to a number of interiors.
When in the city, discover the dark side of Miami Beach on our exclusive Scandals Walking Tour. Delve into the city's intriguing past and uncover its most scandalous moments. From corruption and organized crime to celebrity scandals and political upheavals, this tour takes you through the streets of Miami Beach to explore the sordid history that lies beneath its glamorous exterior

bluejetty:00152607:ios.description:
Your brain has the amazing ability to grow and adapt at any age – it just needs regular exercise. BrainFit makes daily brain exercise fun, fast, and effective. Improve your brain muscles, sharpen your focus, and boost your problem-solving skills with just 3-minute daily workouts guided by your personal AI brain trainer, Neuro Coach.
Why BrainFit?
- Personalized plan: Adaptive difficulty and a guided path from Cognitive Foundations → Advanced Skills → Cognitive Mastery.
- Daily routine: Focus & Inhibition, Processing Speed + Working Memo, Logic & Quant Reasoning, Flexibility & Verbal Fluency, Integration Challenge, and Recovery.
- Short, effective sessions: Fast, focused drills designed for busy schedules.
What You’ll Train
- Working Memo: formation, recall techniques
- Attention & Focus: sustained/selective attention, distraction resistance
- Speed & Agility: processing speed, reaction time, quick decision-making
- Logic & Reasoning: deductive thinking, complex/abstract reasoning
- Flexibility & Creativity: task switching, perspective shifting, ideation
- Executive Function: planning, prioritization, cognitive control
For Students, Professionals & Lifelong Learners: Whether you’re a student aiming to boost memo for exams, a professional seeking sharper focus and problem-solving at work, or a senior looking to keep your mind active, BrainFit adapts to you. The app is suitable for all ages and backgrounds, ensuring everyone can build a sharper, smarter mind.
Real skills, real variety: Memo Palace & association methods, attention switching, working memo, reaction time, problem solving, creative thinking, executive control, and more.
Built-In Motivation
- Levels & XP: 500 points per level, climb as you master lessons.
- Streaks & stats: Keep momentum with daily streaks and improvement tracking.
Freemium Model – Upgrade for More: BrainFit is free to download and use, with core training exercises available for free. You’ll get a robust selection of brain games to start improving right away. Ready for the next level? Upgrade to BrainFit Premium to unlock the full training program: advanced lessons, all daily challenge modes for every day of the week, and exclusive games. Train with no limits and supercharge your progress with premium features!
Give your brain the workout it deserves and have a blast doing it. Download BrainFit for free today and start your brain training journey. In just a few minutes a day, you can build a brighter memo, faster thinking, and a more focused, agile mind. Get ready to train your brain and unlock your full potential with BrainFit!
Note: This app is for training and entertainment purposes and does not provide medical advice.
Developed by Fastemy - Fast and Fun Education

bluejetty:00064465:ios.summary:

Solitaire remains the most popul
bluejetty:00064465:ios.description:
Take your mind off everyday problems and play the latest evolution of the classic card game - Solitaire Kingdom! Our solitaire collection will help you to relax and at the same time will warm-up your brain.
Solitaire remains the most popular computer game of all time, and for good reason. Simple rules and straightforward gameplay make it easy to pick up for anyone. Just focus on clearing out the cards from the table.
Solitaire Kingdom makes it the best experience to date with the 18 best solitaire games:
Klondike
Klondike by Threes
Klondike Two Decks
Spider One Suit
Spider Two Suits
Spider Four Suits
Scorpion
FreeCell
FreeCell Two Decks
Pyramid Easy
Pyramid
Simple Simon
Eight Off
Forty Thieves
Easthaven
Baker’s Game
Golf Easy
Golf
A few words about some of them:
Klondike
This version is the timeless classic that many people just call "Solitaire". Try to clear all the cards from the table using traditional scoring or the popular Vegas scoring system.
Spider
Eight columns of cards await your attempts to clear them with the fewest moves possible. Start out playing with a single suit until you’re comfortable, and then see how you fare when using two or even all four suits in a game.
FreeCell
Use four extra cells to move cards around as you try to clear all cards from the table. More strategic than the Klondike version, FreeCell rewards players who think several moves ahead.
Pyramid
Pair two cards that add up to 13 in order to clear them. Try to reach the top of the pyramid. See how high you score in this deceptively simple and highly addictive card game that continues to increase in popularity!
We did our best to make a high-quality and enjoyable game for you. Please take a moment to write us a comment or rate this app.
Enjoy!
Terms & Conditions - https://b6.games/docs/solitaire/terms_and_conditions.html
Privacy Policy - https://b6.games/docs/solitaire/privacy_policy.html

* Beautiful 3D graphics! Perfect for exceptional space combat

bluejetty:00024872:ios.description:
Take back the throne that was rightfully yours! When demon-summoning usurpers assassinate the king and queen, the right of rulership falls to you, their only child. Develop your own unique prince or princess, discovering a world of fantasy, magic, mystery, and adventure.
"The Lost Heir: The Fall of Daria" is an epic 145,000-word interactive fantasy novel by Mike Walter—the first of a trilogy—where your choices control the story. The game is entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Develop your own unique prince or princess, for good or evil! Become a noble knight, a greedy thief, an evil priest, a nature-loving druid, a charming bard, a deadly assassin, a wise monk, a well-traveled ranger, a martial cleric, a kind priest, a brutal thug, a steadfast guard, a powerful wizard or any combination you choose.
Your highness, the kingdom of Daria awaits you!
• Play as male or female, gay or straight.
• Pursue love interests, make friends, or be a loner.
• Uncover the mysteries of demon summoning.
• Uncover and collect legendary magical items and treasure.

Ready to take your academic life to the next level? Look no further than Schooly — the ultimate app for managing your schoolwork and timetable!
TRACK YOUR SCHOOLWORK LIKE AN A+ STUDENT
Schooly's easy-to-use interface makes creating assignments a breeze, and you can add rich metadata options like links, images, and notes to any due work. You can also create reminders to keep you on track, so you'll never miss a deadline again.
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR SCHEDULE
Schooly also lets you manage your timetable with automatic day switching, so you'll never lose your place in your schedule. You can also add teachers and classrooms to keep track of all your important academic contacts in one place.
SEAMLESS SYNCING ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
Schooly goes where you go, with seamless syncing across all your devices via iCloud. Whether you're on your iPhone, Mac, or Apple Watch, you'll always have access to your important schoolwork and timetable information.
MORE FEATURES TO SIMPLIFY YOUR SCHOOL LIFE
From Siri Shortcuts to widgets, keyboard shortcuts, and multiple app icon options, Schooly is designed to make your school life even easier. For example, on an iPad you can use split view support on multitask while working on your assignments!
Don't wait — download Schooly now and see how these incredible features can help you take control of your academic journey!

You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed. bluejetty:00069540:ios.description:
Create amazing AI art with ArtGo's powerful AI image generator.
With ArtGo you can easily create abstract, deep dream AI paintings - no need for a paintbrush. Using powerful art styles, a blender, and your own rich imagination, the next great artist is you. ArtGo's new artwork creator brings the power of AI to iOS, with mind-blowing AI art tools that bring your imagination to life before your eyes. The easy-to-use AI art generator lets you describe any idea for a picture, then generates it for you almost instantly.
Got a specific or highly intricate style in mind? That’s okay, the only limit is your imagination! Worried your idea might be a little too abstract, dream-like, or surreal? If you think that ArtGo won’t be able to pull it off, just give us a try - you might be surprised! Our cutting-edge artificial intelligence tools can build the most fantastical photos in seconds, or just finesse an idea you weren’t sure how to put on paper. Whether you’re looking to create cover art for an album, a new selfie background, or just want to share some cool creations with your friends and followers, our AI text-to-image tool can help you with it all.
Plus, endless image creation & generative art means that you’ll be able to re-generate your text-to-image picture as many times as you like, until we get it right - or maybe even surprise you with what we come up with.
==ArtGo Features==
+ FAST - Create an artwork image in a few seconds
+ MANY ART STYLES - We provide dozens of art styles to choose, of course you can also customize the style of some individual artists
+ HIGH-QUALITY IMAGES - You can download or share all the creations made by ArtGo AI art tool
+ Upload local images, modify the image descriptions, and generate multiple variants.
==Wonder how it works==
+ Download ArtGo for free in the App Store
+ ArtGo will prompt you with a text-to-image bar (AI image generator), where you can type out whatever comes to mind & watch it appear as digital art. Intergalactic Van Gogh cat? Your hometown as a Salvador Dali painting? You got it.
+ Wait a few seconds (we mean it - just a few seconds!) while the AI image generator creates your image.
+ Not quite what you were looking for? No problem - re-generate! You’ll have a new, AI-generated picture in moments. Again, and again, and again.
+ Share your images on Facebook, TikTok, Instagram - you name it.
Creating art-style pictures has never been easier - type out any of your photo design needs and AI-generated art appears in a snap. Whether you’re looking for a new photo background or cover art - go ahead & give it a try! We can’t wait to see what you come up with.
Now, start your dream with ArtGo.
Terms of use: https://www.nextmob.net/about/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.nextmob.net/about/privacy
If you have any questions, please contact us: HiNextMob@gmail.com
