Carnets provides a complete, stand-alone,
bluejetty:00119961:ios.description:
Jupyter notebooks are a powerful tool used in education and research. You can write small snippets of Python code and observe the result on screen, combine with paragraphs of text, using Markdown.
Carnets provides a complete, stand-alone, implementation of Jupyter notebooks. Everything runs on your device, using the embedded Python interpreter; you do not need an internet connection. You can chose between Jupyter notebooks and the more advance Jupyterlab using Settings.
Numpy, Sympy, Matplotlib, Pandas, lxml, bokeh, nbextensions (including ipywidgets) and many other packages are pre-installed. To see the full list of installed packages, type "%pip list" in a code window. You can add more packages using "%pip install packageName", but only if they are pure Python.
If you need scipy, seaborn or scikit-learn, please use our other App, "Carnets - Jupyter (with scipy)".
You can share your notebooks with other apps and also open notebooks or directories managed by other apps. 
Partial list of installed packages: astropy, babel, bokeh, cryptography, cvxopt, Fiona, geopandas, geopy, lxml, matplotlib, numpy, openCV, pandas, pillow, pyFFTW, pyproj, rasterio, regex, shapely, sympy, wordcloud.

bluejetty:00014933:ios.description:
The iSAMS Student app offers students quick and easy access to their school information in one central place. From timetables to teaching groups, exam entries and exam timetables, rewards and detentions, activities and reports, students have the ability to access their personal school information directly from their iPhone or iPad.
The official iSAMS Student app links directly with the iSAMS management information system. It has been designed to offer students real-time access to their key school information in order to enhance their school experience. It also offers extended communication links and provides a valuable tool for students to connect with their teachers and fellow peers.
Simple to use, the app offers a personalised dashboard with quick links to:
The student’s timetable
Any sanctions and rewards
Any news bulletins and school news
The school calendar
The photo galleries
The ‘My Profile’ section offers easy access to further information including:
Teaching groups
The school timetable
Internal exam details (entries, timetables, results)
External exam details (entries, timetables, arrangements, candidate details, results)
School reports and assessments
Attendance
Activities
Detentions
Reward and conduct details
There is also a helpful ‘Information’ area where students can access school news and bulletins (both current and archived news), the school calendar and the school directory.
Useful push notifications mean that students can be notified about any updates or news in real-time. For example, students can receive a notification to inform them that their latest school report has been added to their profile or the location of their forthcoming hockey match has changed.
The data used by the iSAMS Student app is encrypted to ensure that confidential information cannot be accessed by unauthorised personnel. Your school also controls the level of visibility of information offered to students.
Please note: The iSAMS Student app must be installed by your school in order for it to be accessible to students. It will only work as part of the iSAMS management information system.

bluejetty:00098490:ios.description:
Mahjong Bloom – A Blossoming Twist on Classic Mahjong
Step into a serene world of timeless gameplay with Mahjong Bloom, a beautifully designed tile-matching game that brings a fresh, modern twist to the classic mahjong solitaire experience. Whether you're a seasoned player or just discovering the joy of mahjong, Mahjong Bloom is an exciting new tile game that offers hours of relaxing, brain-boosting fun.
Immerse yourself in calming visuals, soothing sounds, and progressively challenging matching game puzzles as you match your way through an ever-growing garden of mahjong boards. With intuitive controls and stunning design, Mahjong Bloom is the perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp.
Features
Thousands of Unique Levels: Discover a wide variety of layouts and puzzle shapes designed to challenge and delight players of all skill levels.
Exciting Challenges and Rewards: Log in each day for new puzzles, and exciting rewards. Every tile game you complete brings you closer to victory.
 Power-Ups and Hints: Stuck on a match? Use helpful tools like hints, shuffles, and undos to keep the momentum going.
Offline Play: Enjoy Mahjong Bloom anytime, anywhere 
Relaxing Soundscapes: Gentle music and ambient sounds help you stay focused and relaxed as you play.
How to Play

bluejetty:00184138:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The Dieterich Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Dieterich Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Dieterich Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Dieterich Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

Popl is disrupting the events i
bluejetty:00073663:ios.description:
Welcome to Popl, the #1 event lead capture + digital business card app designed to help you seamlessly capture leads and share stunning digital cards at every event, conference, trade show, expo, and beyond.
Popl is disrupting the events industry by allowing teams and individuals to capture leads and share virtual business cards while eliminating:
- Using a different lead capture app each time
- Clunky and hard to use badge scanner apps
- Spending thousands of dollars for lead capture & lead retrieval
- Waiting weeks for lead lists after finishing events
- Manually uploading leads into CRMs
- Broken event marketing attribution
- Missed and delayed follow up emails or phone calls
- Buying CSV lead lists and waiting days to receive them
- Not being able to measure the revenue and value from your events 
AI-POWERED UNIVERSAL BADGE SCANNER
- We’ve created the first ever, AI-powered conference badge scanner that works at every single event! 
- No more badge scanning API kits, no more paying for QR code access, just pure Popl AI magic.
OFFLINE SCANNING: 
- Let's face it, conference Wi-Fi can be a nightmare. We built Popl from the ground up with offline capabilities in mind so that all leads are saved, enriched, and synced no matter the conditions.
EVENT LEAD CAPTURE PLATFORM
- Enjoy automatic lead tagging, personalized follow-up emails, qualifying questions, unique CRM integrations, team goals, digital business card templates, and follow-up emails. 
PAPER BUSINESS CARD SCANNER
- Convert physical paper business cards into digital contacts in seconds, ensuring you never lose a lead. Say goodbye to stacks of business cards.
CALENDER BOOKING INTEGRATIONS
- Instantly book meetings after capturing leads via the Popl app.. Popl integrates with all popular calendar booking platforms to simplify meeting scheduling.
LEAD QUALIFIERS
- Create and answer qualifying questions within the Popl app to capture key lead details such as persona info, favorite products, job titles, level of interest, and region.
DIGITAL BUSINESS CARD MAKER
- Use our industry leading digital business card maker to design electronic business cards that reflect your brand, corporate identity, or personal brand with custom colors, logos, fonts, and layouts.
FOLLOW UP EMAILS
- Did you know that nearly 50% of potential deals from trade show leads end up going to the first company to follow up? Speed to lead is everything, follow up right at the booth while you're still top of mind, not hours later.
CRM INTEGRATIONS
- Popl integrates with popular CRM systems and allows custom mappings to ensure leads flow into your CRM exactly as you need.
QR CODE GENERATOR
- Instant QR code generation: Create unique QR codes linked to your digital business card or lead capture form, perfect for quick and easy sharing.
- Branded QR Codes: Customize your team’s QR codes with logos, brand colors, styles, and more.
UNLIMITED SHARING OPTIONS
- Share your digital business card via Apple Wallet, Apple Watch, home screen & lock screen widgets, email signatures, and NFC-enabled devices.
24/7 ON-FLOOR CALL SUPPORT
- We know that things don't always go according to plan, especially on the event floor. That's why we pride ourselves on being the only event solution that provides on-floor call support at all times. With us, you're never alone on the conference floor.
JOIN MILLIONS OF USERS WORLDWIDE
- Join a global community of 2M+ professionals using Popl to transform their events, networking & lead capture. Trusted by leading brands like Tesla, Google & Salesforce.
POPL’S GLOBAL MISSION
- Our Mission is simple: We connect companies with their future customers. This mission is engrained in our culture here at Popl and we as one team, one dream passionately work towards providing lead generation, lead capture, and lead enrichment value to all of our customers worldwide.
Privacy Policy: https://popl.co/privacy
Terms Of Use: https://popl.co/pages/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00094830:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00094830:ios.description:
Most nutrition apps count calories or macros, but miss what matters most: your micronutrients. Easily track your vitamin and mineral intake just by taking a picture of your food.
Identify deficiencies from iron to vitamin b12, fix symptoms, and optimize your long-term health.
Why Micronutrients Matter
Micronutrients—like iodine, iron, magnesium, and vitamin D—are essential to your energy, mood, immunity, brain function, and longevity. But most people have no idea if they’re getting enough. Even healthy eaters have blind spots. Over time, small nutrient gaps can lead to fatigue, hormonal imbalances, poor immunity, or worse.
We make it easy to see what you’re missing and fix it fast.
Here’s How It Works
1. Snap a Picture of Your Meal
No logging, no typing. Just take a photo. Our AI analyzes your food for dozens of essential vitamins and minerals—instantly.
2. Track Your Daily Intake Against RDAs and AIs
Based on your age and sex, we show you how your nutrient intake compares to the official Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDAs) and Adequate Intakes (AIs).
3. Spot Deficiencies Before They Become Problems
Quickly see where you’re falling short—and get tips to close the gap with better food choices.
4. Build Healthy Habits with Data That Matters
Every day, you’ll know if you’re fueling your body right—not just by calories or protein, but by what truly powers your cells.
Key Features
• Micronutrient Tracking Made Easy – Go beyond calories and macros. Track essential nutrients like iron, vitamin B12, iodine, magnesium, and more.
• Photo-Based Food Logging – Just take a picture. No barcode scanning or manual entry required.
• Personalized Daily Targets – All recommendations are tailored to your age, sex, and official RDA/AI values.
• Simple Visual Feedback – Instantly see what you’ve hit and what you’re missing with clear, color-coded visuals.
• Daily & Weekly Trends – See how your nutrition stacks up over time and build consistency.
• Recipes based on your remaining macros for the day and dietary preferences.
• Science-Backed Guidance – Built on trusted nutrition standards used by health professionals.
Our Mission
We believe that everyone deserves to live a longer, healthier, and happier life, without the stress of counting every gram. Nutrition should be simple, personal, and empowering.
This app gives you the insights to make better food decisions every day—with less effort and more confidence.
Stop guessing what your body needs. Start knowing.
Because it’s not just about eating—it’s about thriving.

bluejetty:00046224:ios.description:
Cataki: Reciclar nunca foi tão fácil.
As catadoras e catadores são responsáveis por coletar 90% de tudo que o Brasil recicla. O Cataki é a plataforma que reúne no mesmo lugar as pessoas que querem que seus resíduos sejam reciclados e os catadores, que tiram seu sustento a partir da reciclagem. 
Além de catadores, no ecossistema Cataki você encontra cooperativas, ferros-velhos, pontos de entrega voluntária (PEVs) e ecopontos.

- remoção de entulho e resto de podas
- remoção de móveis e outros itens volumosos
- pequenos transportes
Importante! O app é gratuito, mas o trabalho dos catadores não. Combine com o profissional da reciclagem um valor que faça sentido pra ambas as partes. A remuneração pelo serviço prestado é essencial
Instagram: @catakiapp
Facebook: /catakiapp

bluejetty:00064131:ios.name: Sonic Boom Dash
bluejetty:00064131:ios.summary: The world’s fastest hedgehog returns in a high-octane sequel built for the next generation of mobile gaming. Sonic Boom Dash fuses the legendary speed of SEGA’s classic runners with the tactical depth of the hit Sonic Boom universe. This is
bluejetty:00064131:ios.description:
The world’s fastest hedgehog returns in a high-octane sequel built for the next generation of mobile gaming. Sonic Boom Dash fuses the legendary speed of SEGA’s classic runners with the tactical depth of the hit Sonic Boom universe. This isn't just a race; it’s a fully immersive, multi-layered dash through 3D worlds that push your reflexes to the limit.
Explore Immersive 3D Worlds
Embark on a high-speed journey through breathtaking 3D landscapes and exhilarating new challenges. Whether you're navigating lush jungles or futuristic ruins, the gameplay is truly endless. Take control of your destiny by choosing the ultimate runner from the iconic Sonic the Hedgehog roster. Will you dash as the legendary Sonic, or master the track with Shadow, Tails, Amy, Knuckles, Vector, or the fearless newcomer, Sticks the Badger?
Epic Graphics, Elite Precision
Experience the "Boom" with stunning, console-quality graphics that bring every loop and jump to life. Race through meticulously designed courses filled with high-stakes hazards and intricate obstacles. It’s not just about running—it’s about precision. Dodge, jump, and weave your way through epic levels as you fight for the top of the leaderboard and claim your victory.
Endless Action for Every Generation
Built for fans of all ages, Sonic Boom offers a deep, rewarding gameplay experience that kids and adults alike can’t put down. The more you run, the more you achieve! Unlock an entire stable of classic characters and customize your experience by selecting the runner that fits your style. Sonic and his team are at the starting line—are you ready to join the race?
GAME FEATURES
-ICONIC ROSTER: Play as Sonic, Shadow, Tails, Amy, Knuckles, Vector, or the wild and unpredictable Sticks the Badger.
-STUNNING 3D ENVIRONMENTS: Race through lush jungles and futuristic landscapes in the beautiful Sonic Boom world, featuring graphics optimized for high-speed thrills.
-EVOLVE YOUR GAMEPLAY: Collect and evolve magical Sprites. These tiny companions provide instant boosts, reviving you from crashes or extending your dash power.
-LIVE EVENTS & CHALLENGES: Don't just run for a high score—run for glory. Compete in Daily SEGA Challenges and special events to unlock exclusive rewards and rare prizes.
Dash into the next generation of endless runners. The world of Sonic Boom is waiting—are you fast enough to handle it?
- - - - -
Privacy Policy: http://www.sega.com/mprivacy/
Terms of Use: https://games.sega.com/eula
SEGA’s Sonic Boom Dash is ad-supported and in-app purchases are not required to progress. Ad-free play is available with an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00130809:ios.summary:

Let's secretly and carefully set up a prank on the people in
bluejetty:00130809:ios.description:
Welcome to Prank Life!
You are an energetic boy who lives in a certain city. You are very mischievous and try various things every day!
However, mischief should never be caught.
Let's secretly and carefully set up a prank on the people in the city!
When the mischief is successful, you will find it fun enough to start dancing!
This game allows you to challenge many mischievous themed mini-games.
Let's relieve stress by having a lot of mischievous experiences in the game that will make you really angry in reality!
There are many types of mini games, and there will be more and more different games in the future, so please look forward to it!
Let me introduce some of the mini games available!
If you clear the mini game and succeed in mischief, you will receive coins as a reward!
Use coins to upgrade your room more and more luxuriously. At first there is no furniture, but you can buy a sofa or rug! Can you upgrade everything?
◆ Digging pits and trapping your friends!
You are trying to sneak into the yard of your friend's house.
Digging pitfalls in your friend's yard and be amazed! Put a cactus in the pit! How do your friends react?
◆ Let's make cute graffiti on the car so as not to get caught!
A car that looks like a luxury car is parked! You just have a spray!
The owner is crazy about the phone but sometimes looks back!
If you think you're going to look back, stop graffiti and hide in the shadow of the car!
Let's scribble a lot with a spray so that the owner will not find it!
◆ Let's eat ice cream with spiders!
There are three delicious ice creams in front of you.
Add a spider to your friend's ice cream and be amazed! 
However, I didn't know which ice cream I was mischievous with. Can you remember it well?
Don't forget which is the ice cream with the spider!
◆ Let's repaint the chair colorfully!
There is a chair in such a place!
Let's paint the chair colorfully with paint! 
If you spend too much time on pranks for a long time, someone may find you!
Let's complete the mischief as quickly as possible!
This one is more fashionable, so it's great!
◆ Mischief has come out! Let's run away from the chasing people!
Finally, a mischief has been found by the people in the city!
This mini-game is a running game where you run away from angry chasing people.
If you hit an obstacle, the speed will slow down.
Avoid obstacles and run hard so you can't catch up!
This game is very funny and simple! But you may need a high IQ to clear it! It's a game that also helps you train your brain! Let's release daily stress and relax!
If you find this game interesting, share it on Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Tik Tok, Twitter, Whatsapp, VK, Tumblr, Flickr, Pinterest and more!
Let's play Prank Life!

bluejetty:00104009:android.description:
Happify’s science-based activities and games can help reduce stress, overcome negative thoughts, and build greater resilience by providing effective tools and programs to improve emotional well-being.
Our techniques are developed by leading scientists and experts who've been studying evidence-based interventions in the fields of positive psychology, mindfulness and cognitive behavioral therapy for decades.
86% of people who use Happify regularly report feeling better about their lives in 2 months!
HAPPINESS ISN’T JUST ONE THING. IT’S EVERYTHING.
Struggling with everyday challenges and being gripped by negativity can be toxic to one's emotional and physical well-being, relationships, and performance at work. So when you start to turn the corner, and begin to learn the new habits of successful engagement with life, everything starts to look brighter and better.
SKEPTICAL JOURNALISTS TRIED IT FOR THEMSELVES, AND HERE’S WHAT THEY SAID:
ABC World News' Mara Schiavocampo
"I gave it a shot for 5 weeks...it works!"
The New York Times
"Each track contains bite-size quizzes, games and activities that guide you to seeing more positive aspects of daily life."
The TODAY Show
"These are things you can do every day -- tasks you can complete and be rewarded for -- to feel better, reduce stress, live a better life, & actually be happy."
Katie Couric: World 3.0 on Yahoo
“[Happify] evaluates what's keeping you from a high happiness quotient, then you're given games and activities that will boost your mood, like Uplift, Serenity Scene, and Gratitude Walk."
YOU KNOW YOUR GOALS. WE KNOW HOW YOU CAN ACHIEVE THEM.
Choose one track. Choose them all.
* Conquering negative thoughts
* Coping better with stress
* Building self-confidence
* Fueling your career success
* Achieving mindfulness through meditation
* …and 30+ more!
Happify is free to download and use. It’s a great way to get started, and discover why so many people upgrade to Happify Plus for access to even more:
* Unlimited access to 30+ tracks;
* Your 20-page character strength report, offered in partnership with the renowned VIA Institute
* Track your progress everyday and see how your skills compare
* and more!
Because we know that everyone has different financial resources, we offer Happify Plus in a variety of plans, for as low as $11.67/month.
Payment will be charged to your Google Play account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off (by going to Account Settings) at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: http://www.happify.com/privacy

Supermarket: A Convenient Spot for Shopp
bluejetty:00115068:ios.description:
Toy Store: A Joyful Shopping Space Full of Childlike Fun
Shelves are loaded with plush dolls, building block puzzles and remote-controlled toys, and each toy holds the key to unlocking happy moments.
Supermarket: A Convenient Spot for Shopping Various Goods
Shelves are fully stocked with everything from fresh fruits and vegetables to daily necessities. Pushing a shopping cart through the aisles, the packed shopping bags are filled with the warmth of daily life.
Villa: A Luxurious, Private Residence for Quality Living
A standalone building is paired with courtyard greenery, an exclusive swimming pool and leisure areas. Smart home systems control all details of the house, allowing you to enjoy the tranquility and dignity of solitude.
Clothing Store: A Choice for Diverse Clothing and Stylish Outfits
From casual hoodies to elegant dresses, various clothing items are displayed in style-specific sections. Every matching attempt in the fitting room unlocks a unique fashion attitude.
Pet Café: A Cozy Coffee Time with Cute Pets
Aromatic coffee steams in the cup. Holding the coffee and petting the cute animals, worries fade away with the aroma. Here, you can enjoy a leisurely and healing slow time.
Indoor Children’s Playground: A Playful Paradise for Kids’ Joy
It is fully equipped with an ocean ball pool, slides and trampolines. Children chase, play, climb and jump in it, and every corner hides carefree happiness.
Amusement Park: An Exciting, Stress-Relieving Entertainment Venue
Roller coasters roar past, carousels spin slowly, and Ferris wheels rise high for a panoramic view. You can gain happiness here.
Farm: A Rural-Style Venue for Farming and Breeding Experiences
Cattle and sheep graze leisurely in the fence, and hens pace in the henhouse. You can experience the fun of farming and breeding, and breathe fresh air with the scent of soil.
Haunted House: A Thrilling Venue for Immersive Horror Experience
Lights flicker on and off in the dim corridor, and eerie sounds linger around the ears. Holding a companion’s hand and moving through it, you experience the thrill of adrenaline surge amid screams and tension.
Horror Building: A Gloomy, Frightening Space for In-Depth Horror Scenes
Creepy props are placed in the rooms, and faint lights cast terrifying shadows. Every step is accompanied by unexpected scares. You can immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere and challenge the limit of your courage.
Princess Castle: A Dreamy, Romantic Living Space from a Fairy Tale
The pink exterior walls and lace curtains are full of dreaminess. A crystal chandelier is placed in the living room, making it feel like stepping into a fairy tale world. It fulfills every girl’s princess dream, being romantic and warm.
Garden: A Blossom-Filled Space for Comfortable Leisure
All kinds of flowers bloom in competition, green grass grows lushly beside the path, and butterflies flutter among the flowers. You can feel the breeze brushing your face and enjoy the quiet and comfortable time.

4. If you need to close the subscription service, please do so in "Account Settings" at least 24 hours in advance.

User Agreement (EULA): https://hdwl.site/ios_user_agreement_builder_en.html

bluejetty:00115221:ios.description:
Welcome to Dim Sum Shop, a relaxing puzzle game where delicious food meets cozy decoration.
Here, you will become the owner of a small dim sum shop. By clearing puzzles with simple moves, you can complete various orders and unlock new ways to decorate your store. Every stage brings not only a fun challenge but also the joy of building your dream shop.
【Game Features】
-Easy puzzle mechanics — clear pieces with simple moves
-Shop decoration — collect items and design your own style
-Variety of dim sum — unlock tasty dishes to enrich your menu
-Special rewards — earn bonuses as you progress
-Warm & cute art style — relax and enjoy every moment
No matter if you want to unwind or enjoy the satisfaction of running your own shop, Dim Sum Shop will bring you a delightful experience!

bluejetty:00179616:ios.description:
This app is not sponsored or endorsed by, or affiliated with, Instagram or Meta Platforms, Inc. It’s time to add style to your Instagram and have your followers impressed! Social Fonts Keyboard lets you type in dozens of eye-catching fonts and symbols perfect for your bio, captions, DMs, and comments. Add a keyboard background image to theme your device exactly as you envision it. Also, Social Fonts Keyboard works on all other apps, including TikTok, Snapchat, WhatsApp, Facebook, Messages, WeChat, and more. It’s time to ditch the default system keyboard and boost your Instagram!
GROW YOUR SOCIALS
Social Fonts Keyboard helps your socials stand out…and followers won’t stop asking and enjoying.
FREE
Enjoy Social Fonts Keyboard for free, with optional upgrades to further boost your experience. If you decide to go Pro, enjoy a free 3-day trial and then it renews at USD$4.99/week or USD$24.99/year.
EASY-PEASY
Setting up Social Fonts Keyboard can be done in seconds, with 3 quick steps. Then you’re all set to use the fonts keyboard directly in any app you wish.
DOZENS OF FONTS
Browse a collection of dozens of fonts including Outline, Cursive, Manga, Hacker, Comic, Gothic and so much more.
KEYBOARD THEMES
Spice up your keyboard with custom backgrounds. Whether you like simple pastel colors, kittens, sunsets, galaxies, beaches, or countless other options, there's a theme for everyone.
SECURE & PRIVATE 
Privacy is our top priority, which is why we collect and store as little personal information as possible. We cannot and will never access the text you type. Learn more in our privacy policy & terms of use: https://mmappsinc.com/fonts-privacy

bluejetty:00080326:ios.description:
Flexcil: The world’s ultimate iOS note-taking app
Loved by Apple Editors - Editor's Choice, App of the Day, Note-taking on the next level, College Life, Apple Pencil Enhanced, New Apps We Love, Noteworthy Apps & Game, Productivity Boost for teachers
Whether you’re taking notes, bullet journaling, reading documents, or editing pages from textbooks ー use Flexcil! It’s the #1 note-taking tool for any Apple device.
Simply highlight by pen gestures and capture images and text on the study-note by pen gestures! Save time transcribing summaries by gestures on study-note with your Apple pencil.
ALL IN ONE NOTE TAKING
• Edit PDF pages 
• Annotate almost anything
• Endless pen colors, sizes, and fonts
• Seamlessly highlight and underline text with GESTURE
• Summarize and organize your thoughts, texts and notes 
• Instantly open any PDF for reading and studying
• Zoom to read small text
• Organize and manage your books AND notes
EASY AND INTUITIVE 
• Drag and paste text flawlessly
• Add text and annotate with ease
• Smooth Image selection
• Reading and pen gesture mode - FLEXCIL EXCLUSIVE
• Search the dictionary for any definitions you need
• Improved the tiring, old-fashioned way of writing which results in wrist/palm pain 
BULLET JOURNAL & TAKE BETTER NOTES
• Easily create bullet journal pages
• Hundreds of colors and pen stroke sizes
• Colorful covers & templates
• Endless creativity ー perfect for artists, hobbyists, or anyone that wants to make studying more fun
• Proven to boost productivity & happiness
RECORD & PLAYBACK AUDIO
• Record everything you hear whenever you take class notes or writing meeting notes
• Replay audio recording and review what you wrote during the class or in the meeting
• Tab on your note and hear what was said at the moment
MULTITASK
• Use Flexcil while other apps are open - take notes during lectures!
• Edit 2 PDFs at once
• Advanced viewing: full screen view, vertical scroll, 4-page view, and so much more
COMPATIBLE WITH:
• Zoom
• Google Classroom
• Google Drive
• Dropbox
• Box
• iCloud
• Notes
• Digital textbooks
• ebooks
• PDFs
and more!
APPLE PENCIL
• Simulate real-life note-taking by using your Apple Pencil - easy to use for all ages
• Guaranteed ZERO touch malfunctions 
• Support Apple pencil 2nd generation & double tap
Plus, enjoy these NEW FEATURES!
• Cloud sync: Access your notes from anywhere, and seamlessly sync across devices.
• Masking pen: Enhance your annotations with precision using the masking pen.
Take your note-taking to the next level with Flexcil. Download the most comprehensive, easy to use, and innovative study tool on the App Store today! 
* Support: https://support.flexcil.com
* Website: https://www.flexcil.com
* Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/flexcil
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/flexcil
* Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjro4WpiFnxqKxAXQmASNwg
[Access Permission Guide]
• Storage (Photos and Videos): Used for adding images to documents in Flexcil, accessing PDF files, purchasing and downloading store content.
• Music and Audio: Used for voice recording features, purchasing and downloading store content.
• Microphone: Used for voice recording.
• Camera: Used for taking pictures when adding photos.
• Notifications: Used to display important notification content.

Nós ajudamos você voltar para o positivo, negocie suas dívidas com descontos de até 90% com as melhores formas de pagamento.

bluejetty:00186782:ios.name: Colossus Piano
bluejetty:00186782:ios.summary: Colossus Piano sets a new standard in terms of realism, detail and overall quality of piano sounds on your iPad, iPhone and iPod touch. There are 8 acoustic piano models available as 8 individual in-app purchases, plus 5 E-Piano legends bun
bluejetty:00186782:ios.description:
Colossus Piano sets a new standard in terms of realism, detail and overall quality of piano sounds on your iPad, iPhone and iPod touch. There are 8 acoustic piano models available as 8 individual in-app purchases, plus 5 E-Piano legends bundled as 1 sound set with this app, together those 13 piano models make up 30 Gigabyte of sound material. All keys of all piano models were recorded in full length with a recording quality of 24 bit and 96 kHz stereo.
Note: this app requires in-app purchases to provide its functionalities!
Minimum Requirement: at least iPad 3 / iPad Air 1 / iPad mini 2 / iPhone 5 / iPod touch 6th gen.
Recommended: iPad Air 2 / iPad mini 4 / iPad Pro / iPhone SE / iPhone 6s or higher.
The dark brown „Colossus Concert Grand” model:³ 
• 24 velocity layers per key.
• Dedicated sustain samples.
• Release hammer sound.
• Optional pad sound.
• 14 GB in size (SSD space).
The white „Baby Grand” model:
• 12 velocity layers per key.
• Dedicated sustain samples.
• Release hammer sound.
• Optional pad sound.
• 6 GB in size (SSD space).
The „Upright Piano” model:
• 8 velocity layers per key.
• Dedicated sustain samples.
• Release hammer sound.
• Optional pad sound.
• 3.4 GB in size (SSD space).
The „E-Piano” sound set:
• 5 legendary E-Piano models (plus different model generations or configurations).
• 17 E-Piano sounds in total.
• Optional pad sound.
• Optional tremolo effect.
• 1.6 GB in size (SSD space).
For information about the other piano models, please visit our product website!
This app supports Audio Unit v3, Inter-App Audio and Bluetooth LE MIDI !
Software features:
• Modulation wheel support for controlling the most relevant sound parameter of the currently selected sound.
• Warm pad sound of a well known analogue synthesizer (not available for all models) can be turned on/off as support for the piano sound; volume can be controlled by mod. wheel and expr. controller.
• Sustain pedal support for holding notes.
• Sostenuto pedal support for holding individual notes.
• Soft pedal support for a more gentle sound.
• Expression pedal support for controlling optional pad layer's volume.
• Hammer sound when releasing keys, uses round robin, can be turned on/off and volume controlled (some acoustic pianos only).
• Polyphony of up to several hundred stereo voices.²
• Low latency disk streaming.
• Configurable audio latency down to 1 ms.
• Integrated effects (18 presets).
• App States: Save app's entire state as user presets.
• MIDI velocity response curve editor.
• App can keep running in the background.
• Master Tune, Scale Tuning & Hermode Tuning.
• Provides Audio Unit v3 plugin version of this app, which allows it to be used as virtual instrument directly within 3rd party multi-track DAW apps.
• Supports Apple's "Inter-App Audio" system.
• Virtual on-screen piano keyboard with velocity support, scalable & scrollable.
MIDI Player / Recorder:
• Record, save and load your songs in standard MIDI file format.
• Share your songs easily as audio file.
• Unlimited amount of tracks.
• Unlimited recording and playback length.
• Open MIDI (.mid) files directly from other apps (i.e. from Safari, Mail).
• Download or upload MIDI files with iTunes.
• Metronome.
• Use the "Tempo Zoom" dial knob to i.e. slow down playback at any time, learn your favorite songs more easily.
¹ For more information about supported adapters and MIDI keyboards, please visit our product website.
² Some sounds might use several voices per note. Polyphony depends on the exact device model being used. You find a polyphony table on our product website.
³ Important: the dark brown „Colossus Grand” piano model requires a large amount of main memory, so we only recommend this piano model for device models mentioned as „recommended” above.

bluejetty:00136585:ios.name: Medieval Life - Life Simulator
bluejetty:00136585:ios.summary: Embark on a captivating journey through the annals of history in "Medieval Life," an immersive and strategic mobile game for iOS that puts you in the shoes of medieval nobility. As a ruler of your own realm, you'll navigate the complexities
bluejetty:00136585:ios.description:
Embark on a captivating journey through the annals of history in "Medieval Life," an immersive and strategic mobile game for iOS that puts you in the shoes of medieval nobility. As a ruler of your own realm, you'll navigate the complexities of governing, strategizing, and building your legacy in a dynamic medieval world. Immerse yourself in this medieval simulation and guide your realm to greatness.
Key Features:
Royal Aspirations: Step into the regal shoes of a monarch, whether it's an emperor, empress, king, queen, duke, duchess, count or countess. Your destiny awaits as you strive to lead your realm to greatness.
Build and Expand: Develop your realm from the ground up. Expand your dominion and create a flourishing civilization.
Strategic Governance: Rule with wisdom and make vital decisions that will shape the fate of your people. Manage your gold and army, administer justice, and ensure the prosperity of your subjects.
Education: Cultivate the minds of your heirs and subjects through an intricate education system. Raise a generation of learned individuals who will shape the future of your realm.
Organize Feasts and Hunts: Host grand feasts and thrilling hunts to entertain your court, boost morale, and celebrate your victories.
Go on Pilgrimages: Embark on spiritual journeys to holy sites, seeking blessings and guidance. Your faith and actions can shape the destiny of your realm.
Conquer/Defend: Lay claims on your rival kingdoms and be prepared to use your mighty army to expand your kingdom, but be prepared to have to defend those new lands at any point! Engage in epic battles and utilize strategy to come out Victorious!
Scheme: Plot intrigues and political machinations to gain the upper hand. Your ability to scheme and strategize will be pivotal in achieving your ambitions.
Customizable Characters: Personalize your character's and stand out as a ruler of singular style and character.
Medieval Life is the ultimate medieval simulation game, offering a blend of strategy, history, and role-playing, all in the palm of your hand. Will you be a wise diplomat, a cunning strategist, or a fierce conqueror? Rule your realm with wisdom and power, or engage in political scheming to outmaneuver your rivals.

bluejetty:00063492:ios.summary:
Fall in love with Hearts, a popular card game. Hearts is structured to be played with four players, it is not difficult to learn but there is strategic play abound.
The game of Hearts is also popularly called as The Dirty, Dark Lady, Slipp
bluejetty:00063492:ios.description:
Fall in love with Hearts, a popular card game. Hearts is structured to be played with four players, it is not difficult to learn but there is strategic play abound.
The game of Hearts is also popularly called as The Dirty, Dark Lady, Slippery Anne, Chase the Lady, Black Queen, Crubs and Black Maria.
Hearts originated with a family of related games called Reversis, which was popular in Spain. 
The objective is to be the player with the fewest points by the end of the game.
Hearts, one of the most popular, enduring card games in the world, is great fun for players of all ages, though the rules can be somewhat tricky for rookies. 
Hearts is a 4-player trick-taking card game where the aim is to avoid getting penalty points. Each heart is worth one penalty point and the queen of spades is worth 13 penalty points. The other cards have no value. There is no trump suit.
In Hearts, a penalty point is awarded for each trick won, plus additional points for capturing the Jack of hearts or the Queen of Hearts.
Hearts card game train attention span and concentration, memory, and logical reasoning.
It is a game of skill - to a certain extent. You rely on luck to get good cards dealt to you, but strategic playing and a good memory make an enormous difference in this game. Keeping track of the cards played in each suit helps you to master this game, and practice and experience have no substitute.
Join thousands of other players in this Hearts card-game multiplayer adventure.
You can also create Private Rooms and invite your friends to play.
Unique combination of luck and strategy makes every game of hearts an exciting challenge.
Enjoy one of the most famous trick-taking card games – Hearts. 
You might have played many card games but there is nothing like Hearts.
Give our game a try. We’re sure you’ll love it. Enjoy!
Download Hearts Card Game for your phone and tablets today and have endless hours of fun.
***** Hearts Card Game Features *****
1. Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family.
2. True multiplayer where you can play with real people online in online player mode.
3. Offline Mode
4. 3 & 4 online multiplayer options
Please don't forget to review Hearts card game! 
We would like to know your feedback. Enjoy playing!!

bluejetty:00161054:ios.description:
The Messages App is a comprehensive communication platform designed to streamline your messaging experience. With a focus on efficiency, connectivity, and user convenience, this app combines a variety of communication tools into one cohesive interface. Whether you’re looking to send a quick text, set a reminder, or make a call, the Messages App has you covered.
Key Features
1. Dual Apps
Multiple Accounts: Manage and switch between multiple accounts seamlessly without logging out.
Separate Spaces: Keep personal and professional conversations distinct by using dual app instances.
Custom Settings: Customize notification settings, themes, and preferences independently for each account.
2. Direct Chat
Instant Messaging: Send and receive text messages instantly.
Media Sharing: Share photos, videos, voice messages, and documents with ease.
Group Chats: Create and manage group conversations for collaborative communication.
Quick Replies: Use pre-set responses for faster communication.
3. Direct Message
One-on-One Messaging: Engage in private conversations with contacts.
Message Encryption: Ensure privacy with end-to-end encryption for all direct messages.
Read Receipts: Know when your messages have been read by the recipient.
Typing Indicators: See when the other person is typing a response.
4. Reminder
Set Reminders: Create reminders directly from your chat conversations.
Sync with Calendar: Integrate reminders with your calendar app for better task management.
Recurring Reminders: Set daily, weekly, or monthly reminders for regular tasks.
Notification Alerts: Get notified when a reminder is due.
5. Direct Calling
Voice Calls: Make high-quality voice calls directly from the app.
Video Calls: Connect face-to-face with video calling.
Call History: View and manage your call logs within the app.
Voicemail: Leave voice messages when calls are not answered.
6. Messages
Unified Inbox: Access all your messages in one place, including SMS, MMS, and app-based messages.
Search Functionality: Easily search through your messages to find specific conversations or keywords.
Message Organization: Organize messages by date, sender, or priority.
Starred Messages: Mark important messages for quick reference later.
Additional Features
Customizable Themes: Personalize the app with various themes and color schemes.
Notification Management: Control notification preferences for each type of message and call.
Contact Syncing: Sync your contacts from your phone, email, and other apps.
Spam Protection: Automatically filter out spam messages and calls.
Multi-Device Support: Access your messages and calls from multiple devices, ensuring you stay connected on the go.
The Messages App is your all-in-one communication hub, offering a range of features designed to enhance your messaging and calling experience. With its intuitive interface and robust functionality, staying in touch with friends, family, and colleagues has never been easier.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase to enjoy all App Features without Ads:
• Auto-renewable subscription.
• Weekly ($2.99), 1 month ($4.99) and 1 year ($29.49) durations.
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at:
* Link to Privacy Policy: https://messagestextmessage.blogspot.com/2024/07/privacy-policy.html
* Link to EULA: https://messagestextmessage.blogspot.com/2024/07/eula.html
* Link to Terms of use: https://messagestextmessage.blogspot.com/2024/07/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00099201:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00099201:ios.description:
Find the right GIF, meme, or reaction without leaving the conversation.
Now in iMessage: GIF Keyboard includes an iMessage app, so you can search and send GIFs right inside Messages — no keyboard setup or Full Access needed. Open any conversation, tap + and choose GIF Keyboard. Don't see it? Scroll down the list, or tap More on older iOS versions.
KEY FEATURES
• Search trending GIFs, memes, and reactions
• Recent GIFs in the keyboard, available offline after they load
• Save favorites for quick access
• Quick Replies for messages you use often
• A complete text keyboard with letters, numbers, and symbols
• Type normally even without Full Access
• Clear copy, share, and send-confirmation feedback
• Faster loading with cached results when available
WORKS WITH YOUR CHATS
Use GIF Keyboard with iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat, Telegram, Discord, TikTok DMs, email, and other apps that support third-party keyboards and GIF pasting.
HOW TO ENABLE THE KEYBOARD
1. Open GIF Keyboard and choose Setup.
2. Open iPhone Settings.
3. Go to General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard.
4. Select GIF Keyboard.
5. Turn on Allow Full Access to search, copy GIFs, and access saved replies.
6. Open a chat, tap the globe key, and choose GIF Keyboard.
PRIVACY
When the keyboard is active, nearby text may be processed locally on your device to generate reply suggestions. Message content is not stored or sent to our servers. GIF search terms are sent to our GIF providers to return results. Advertising and analytics data are handled as described in our Privacy Policy.
Privacy Policy: https://aswapps.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00074433:ios.description:
PDF Scanner transforms your smartphone into a powerful and convenient document scanner. Designed for professionals and everyday users alike, this intuitive scanner app allows you to scan, convert, edit, and manage documents with ease. Whether you need a reliable photo to PDF convert scanner or a full-featured PDF file editor, this app has you covered.
DOCUMENT SCANNING
Quickly scan paper documents, passports, ID cards, books, invoices, images, receipts, or notes. Smart edge detection and auto-enhancement ensure sharp and clear scans every time, making this document scanner ideal for both personal and professional use.
ADD FILES - IMPORT & EXPORT
Import existing documents from your device, email, or cloud storage. Supported file formats include: DOC, DOCX, TXT, RTF, HTML, EML, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, HEIC, BMP, and GIF. Organize files in folders for easy access. Export documents in PDF, TXT, Word, DOC, and Excel formats with a single tap.
PDF EDITOR
Edit PDF files and other documents directly within the app: add annotations, highlight text, insert or delete pages, rearrange content, and more. You can also add a signature to documents for quick approvals or formal use.
PDF CONVERTER
Seamlessly convert between file formats like PDF, TXT, and DOC. The app also supports image to PDF conversion - turn any photo into a high-quality PDF document, either by capturing it instantly or importing from your gallery. Ideal for archiving handwritten notes, forms, printed pages, and more, with customizable layouts and page order.
SHARE DOCUMENTS
Easily share scanned or imported documents with others via email, messengers, or cloud services. Whether you're sending reports, forms, or notes, sharing is fast and secure across all major platforms.
PDF PRINTER
Print scanned or edited documents directly from your phone using wireless printing. Supports AirPrint and other major printing protocols for seamless and efficient output.
MATH EQUATIONS SOLVER
Scan handwritten math equations and receive instant solutions, making it a powerful tool for students, educators, and anyone working with mathematics.
RULER - REAL-TIME DISTANCE MEASUREMENT
Use your device’s camera to measure distances accurately in real-time. Ideal for everyday tasks, room planning, and quick measurements on the go.
QR CODE SCANNER
Instantly scan and read QR codes for websites, contacts, Wi-Fi access, and more - directly within the app.
MOBILE SCANNER CONVENIENCE
Lightweight and easy to use, this mobile scanner is the perfect companion for anyone who needs fast and flexible document processing on the move.
Whether you’re scanning a contract, editing a report, sharing a file, or converting a picture to PDF, this all-in-one tool simplifies your workflow. With PDF Scanner, managing documents is faster, smarter, and always in your pocket.

SLS Detector with Pose & Facemesh Detection:

Advanced Spirit Box & Word Log:

Additionally, the interactive word log records all detected messages, enabling users to analyze patterns and validate the authenticity of the spirit communication. This feature employs AI-driven speech processing to enhance the accuracy and relevance of the messages received during ghost-hunting sessions.

Its clean and simplistic interface ensures that there are no distractions, so you can focus on the hunt. bluejetty:00153571:ios.summary:
With over 13 million downloads worldwide, winner of the Japan Game Awards 2024 "Movement Award," and the #1 most downloaded game on Nintendo Switch for two consecutive years—the viral sensation "Suika Game" is now on Apple Arcade!
● About
bluejetty:00153571:ios.description:
With over 13 million downloads worldwide, winner of the Japan Game Awards 2024 "Movement Award," and the #1 most downloaded game on Nintendo Switch for two consecutive years—the viral sensation "Suika Game" is now on Apple Arcade!
● About the Game
A fun and engaging puzzle game where you match fruits and “evolve” them. Create the biggest watermelon possible and aim for the top score! What happens when two watermelons match...?
Check your score on period-based rankings and compete with players worldwide to reach the top.
● How to Play
1.When identical fruits match, they "evolve" into the next size, and points are added to your score.
2.Tap and drag to move "the grabber" left and right, then release your finger to drop the fruit. You can also tap any location inside the box to drop the fruit there.
3.The game is over if the fruits overflow from the box.
*Supports both portrait and landscape modes.
● Customization Features
Freely arrange the game screen design. Make your watermelon-making even more fun with your own favorite design!

bluejetty:00097702:ios.description:
The Bank of Clarendon is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with The Bank of Clarendon:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the The Bank of Clarendon Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a The Bank of Clarendon Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Key Features of the Seattle Yel
bluejetty:00147084:ios.description:
Seattle Yellow Cab App is the booking application for car services in King County, Seattle and surrounding communities.
We are pleased to offer fast, convenient, and easy to use free Seattle Yellow Cab App.
Key Features of the Seattle Yellow Cab App include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Seattle Yellow Cab App with the push of a button
To begin using the Seattle Yellow Cab App today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Seattle Yellow Cab App retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed up the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Seattle Yellow Cab App or calling us at +1 206-622-6500
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Seattle Yellow Cab App in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00164986:ios.name: Idle Monster TD: Tower Defense
bluejetty:00164986:ios.summary: Idle Monster TD Evolved is an endless idle Tower Defense game of epic monsters vs evil humans set in a cute 3D fantasy RPG world. Unlock, upgrade, and most importantly, EVOLVE over 120 unique monsters to defend the portal from an infinite s
bluejetty:00164986:ios.description:
Idle Monster TD Evolved is an endless idle Tower Defense game of epic monsters vs evil humans set in a cute 3D fantasy RPG world. Unlock, upgrade, and most importantly, EVOLVE over 120 unique monsters to defend the portal from an infinite swarm of invading humans. Strategize the most effective placement of monsters to optimize their powerful abilities. Management is crucial in this idle, tap tycoon, auto battler game! 
This delightful take on tower defense flips the script, putting you in charge of helpful creepy-crawlies trying to stop human invaders from destroying your base. Strategically tap to place cute allies like "Sun Blossom" for increased auto gold-production, or use "Skeleton Mage" for heavier damage. And if things get real dicey, just wipe the map clean with a "Rain of Fire" spell! Become the ultimate tycoon of Tower Defense!
Like other incremental clicker, tap tap, and tycoon idle games, defeating waves of invading humans gives you upgrades to bolster power, speed, and other stats - and the more humans you obliterate, the more monsters you’ll unlock. Idle Monster TD Evolved is filled with awesome beasts, ranging from cute flower monsters to big metal robots to scorching fire dragons. Discovering and evolving new creatures is part of the fun. Progress towards the tap tycoon master!
Like any loyal pal, Idle Monster TD takes care of itself while you’re away. Let the game auto battle, then come back in a few days to claim idle gold and power up your tower defenses. The enemy doesn't sleep - but neither do your monster towers. Sit back and relax while the endless, idle, auto battler does its thing.
Features:
- Unlock 40 unique monster towers, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success.
- Each monster has 3 evolutions that provide massive upgrades to power.
- Strategize by placing up to 10 monster towers at a time. Determining the most effective combination of their elemental skills and passive boosts will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks!
- Play through 6 different maps, each requiring different strategies to defend most efficiently.
- PvP tournaments and leaderboards give this casual game a competitive edge.
- Discover countless upgrades, research, spells, artifacts, technology, and more to level up with a variety of different resources.
- Several rewarding mini-games, such as Peasant Mobs, Tank Swordsman, and Necromancer bosses.
- Non-stop, endless, auto battle, and idle gameplay!
- Incremental clicker, tap tap, and tycoon idle auto battler game mechanics.
- Fantasy RPG based world and classes.
- Tower defense and incremental TD game mechanics.
- Complete tons of daily missions and achievements.
- Idle offline progress and auto battle gold earnings reward you while the game is closed!
- Cute and colorful 3D fantasy graphics.
Idle Monster TD Evolved is the perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is an endless TD and can mostly auto battle and play itself without you watching. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards as the ultimate TD tycoon. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantasy world, tap to battle humans and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Monster TD Evolved!

Like any loyal pal, Idle Monster TD takes care of itself while you’re away. Let the game auto battle, then come back in a few days to claim idle gold and power up your tower defenses. The enemy doesn't sleep - but neither do your monster towers. Sit back and relax while the endless, idle, auto battler does its thing.

Features:
- Unlock 40 unique monster towers, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success.
- Each monster has 3 evolutions that provide massive upgrades to power.
- Strategize by placing up to 10 monster towers at a time. Determining the most effective combination of their elemental skills and passive boosts will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks!
- Play through 6 different maps, each requiring different strategies to defend most efficiently.
- PvP tournaments and leaderboards give this casual game a competitive edge.
- Discover countless upgrades, research, spells, artifacts, technology, and more to level up with a variety of different resources.
- Several rewarding mini-games, such as Peasant Mobs, Tank Swordsman, and Necromancer bosses.
- Non-stop, endless, auto battle, and idle gameplay!
- Incremental clicker, tap tap, and tycoon idle auto battler game mechanics.
- Fantasy RPG based world and classes.
- Tower defense and incremental TD game mechanics.
- Complete tons of daily missions and achievements.
- Idle offline progress and auto battle gold earnings reward you while the game is closed!
- Cute and colorful 3D fantasy graphics.

Idle Monster TD Evolved is the perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is an endless TD and can mostly auto battle and play itself without you watching. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards as the ultimate TD tycoon. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantasy world, tap to battle humans and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Monster TD Evolved!

GET THERE YOUR WAY — Curvy routes, beauty routes, unpaved adventures. Scenic finds the twistiest
bluejetty:00026925:ios.description:
TAKE THE SCENIC ROUTE — The app motorcycle riders swear by. 30 million hours ridden, 200,000+ user-designed routes, 4.7 star rating worldwide.
GET THERE YOUR WAY — Curvy routes, beauty routes, unpaved adventures. Scenic finds the twistiest roads automatically, anywhere in the world. You choose how to get there — the rest is just riding.
PLAN LIKE A PRO — Drop pins, set stops, pick your routing mode. Share your route with fellow riders before you even leave.
DISCOVER EPIC ROADS — Browse thousands of routes shared and rated by local riders. Search any area, generate a round trip, or import a GPX, Google Maps link, or KML file. All your routes, one app.
FOCUS ON THE ROAD — Turn-by-turn navigation, glove-friendly controls, and Apple CarPlay support keep your eyes up and hands on the bars. Speed camera alerts warn you before it matters. Road closures and traffic incidents show up right on the map so you're never caught off guard.
GO OFF GRID — Offline maps with global coverage. No signal, no problem. Ride anywhere.
RELIVE EVERY MILE — Scenic logs your speed, location, and elevation automatically. Add photos along the way. Track your stats over time and share your rides to social media.
* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
** Scenic has an optional yearly Premium Subscription with a free trial period, that gives you access to Premium Features (see scenic.app/premium for details). The subscription automatically renews after the free trial period. The first payment will be charged to your App Store Account at the end of your trial period. It automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by you, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings in the Apple App Store.
Speed camera data is provided by SCDB.info
Scenic's privacy policy: https://scenic.app/privacy-policy
Scenic's terms of use: https://scenic.app/terms

8player is an all-in-one video, music and photo player for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Stream, download and enjoy your favorite media anytime, anywhere.

• Smooth streaming from cloud storage, NAS devices and network servers
• Available on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV

• SMB network shares

• Local files on your device

• Images: heic, jpeg, png, gif, tiff and more

Challenge yourself with a variety of mind-bending levels, each with its own unique combination of baseplate layouts and block arrangements. Your objective is to strategically place the blocks on the baseplates to cover them completely and achieve a harmonious single color in each plate.

Immerse yourself in a world of endless possibilities as you unlock new levels and encounter increasingly complex puzzles. With intuitive touch controls, you can easily drag and drop the blocks onto the baseplates, experimenting with various combinations to find the perfect solution.


Features:
- Engaging gameplay: Arrange blocks on baseplates to cover them completely and create stunning color combinations.
- Challenging levels: Test your sorting skills with a wide range of puzzles, from simple to intricate designs.
- Vibrant visuals: Immerse yourself in a colorful world filled with eye-catching blocks and beautifully designed baseplates.
- Intuitive controls: Drag and drop blocks with ease, allowing for seamless gameplay and effortless creativity.
- Unlockable content: Progress through levels to unlock new themes, shapes, and colors, adding even more excitement to your sorting adventure.

Are you up for the block sorting challenge? Download Colorful Block Sort now and start your journey towards becoming a master of shapes and colors!

bluejetty:00127438:ios.description:
Fantasy AI art generator - AI help you generated dream art just by entering a text prompt. You can select one AI Art model between stable
diffusion and fantasy diffusion, AI Art will be generated soon. Feel the power of AI Art now!
How to start generate Art Ai works?
1. Use words to describe what you want to create, no matter what. Enter the words. Such as "undiscovered animal" "a panda in mechanical
armor". AI will generate AI Artworks.
2. Choose AI Art generated model, you can select one between stable, fantasy and anime.
3. Pick an AI Art style. Various style example for AI art. Intuitively see the effect through the picture. Must satisfy you with dream
art.
4. Click GENERATE button at the bottom of the screen, then see the process of AI artist use the power of AI to turn your words into
artworks.
What are the outstanding features of our products?
[Three Art models in One app]
Provides three Art models for you to generate your own style creations, different from other apps only have styles you can choose to
generate. Anime diffusion for generating anime style art. Fantasy diffusion for generating abstract colorful AI Art. Stable diffusion for
generating concrete reality AI Art. You can choose what you like!
[AI Chat & Interactive Stories]
New function - AI chat. We provide hundreds of trained character models. Enjoy creative and engaging conversations! Chat AI is designed to
provide an immersive and lifelike chat experience. Using cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology, our characters continuously
learn and evolve, ensuring dynamic and engaging interactions. If you like interactive stories or text adventure games, you can download
this app!
[Regenerate images depends on pictures]
New section coming now! Besides AI Art generator, you can use any pictures to generate artworks. Just like tt or dream, have fun with this
function. You can try different kind of pictures. Wonder how magic you will generate! Also you can choose the style you want to generate.
AI help you turn pictures into other style artworks. We will continue developing fun AI function for you, let AI be your assistant.
[Inspiration to generate AI artworks]
Adding a new section of gallery show, you can see more beautiful and creative pictures. You can use the prompt generate picture directly.
Not only that, we provide tips for you to optimize your prompt, keep you away from strange paintings.
Just as stable diffusion, midjourney and dalle 2. Fantasy is easy to use, even you don't have systematic painting teaching. Imagine a
screen in your head, describe it by texts, then entering the texts into Fantasy. AI will turn your thoughts into AI artworks. You can try
various inspirations. Also you can try "Open AI creator" "Alien disco diffusion" "Deep dream". You will get AI Art now.
[Personal gallery show]
Add a personal gallery, you can see all the historical production pictures, don't worry about not saving pictures.
[Use fantasy AI art]
After generating artwork, you can display it on social media, sell it as NFT artwork on OpenSea, Nifty Gateway, MakersPlace, Rarib and
other platforms, decorate it on daily necessities, and use it as a lock screen or wallpaper. The possibility of value extension is
infinite. Let's start exploring!
[Payment and subscription condition]
Select one of the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
weekly subscription
yearly subscription
You can unsubscribe at any time
AI Art Generator is popular all over the world, you can catch it by trying now!

bluejetty:00027259:ios.summary:

Rashaqa is an all-in-one health and fitness app that offers several advantages to its users. Among its features, the Calories Scanner stands out as a powerful tool for managing your diet and achiev
bluejetty:00027259:ios.description:
Rashaqa is an app for health and wellness
Rashaqa is an all-in-one health and fitness app that offers several advantages to its users. Among its features, the Calories Scanner stands out as a powerful tool for managing your diet and achieving your health goals. Here’s what you need to know:
Calorie Tracking:
Rashaqa provides you with a calorie tracker program for all your meals. Whether you’re following a specific diet plan, practicing intermittent fasting, or simply aiming for weight loss, this feature has you covered.
By accurately calculating the calories for each meal you consume, Rashaqa helps you stay on track with your dietary goals.
It also includes easy and quick healthy recipes suitable for various diets.
Healthy Diet Plans:
Specify your goal—whether it’s weight gain, weight loss, or muscle building—and Rashaqa will choose an appropriate meal plan for your health condition.
These meal plans have been thoughtfully developed by nutritionists who specialize in creating healthy diets tailored to individual needs.
With over 400 meal plans, you can customize your food choices and track your intake effectively.
Home Workouts:
Rashaqa offers a comprehensive home workout service. You’ll have your virtual fitness coach guiding you through fat-burning exercises.
Whether you’re aiming for weight loss or overall fitness, these home workouts are designed to help you achieve your goals.
Make the most of your fitness time with Rashaqa’s exercise plans. 
Steps Counter (Pedometer):
Rashaqa walks with you step by step, tracking and recording your steps and statistics.
Whether you’re walking or running, every step counts toward your overall activity level.
Water Alarm:
Staying hydrated is crucial during workouts. Rashaqa reminds you to drink water regularly to replenish lost fluids.
The app determines the appropriate water intake based on your weight and daily needs.
Additional Exercises:
Rashaqa provides various exercise options, including:
Treadmill: Calculate your steps using the step counter during treadmill workouts.
Stationary Bike: Burn calories and lose weight with fat-burning exercises at home.
Running in Place: A simple yet effective home exercise for weight loss.
In summary, Rashaqa combines calorie tracking, diet planning, home workouts, and step counting—all in one convenient app. Transform your health today with Rashaqa!
---
To review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
* Privacy Policy: https://rashaqa.net/privacy.html
* Terms of Use: https://rashaqa.net/TermsandConditions.html

✔ Do Not Disturb Mode
Silence notifications and calls for uninterrupted focus or relaxation.
✔ Screen Rotation Lock
Lock your screen orientation for a stable viewing experience, whether you're watching videos or reading.

This app uses ACCESSIBILITY SERVICES.
To provide the control center view on your device, this app requires accessibility service permissions. These permissions allow the app to display the control center overlay on the screen.
Additionally, to enable features such as music playback controls, adjusting the volume, or managing system dialog boxes, the app utilizes accessibility service functions like music control, volume control, and dialog management.
This app respects your privacy. No user information is collected, stored, or shared in connection with ACCESSIBILITY SERVICES. These permissions are solely used to enable the described features and enhance your experience.
- Usage Access: To monitor and manage running apps.
- Display over other apps: To show the standby screen when apps are forcibly closed.

bluejetty:00061421:ios.summary:

Easy sync and iPhone/iPad
bluejetty:00061421:ios.description:
EASY BUDGET. Cut your expenses with Money Pro®!
Expense tracker, budget planner & account manager - all in one app to get your finances under control. Money Pro works great for personal & family expense tracking.
Easy sync and iPhone/iPad versions combined in one app. Money Pro is the next generation of the Money app (over 2 million downloads worldwide).
FEATURES:
Simple and Secure
- widget for quick expense tracking on the go without launching the app: save your time
- quick and easy expense/income entries: save even more
- password & backups of your data
Income and Expense Tracker
- split transactions: split one payment into multiple categories, keep it all organized
- search by amount, category, description, payee, cheque number, etc
- recurring expenses with custom periodicity
- calendar for scheduling bills and expenses for the whole year ahead
- notifications & alerts for bills due
- tracking expenses with family members and cross-platform syncing* (PLUS or GOLD subscription required)
- multiple profiles for organized tracking of personal and family finances
- attachment of receipt (or any other) photos: keep important bills captured
Budget Planner
- flexible structure of categories & subcategories with over 1,500 built-in icons
- custom periodicity: start your budget from any date
- visual indicators for budget spending
- transaction list for each category: access your bills with ease 
- transferring the leftover of the previous budget period to the current one to limit your spending
- unique icons with your photos
Account Manager
- easy management of an unlimited number of accounts
- balance change history
- additional fields for organizing your records: payee, description, check #, class (personal/business travel expenses). 
- import of bank statements (files: OFX, CSV)
- online banking (GOLD subscription required)
Insightful Analytics
- eight different reports
- filter customization
- quick and easy date selection
Augmented Reality
- build three-dimensional charts right on your table with AR reports (GOLD subscription required)
Goals
- set your goals and achieve them
- visualize your goal progress with a trend chart
- four Goal types: Save money, Pay off debt, Reduce expenses, Increase income (GOLD subscription required for last three)
More
- calculator and currency converter
- print and export to PDF, QIF, CSV formats
- multiple currencies & automatic update of exchange rates
- support service & user guide (https://money.pro/guide/)
PLUS subscription
- 1 Month of PLUS: $4.99
GOLD subscription
- 1 Month of GOLD: $9.99
In all the countries (except the USA), actual charges will be converted to the local currency. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms & Privacy
- http://ibearsoft.com/privacy.html
- http://ibearsoft.com/terms.html
Money Pro is a Universal app. Pay once and use it on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
*See App Support for further details

bluejetty:00153928:ios.summary:
Master Your Emotions in the Ultimate Block Sorting Puzzle!
Gameplay Overview:
Step into the world of Face Sort: Mood Path, a one-of-a-kind puzzle game where sorting emotions is both a mental challenge and a relaxing escape. Your objective
bluejetty:00153928:ios.description:
Master Your Emotions in the Ultimate Block Sorting Puzzle!
Gameplay Overview:
Step into the world of Face Sort: Mood Path, a one-of-a-kind puzzle game where sorting emotions is both a mental challenge and a relaxing escape. Your objective is to organize mood blocks—each showing a distinct facial expression—into matching groups, restoring emotional harmony with each move. Ready to balance your emotions?
- An Emotional Jumble: At the start of each level, you’ll encounter mood blocks displaying a variety of expressions—happy, sad, angry, and more—arranged randomly across slots.
- Organize the Moods: Your mission is to sort these mood blocks by grouping identical emotions together in separate slots.
- Simple But Strategic Rules:
 - Blocks can only be moved onto another block with the same mood or into an empty slot.
 - Ensure that the target slot has enough space for the blocks you’re moving.
 - Plan carefully to avoid getting stuck—strategy and foresight are your best allies!
Key Features:
- Emotion Sorting Challenge: Tackle hundreds of levels that test your ability to sort and manage diverse emotional expressions.
- Relax and Reorganize: The soothing gameplay is designed to help you unwind while you focus on organizing emotions.
- Visually Expressive: Each block features beautifully crafted faces and smooth animations, displaying a variety of moods with vibrant colors.
- Progressive Complexity: As you advance, the difficulty ramps up, keeping the gameplay fresh and challenging your problem-solving skills.
- Winning Streaks and Rewards: Keep your win streak alive to unlock special rewards and enhance your overall gameplay experience.
Theme:
Immerse yourself in the world of emotional balance with Face Sort: Mood Path. The game offers a serene retreat, where the act of sorting emotions leads to inner peace and clarity. With calming visuals and a tranquil soundtrack, each level is a mindful journey, designed to help you find harmony within both the game and yourself.
Are you ready to bring order to your emotions? Download Face Sort: Mood Path now and embark on your journey towards emotional mastery through mindful block Master Your Emotions in the Ultimate Block Sorting Puzzle!

A simple and intuitive application for financial management and cash control. Developed to streamline the tracking of your cash flow and daily expenses, this application is an indispensable tool for both businesses and individuals.
Efficiently manage all your daily income and expense transactions with our simple cash book. bluejetty:00077072:ios.description:
Webster Five Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Webster Five Mobile:
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Webster Five Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Webster Five Cents Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
