bluejetty:00025417:ios.summary:
Tired of tapping the same buttons, scrolling through the same feeds, and filling the same forms every single day? Your phone should handle that. Now it can.
Record your browser actions once and replay them on autopilot. No coding. No jailb
bluejetty:00025417:ios.description:
Tired of tapping the same buttons, scrolling through the same feeds, and filling the same forms every single day? Your phone should handle that. Now it can.
Record your browser actions once and replay them on autopilot. No coding. No jailbreak. Just tap Record, do your thing, and let Auto Clicker repeat it for you.
Or just describe what you need in plain words, and let AI build it for you.
◆ NEW: CREATE WITH AI
Tap Create with AI and describe your task in your own words. AI builds the steps for you.
● Just one example: "Refresh every 30 seconds until the Buy button appears, then tap it"
● Describe almost anything you do over and over on a website, and AI turns it into an automation
● Keep chatting to refine it, and the steps update as you go
● You stay in control: review every step and run a test before you tap Save
● Edit with AI changes saved automations too: "Make it slower" or "Repeat until I stop it"
● AI-built automations can tap, scroll, swipe, type, wait, repeat, and check what's on a page
No account needed. Just open the app and describe your task.
◆ WHAT YOU CAN AUTOMATE
● Auto-scroll through articles, news feeds, or social media
● Auto-refresh pages to catch limited drops and open slots
● Auto-tap through idle games and web-based clickers
● Auto-fill forms on any website
● Chain multiple actions into powerful multi-step sequences
● Set custom speeds, delays, and repeat counts
◆ HOW IT WORKS
1. Open any website in the built-in browser
2. Tap Record and perform your actions normally
3. Stop recording, name it, and save
4. Hit Play anytime to run it hands-free
Choose to run once, repeat 2x, 5x, or loop until you stop it.
◆ VISUAL AUTOMATION BUILDER
Prefer to build step-by-step? Use the visual builder to create automations from scratch. Add taps, scrolls, swipes, wait conditions, loops, and if-then logic. Reorder, duplicate, and fine-tune your actions.
◆ COMMUNITY PRESETS
Browse ready-made automations shared by thousands of users. Download and run them instantly, or share your own. The only auto clicker with a built-in community marketplace.
◆ BUILT-IN BROWSER
Full browser with smart URL bar, search suggestions, browsing history, and back/forward navigation. Your automations run seamlessly inside it. We never sell your data.
◆ PLANS
Choose Pro, Max, or Business to unlock Auto Clicker. Pro includes advanced actions, cloud sync, and weekly allowances for automations, runs, and requests to the AI. Max and Business raise those limits even further.
◆ 31 LANGUAGES SUPPORTED
Use the app in your language. Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, and 20 more.
Automate the repetitive. Reclaim your time.
For support: contact-us@meliorapps.org
Terms of Service: https://www.meliorapps.org/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.meliorapps.org/privacy-policy

Calculus doodlus keeps your calculations visible, line by line. Read them back, continue where you left off, or go back and change any number.
• Edit, copy & link
Touch and hold any number to edit it. Tap a line to reuse its value, or double-tap to link it to another calculation and keep the values in sync.
• Percentages & VAT
Calculate percentages or deduct VAT with ease. The calculation remains visible, so you can see exactly how the result was obtained.

Your pages are saved automatically. Keep recent calculations, pin important ones, rename and share them, and switch between pages with a swipe.
• Big numbers, exact results
Every operation is performed digit by digit, the same way you learned in school. That's how Calculus doodlus handles very large numbers while keeping exact results on the page.
• Make it your own
Customize the keyboard color and replace its digits with your own handwriting. Add Calculus doodlus to your Lock Screen or Control Center for one-tap access.

Stay ahead of the weather with 14 Day Weather Forecast, your ultimate weather companion for any plans—whether it’s a weekend getaway, sports event, or outdoor fun. Get real-time updates and a detailed 14-day forecast to keep you prepared, no matter what.

Turn your phone into a live weather display with stunning HD wallpaper backgrounds that match the current weather. From calming ocean waves to dramatic thunderclouds, bring the forecast to life right on your screen. Perfect for your nightstand, office desk, or even the living room.

Key Features:
+ NEW: Live weather radar with animated rain and snow
+ NEW: Official severe weather alerts with push notifications
+ NEW: Hurricane tracker map
+ NEW: Rain alerts before the first drop
+ 14-Day and Hourly Forecasts with accurate, up-to-the-minute weather info
+ Live Weather Wallpaper with beautiful HD backgrounds that change with the weather
+ Detailed Current Conditions including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and moon phase
+ Swipe Between Cities to easily check weather in your favorite spots
+ Supports Fahrenheit/mph and Celsius/kmh
+ Auto Location Detection or add your cities manually

Bonus Features:
+ HD weather wallpaper for current or random weather scenes
+ Perfect Nightstand Companion with a sleep timer for relaxing nighttime scenes
+ Shake-to-Flashlight for quick access when you need it
+ Option to hide the forecast for full-screen weather scenes

Download now and bring the weather to life with real-time updates, detailed forecasts, and beautiful live wallpaper.

bluejetty:00129530:ios.description:
Welcome to My Bar, Unleash Your Inner Bartender with the Ultimate Cocktail Companion!
Your go-to app for discovering and crafting delicious cocktails right at home. Whether you're a cocktail enthusiast eager to explore new recipes or a professional bartender refining your mixology skills, My Bar brings a world of drinks to your fingertips.
Why Choose My Bar?
* Explore Hundreds of Drink Recipes: Dive into a vast collection of cocktail recipes, from timeless classics to innovative new mixes. Whether you're in the mood for a simple highball or an intricate craft concoction, our library has you covered. Search by name or the spirits you love.
* Easy-to-Follow Guides: Our detailed instructions ensure that mixing your favorite drinks is simple and fun, no matter your experience level. Achieve perfect results every time and impress your friends with your bartending skills.
* Filter by Your Ingredients: My Bar’s unique filtering system allows you to input the ingredients you have on hand, offering you a personalized selection of recipes you can make without needing a trip to the store. It's like having a virtual bartender at your disposal.
* Learn and Grow: Elevate your mixology knowledge with My Bar Tutorials.
* Favorite and Track: Save your preferred recipes in a custom list for quick access later. Rate and review your experiments, helping you remember which concoctions you loved most.
* Regular Updates & User-Friendly Design: We continuously enrich My Bar with the latest cocktail trends, seasonal specials, and user-requested features. Coupled with our sleek, intuitive interface, you're set for an unparalleled cocktail crafting experience.
Transform your home into the ultimate cocktail bar with My Bar. Download now and start crafting your next extraordinary drink. Cheers!
We would love to hear your feedback. 
Get in touch if there are any features you would love to add to the app. Drop us an email at - hello@getmybar.co.uk

Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. bluejetty:00017934:ios.name: Freedom FCU Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00017934:ios.summary: The Freedom FCU Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so
bluejetty:00017934:ios.description:
The Freedom FCU Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Freedom Federal Credit Union customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Freedom FCU Mobile Banking App, you must be enrolled as a Freedom Federal Credit Union Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00179996:ios.name: Engine Link - OBD II diagnosis
bluejetty:00179996:ios.summary: EngineLink will turn your iPhone/iPod into vehicle / car performance / diagnostics tool and scanner that uses an OBD II WIFI adapter or a low Energy Bluetooth adapter (LELink, LELink2, Carista, Viecar) to connect to your OBD2 engine managem
bluejetty:00179996:ios.description:
EngineLink will turn your iPhone/iPod into vehicle / car performance / diagnostics tool and scanner that uses an OBD II WIFI adapter or a low Energy Bluetooth adapter (LELink, LELink2, Carista, Viecar) to connect to your OBD2 engine management / ECU.
The only iPhone app does custom PID, now supports Torque custom PID file. 
BENEFITS:
* Emission Test.
* See what your car is doing in real-time.
* Read and clear OBD fault codes.
* Display car performance and sensor data.
* Customizable gauges, showing only the data you were interested in
* Top Ranked Car App
* No in-app purchase and No subscription fees!
__________________
FEATURES:
+ Show and reset a DTC / CEL / fault code (current, pending and history) like a scan tool
+ Graph data
+ MPG widget to plot real time fuel efficiency
+ Heads up display / HUD mode for night time driving (mirror the display on your vehicle's windshield)
+ Can read Transmission Temperatures (vehicle dependant)
+ Horsepower/HP & Torque / acceleration 
+ Boost / vacuum gauge 
+ Engine speed / Engine RPM / Engine Load /Coolant / Fuel Tank 
+ Customizable dashboard 
+ Full configurable GUI with user choice of dial gauge, bar gauge, plot gauge, digital gauge, and on-off gauge as display elements
+ Full custom PID support.
+ Formula support. 
+ Preloaded GM and Ford PID libraries
+ Preloaded standard PID library and Prius PID libraries .
+ User can add more libraries within the app or by using iTunes File Sharing
+ Multiple ECU support. Non-CAN, 11-bit CAN, and 29-bit CAN ECU bus types
+ Multiframe data support
+ Background color option
+ Email user log function (access by long pressing custom PID screen) 
+ Multiple PID formula support
+ 0 to 60mph timer and quarter mile timer
__________________
EngineLink supports all OBD-II and EOBD compliant vehicles sold worldwide. If in doubt check with your manufacturer first or look for 'OBD2' on written on a big white label in your engine bay.
The app needs an ELM compatible Bluetooth Low Energy (for iPhone4s and later) or Wi-Fi adapter to work.
You can check Developer WebSite for Adapter Guide: http://www.outdoor-apps.com/enginelink.html
*** If you have Bluetooth OBD adaptor, please contact support@ksolution.org for instruction before you purchase this app.
Drop us an email for any suggestions/questions you may have at support@ksolution.org. We will answer.

Penguin Diner is an engaging and addictive idle restaurant game where you are running a restaurant and serving food and drinks to customers. 
Penny the penguin got lost, and she found herself on the icy mountain. She need money and she found a job as a waitress. Her goal is to get back to Antarctica as soon as possible. Help her to along better in the restaurant dash - Slide fast & become a dining legend! 
Learn with Penny, earn and upgrade skills & facilities. Manage the restaurant - Slide and serve the penguin customers!
The #1 ORIGINAL SMASH HIT web game - Penguin Diner is finally here - on MOBILE and it's 100% FREE!
Main features of Penguin Diner - Restaurant Dash:
- Penguin slide adventure - Slide through tables fast while taking orders and serving customers.
- 3 exciting diners - As Penny grows as a waitress and upgrades her skills, she will move to another restaurant where she can earn more money. There are 3 diners, 3 restaurant stories, that she has to master before she achieves the ultimate goal.
- Penguin shop - Get a cool upgrade with the money that you earn. Any available help on the way to becoming the dining legend!
- Comic-style storyline - Gives you an additional feeling of enjoyment!
- Restaurant dash - As you progress the levels, the rush becomes more challenging and you will have to use all available resources and upgrades to achieve goals.
- AutoSave - You don`t have to worry about your progress being deleted. It is autosaved, and each time you enter the game, you will be asked if you want to continue where you left off.

Take the order and serve on time - Keep customers happy! It will help you to earn more money, upgrade your restaurant, and move forward to Penny's goal - Return to Antarctica!
Make it more comfortable for your penguin customers and take your idle restaurant business to the next level.
Hill Top Cafe - The place where your dream restaurant story starts! Get to the Ice Rink and Iceberg Cafe in the polar journey full of excitement!
Download the Penguin Diner Restaurant Dash and help Penny earn enough money to get her home to her family! Enjoy one of the best penguin slide games. Build a successful idle restaurant story and become a dining legend!

ACCURATE LOCATION TRACKER
Be Closer - it is a smart way to track your kids, parents and family members' location. By using Be Closer location tracking app you can know the real-time whereabouts of loved ones. You add people you want to track, and if they accept, you can then see their whereabouts on the map. Stay connected with your close ones at all times with Be Closer location tracker.
KIDS & TEENS location tracker - extremely helpful app for parents
Real-time location tracker is an ideal solution for parents who worry too much. Use Be Closer and be sure your kids are safe. Sometimes your kids can’t answer the phone for one reason or another. Be Closer helps you to know where they are.
Knowing that your child is at school helps you save some nerves. 
Track YOUNG DRIVERS
Make sure your young drivers get to school safely without constantly texting them every few hours. It's a huge piece of mind. In other words, location tracker will make your overprotective heart happy while still giving your teens independence.
No more worrying!
Track your FAMILY around the world
Now you can manage the whole family easily, know where your mom or dad is and where to find them. No need to send text messages asking “When will you be home?” The Be Closer tells you!
CELLPHONE
Track the real-time location of a device, know exactly where your lost or stolen phone is and get it back (you can find your phone easily using a family member’s registered phone).
Note: Be Closer must be installed on the phone that you want to track.
PLACES
Add places and get notified when your family members arrive and leave.
Emergency SOS function 
You can send a signal to your relatives if you need emergency help. The emergency SOS function allows you to alert all family members that you need help.

- add your relative's phone number to the app;
- click the SOS button if you need emergency help;
- your relative will receive a signal for help and see a live update of your geolocation.

- Location history: you can see the past whereabouts of someone
- Location sharing settings: you can turn on/off location sharing whenever you want

bluejetty:00084237:ios.description:
The Interton Sound app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change programs, make sound adjustments and save them as favorites. The app helps you learn what you can do and how to do it. It can even help you find your hearing aids if you lose them. 
Notes: Please contact your local Interton representative for product and feature availability in your market. We recommend that the hearing aids run the latest software version. If in doubt, please contact your hearing care professional.
Interton Sound mobile device compatibility: 
Please consult the Interton app website for up-to-date compatibility information: www.interton.com/compatibility-connectivity. 
Use the Interton Sound app to: 
• Adjust volume settings on your hearing aids
• Mute your hearing aids
• Adjust volume of your Interton streaming accessories
• Change manual and streamer programs
• Edit and personalize program names 
• Adjust treble, middle and bass tones to your preferences
• Save your preferred settings as a Favorite – you can even tag to a location
• Help locate lost or misplaced hearing aids
• Adjust sound variation and frequency of the Tinnitus Sound Generator (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
For more information and help, please visit www.interton.com/sound.

bluejetty:00016546:ios.description:
A dream come true! Your own horse to care for and ride - anytime you want! In the animal simulation "HorseWorld: My Riding Horse" from Tivola you care for your new darling so that you can master every course in the riding ring and crack the high scores together!
NURTURE FROM HEAD TO HOOF
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
There are lots of things to pay attention to so that you ensure that your horse is healthy! Grooming is just as important as the correct handling of the hooves. Clear the pen out thoroughly, make sure there's fresh food and don't forget to pet the horse now and then. And while doing this you learn how to care for your horse and you make sure that it has enough energy to get through the day! Perfect for all horse and pony friends.
IN THE PURSUIT OF RECORD TIME
In "HorseWorld: My Riding Horse" the point of the game happens in the riding ring: You have to prove your ability as a team on various obstacle courses. You learn bit by bit - with the instructions from the riding instructor - how to correctly lead your horse and complete every course as best as possible. Can you find the perfect route in your pursuit of a new record time?
IMPRESSIVE GRAPHICS AND INTUITIVE CONTROLS
With one finger swipe you move yourself over the equestrian center and switch between the locations. Thanks to the realistic graphics all your wishes are fulfilled and navigation becomes child's play. On the back of your horse you can almost feel his steps and to change the direction you only have to tilt the device correspondingly. And so you go up and over every obstacle with a waving tail.
JUMP COURSES, RIDE INTO THE COUNTRYSIDE AND EVEN MORE COURSES
"HorseWorld: My Riding Horse" includes your horse, the stable and the riding ring with lots of courses. When you want new challenges, you can unlock upgrades via in-app purchases. You can access the "jump course" with many obstacles, more runs for the riding ring or go on a trail with "ride in the countryside."

ATracker is a simple yet very powerful time tracking app and productivity tool that allows you to use it with minimal setup. Having a track of your precious time has never been easier with our one-tap to start/stop time tracking. As the leading time tracking app, ATracker also offers bar or pie charts showcasing where your time went.
Lots of features for self-development 
The fully customizable user interface allows you to turn this habit tracker into your own. The tracking app also comes with the option of categorizing tasks with tags; data export; sync data between multiple devices for the shortest path towards self-improvement and the perfect boost of productivity.
It's a fresh way to organize your day and make the most out of it … with just a few taps.
SCOPE
ATracker is a clean and minimalistic approach to,
• Track time of different tasks and projects at work
• Track time of School studies and projects
• Track time of Exercises
• Track time of Socializing
• Track time of Homemaking tasks
• Track time of Baby or child daily activities
• Hobby projects
• Or any activity people want to track and control
We believe that time tracking should be effortless. 
Here are some of the key features ATracker offers
• Start and stop tracking a task with just one tap.
• Overview of today's time spending on the Today tab.
• Interactive goal system for self-improvement.
• Complete activity log. Show activities on any given date. Add missed or modify existing activity.
• Customization of activities with hundreds of unique icons to choose from. You can also color code the activities for a personalized time tracking experience. 
• Ability to keep notes for each task entry.
• Statistics showed in bar charts and pie charts.
• Group tasks by tags and allow users to filter tasks by tag on the Today tab, as well as aggregate the data by tag in reporting.
• The activity timer does not stop even when the application is not running, or your mobile is in sleep mode.
• Set alarm for activities. The alarm will sound even when the app is not running.
• Widget to see your data on-screen at all times.
• Gesture support
• Full customization of UI with more skins and allow the user to use their own image as background.
PRO FEATURES 
With an only one-time investment, you will get to enjoy,
- No Ads.
- Unlimited tasks
- Data export with PDF and CSV file.
- Able to keep notes for each task entry. 
- Full customization of UI with more skins and allow user to use own image as background.
WEB SUBSCRIPTION
With web subscription, ATracker supports sync across multiple devices. It also provides web access to ATracker services besides the app. This add-on is optional.

Privacy Policy: https://atracker.pro/atracker_policy_APP.html

listings.name: ATracker Time Tracker
listings.description:
Life is precious and so is your time. And keeping that in mind, ATracker is here to help you achieve more of your goals, build a sustainable habit, and boost your productivity to a new height.

ATracker is a simple yet very powerful time tracking app and productivity tool that allows you to use it with minimal setup. Having a track of your precious time has never been easier with our one-tap to start/stop time tracking. As the leading time tracking app, ATracker also offers bar or pie charts showcasing where your time went.

Lots of features for self-development 
The fully customizable user interface allows you to turn this habit tracker into your own. The tracking app also comes with the option of categorizing tasks with tags; data export; sync data between multiple devices for the shortest path towards self-improvement and the perfect boost of productivity.

It's a fresh way to organize your day and make the most out of it … with just a few taps.

SCOPE

ATracker is a clean and minimalistic approach to,
•	Track time of different tasks and projects at work
•	Track time of School studies and projects
•	Track time of Exercises
•	Track time of Socializing
•	Track time of Homemaking tasks
•	Track time of Baby or child daily activities
•	Hobby projects
•	Or any activity people want to track and control

We believe that time tracking should be effortless. 

Here are some of the key features ATracker offers

•	Start and stop tracking a task with just one tap.
•	Overview of today's time spending on the Today tab.
•	Interactive goal system for self-improvement.
•	Complete activity log. Show activities on any given date. Add missed or modify existing activity.
•	Customization of activities with hundreds of unique icons to choose from. You can also color code the activities for a personalized time tracking experience. 
•	Ability to keep notes for each task entry.
•	Statistics showed in bar charts and pie charts.
•	Group tasks by tags and allow users to filter tasks by tag on the Today tab, as well as aggregate the data by tag in reporting.
•	The activity timer does not stop even when the application is not running, or your mobile is in sleep mode.
•	Set alarm for activities. The alarm will sound even when the app is not running.
•	Widget to see your data on-screen at all times.
•	Gesture support
•	Full customization of UI with more skins and allow the user to use their own image as background.

PRO FEATURES 

With an only one-time investment, you will get to enjoy,
- No Ads.
- Unlimited tasks
- Data export with PDF and CSV file.
- Able to keep notes for each task entry. 
- Full customization of UI with more skins and allow user to use own image as background.

WEB SUBSCRIPTION
With web subscription, ATracker supports sync across multiple devices. It also provides web access to ATracker services besides the app. This add-on is optional.
• ATracker subscriptions purchased in-app renew monthly or yearly depending on your plan. Plan pricing may vary by country.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

SUPPORT
Visit https://support.wonderapps.se or contact us at support@wonderapps.se

Privacy Policy: https://atracker.pro/atracker_policy_APP.html

Welcome to My Town Fire Station and play a lot of rescue games!
bluejetty:00070921:ios.description:
Do you see a fire and smell the smoke? Jump on the firetruck and drive to an emergency rescue mission! Play and discover many new missions in this firefighter game for kids! 
Welcome to My Town Fire Station and play a lot of rescue games! Be the best firefighter and drive your fire truck out of the fire station around the town! My Town firefighter games for kids are full of fun!
TAKE 911 EMERGENCY CALL AND GET READY FOR ACTION
Is that 911 Emergency call coming from the fire station control room? No problem! My Town city firefighter heroes are ready to go for a rescue game mission and help citizens! Extinguish fire in My Town fire station games, help kids on the street and be a My Town fireman HERO! Enjoy My Town Firefighter games and learn about fireman life – an amazing firefighter simulator for kids!
MY TOWN FIREFIGHTER GAMES FOR KIDS – BE A FIREMAN HERO!
Be a city firefighter hero and drive a fire truck, an ambulance car, or pilot a helicopter! Play My Town ambulance games and explore the city, looking for some rescue games! Play and discover where help is needed and enjoy firetruck games for kids!
FIRE STATION – PLAY FIRE TRUCK GAMES FOR KIDS!
Take city Firefighters heroes and paramedics into the mission and help My Town citizens! Be the firefighter hero that My Town needs! All you need is the courage and to be brave to complete the rescue games missions!
Siren in Fire Station? Dress up your fireman in his protective gear, jump into the fire truck, and let’s go! Be ready as there are many locations in this role-playing game for children!
FIREFIGHTER, FIRE STATION & FIRETRUCK GAMES FOR KIDS FEATURES:
- 9 locations: Fire Station mission control room, fireman kitchen, ambulance, gym, fire truck garage, and more in this fire rescue games for kids!
- By playing our rescue games, kids will learn a lot about safety
- Pilot the helicopter or drive a fire truck as a Firefighter! 
- Run over the city with an ambulance car!
- New clothes in this emergency fire game – choose your favorite firefighter costume
- 911 Emergency call ringing? Better answer the call and get ready for the rescue game mission!
- Multi-Touch: play with friends on the same device
- Save a kitten, extinguish a fire and play firefighter games with fun!
- Explore and discover all Fire Station rooms!
- Firefighter simulator – enjoy rescue games for kids!
MY TOWN – FUN FIREFIGHTER GAMES
Each rescue game mission will help your kid to be more creative and to learn a lot about safety! Use the fire extinguisher and fight against fire in My Town! Save lives in this amazing game for little kids!
Challenge your family for a ping pong game in the fire station? Or take them out on a helicopter flight! Isn’t that so cool? All is possible in My Town firefighter games for kids – many 911 emergency games to play all day!
MY TOWN Fire Station - be a Fireman HERO and enjoy a firefighter simulator for kids!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
My Town firefighter game is for kids 4-12. My Town fire truck games for kids are safe to play even when parents are out of the room

The My Town Games studio designs digital doll house games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com

bluejetty:00175072:ios.name: Talli Baby Tracker Newborn Log
bluejetty:00175072:ios.summary: Talli Baby Tracker is the most flexible and convenient infant feeding, diaper, and sleep tracking app. Keep track of everything parents want to know and pediatricians ask about for infants and newborns. And Talli Baby Tracker is the only tr
bluejetty:00175072:ios.description:
Talli Baby Tracker is the most flexible and convenient infant feeding, diaper, and sleep tracking app. Keep track of everything parents want to know and pediatricians ask about for infants and newborns. And Talli Baby Tracker is the only tracking app you can customize for your family's exact needs. Track meds, bath time, tummy time, Vitamin D drops – even baby's mood or meds for mom. 
Share with family & caregivers
Easily add a partner/spouse, grandparents, nannies and other caregivers, even pediatricians and lactation or sleep consultants to keep everyone on the same page. Everyone added to your app account can login to the app from their own phones and see/manage everything in real time. 
Customize to your family's exact needs
Talli Baby Tracker is the only tracking app that is 100% configurable. Use it for your infant / newborn, and continue using it as your baby grows! 
* Track only the things you need. Not feeding solid food yet? Change that button to track bath time! Or Vitamin D drops. 
* Not breastfeeding or pumping anymore? Change those buttons to track medications or phototherapy. 
* Special medical needs? (Feeding tube, breathing treatments, etc.) Talli Baby can be configured to track exactly what you need. 
* Track solid food introduction, potty training, even daily chores as your child grows into a toddler and even a big kid!
* If there's something you want to track, and you don't see an icon for it, let us know and we'll add one! 
Track Feedings
* Start and stop nursing / breastfeeding timers by side and by full nursing session
* Start and stop pumping timers by side or both sides at once
* Track amount pumped by side and by full pumping session
* Log bottle feedings with specific contents (formula, breastmilk, etc.)
* Default settings for bottles so if you typically feed the same contents and amount, the app will prepopulate those for new bottle feedings. 
* Solid food tracker
* Add notes to any feeding event to capture formula brand, preferences, allergic reactions, etc. 
Track Diaper Changes
* Track wet diapers, dirty diapers, and mixed diapers
* Stay ahead of potential concerns like dehydration, constipation, and other digestive issues
* Share info on bowel and urination habits with doctors and other caregivers
* Add a photo to any event
Sleep Schedule
* Track when your baby goes to sleep and when they wake 
* See sleep cycles and wake windows to shape a healthy sleep schedule
* Understand the patterns of your baby's sleep to help everyone get the sleep they need
* Set up reminders for when it's time to put baby down for a nap or bedtime
* See feeding, diaper and sleep trends to identify correlations between feedings and sleep
Data Sharing
* Invite as many family members, caregivers, and providers as you want to access your baby's info
* Export your data to a csv file anytime 
* Data is always up-to-date in everyone's view no matter who logged it or from what device
* Email or text any data view to yourself or a loved one or provider
* Quickly identify patterns, trends, habits and anomalies or differences from the norm
Milestones & Journal
* Capture photos and milestones like first smile, first laugh, first steps, 
* Keep health info and doctor's appointment info
* Enter notes in our daily Journal anytime
* Export your data to a csv file anytime 
Log hands-free!
* If you have an Amazon Echo device, log by voice with our free Alexa integration
* Available under "Talli Baby" in the Skills store
One-touch Device Available
Talli Baby Tracker is the only tracking app with a one-touch hardware device available to use with the app. 
* Log any event with a single button press 
* Fast and easy for sleep deprived parents at middle-of-the-night feedings and diaper changes
* Simple and intuitive for nannies, grandparents, and other caregivers
* The device uses Wi-Fi to send data to the app even when your phone is not nearby 
Terms of Use: https://talli.me/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00179624:ios.name: BeatMaker 3
bluejetty:00179624:ios.summary:
▸ REDEFINING MUSIC PRODUCTION
BeatMaker brings unmatched efficiency and depth in an intuitive audio and MIDI workstation.
Look no further, the power of traditional desktop software and real hardware is now united into one single production
bluejetty:00179624:ios.description:
▸ REDEFINING MUSIC PRODUCTION
BeatMaker brings unmatched efficiency and depth in an intuitive audio and MIDI workstation.
Look no further, the power of traditional desktop software and real hardware is now united into one single production studio.
▸ PLAY • PERFORM • RECORD
Its streamlined workflow lets you perform and shape your ideas quickly and effectively, turning your instruments into full productions. Inspirational performance tools such as repeat, roll, swing, key scales & chords and macro controls will boost your creativity tenfold.
Take control of it all with your MIDI gear and the new smart binding system.
▸ CRAFT YOUR OWN INSTRUMENTS
128 banks of 128 pads, where each one of them is a full-fledged instrument with multiple dimensions. 
Record and chop live, assemble, mangle and resample: our state of the art sampling engine will sculpt your ideas, giving life to your instruments with a full modulation and layering system.
With ZPlane’s Elastique live stretch and pitch shift, adjust your loops and instruments to match the tempo or go experimental.
You can even integrate your favorite synth & effect apps with full AUv3 and IAA support.
▸ PRECISE SEQUENCING
The classic timeline based pattern & song editor gives all the modern sequencing features you‘d want to arrange complete tracks.
Adding to this foundation, the new flexible Scene Mode opens up opportunities for remixing and live performances, looping and arranging clips in new ways.
All the patterns, automations and sequencing tools are available right where you would expect.
Add audio tracks to the mix, stretch them, turn your arrangements into a complete masterpiece.
You can even play in sync with other software using Ableton Link.
▸ INSPIRATIONAL LIBRARY
The ever growing sound store will bring premium and exclusive content to your own library. The genius of our sound designers will enhance your productions instantly, whether you’re looking for a classic 808 bass or exploring new musical genres.
▸ FULL FLEDGED MIXER
Multi-channel recording & input/output routing is now a reality with the support of USB audio interfaces. Fine-tune your mix with the modern mixing board: every track, every pad has its own channel with unlimited effects and up to 8 sends.
Add new depths to your sound with our palette of effects (internal or external AUv3/IAA).
▸ EXPORT AND SHARE
Export your compositions and separated elements into single stems to share, re-use, re-work, re-master within a traditional studio setup
Read the full specs on http://intua.net !
▸ COMPATIBILITY

▸ REDEFINING MUSIC PRODUCTION

BeatMaker brings unmatched efficiency and depth in an intuitive audio and MIDI workstation.
Look no further, the power of traditional desktop software and real hardware is now united into one single production studio.


▸ PLAY • PERFORM • RECORD
 
Its streamlined workflow lets you perform and shape your ideas quickly and effectively, turning your instruments into full productions. Inspirational performance tools such as repeat, roll, swing, key scales & chords and macro controls will boost your creativity tenfold.
Take control of it all with your MIDI gear and the new smart binding system.


▸ CRAFT YOUR OWN INSTRUMENTS

128 banks of 128 pads, where each one of them is a full-fledged instrument with multiple dimensions. 

Record and chop live, assemble, mangle and resample: our state of the art sampling engine will sculpt your ideas, giving life to your instruments with a full modulation and layering system.
With ZPlane’s Elastique live stretch and pitch shift, adjust your loops and instruments to match the tempo or go experimental.
You can even integrate your favorite synth & effect apps with full AUv3 and IAA support.


▸ PRECISE SEQUENCING

The classic timeline based pattern & song editor gives all the modern sequencing features you‘d want to arrange complete tracks.
Adding to this foundation, the new flexible Scene Mode opens up opportunities for remixing and live performances, looping and arranging clips in new ways.

All the patterns, automations and sequencing tools are available right where you would expect.
Add audio tracks to the mix, stretch them, turn your arrangements into a complete masterpiece.

You can even play in sync with other software using Ableton Link.


▸ INSPIRATIONAL LIBRARY

The ever growing sound store will bring premium and exclusive content to your own library. The genius of our sound designers will enhance your productions instantly, whether you’re looking for a classic 808 bass or exploring new musical genres.


▸ FULL FLEDGED MIXER

Multi-channel recording & input/output routing is now a reality with the support of USB audio interfaces. Fine-tune your mix with the modern mixing board: every track, every pad has its own channel with unlimited effects and up to 8 sends.
Add new depths to your sound with our palette of effects (internal or external AUv3/IAA).


▸ EXPORT AND SHARE

Export your compositions and separated elements into single stems to share, re-use, re-work, re-master within a traditional studio setup

bluejetty:00187135:ios.name: Timeero GPS Time Tracking
bluejetty:00187135:ios.summary: Track employee hours, verify job-site attendance, and record business mileage with Timeero, a GPS time tracking app built for mobile teams. Simplify time tracking, improve workforce visibility, and spend less time chasing missing informatio
bluejetty:00187135:ios.description:
Track employee hours, verify job-site attendance, and record business mileage with Timeero, a GPS time tracking app built for mobile teams. Simplify time tracking, improve workforce visibility, and spend less time chasing missing information.
When employees work across multiple job sites, missed clock-ins, inaccurate timesheets, and manual mileage logs make payroll harder than it needs to be. Timeero helps you track work hours, verify attendance with GPS, and keep your team's time and mileage records organized.
Connect Timeero to compatible AI assistants through our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to get answers from your workforce data using everyday language.
GPS TIME TRACKING
Give employees an easy-to-use time clock app to clock in and out from their mobile devices. Review recorded hours and GPS data to help identify discrepancies before payroll. Use Timeero as a work hours tracker to simplify timesheet reviews and reduce manual corrections.
GPS TRACKING & GEOFENCING
See where your mobile team works and verify job-site attendance. Set up geofences around work locations and receive clock-in and clock-out reminders when employees arrive at or leave a job site.
AUTOMATIC CLOCK-IN & CLOCK-OUT
Reduce missed punches with geofence-based automatic clock-in and clock-out. With supported settings, employees can automatically record their time when they arrive at or leave a job site.
BUSINESS MILEAGE TRACKING
Use Timeero as a mileage tracker to record work-related miles and maintain mileage records for reimbursement. The business mileage tracker features help you review mileage reports, reduce manual calculations, and document business travel.
AI-POWERED WORKFORCE INSIGHTS WITH MCP
Get more from your Timeero data by connecting it to compatible AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Ask questions in everyday language and retrieve supported workforce information without manually searching through reports.
For example, ask about employee hours or recorded mileage to find the information you need faster. Available answers depend on the data and queries supported by the integration.
EMPLOYEE SCHEDULING
Create schedules, assign shifts, and notify employees through the app or email. Keep your team informed about where they need to be and when they're expected to work.
SEE WHO'S WORKING
Get a clearer picture of your team's workday from the web dashboard. Review employee locations, recorded hours, and job activity without constantly calling or messaging employees for updates.
IN-APP MESSAGING
Keep your team connected with in-app messaging. Communicate with employees directly through Timeero to share updates, coordinate work, and keep everyone informed while they're on the go.
TIMESHEET REPORTS FOR PAYROLL
Review recorded hours and mileage in one place. Generate reports to help prepare payroll, check time records, and reduce manual data entry.
OFFLINE TIME TRACKING
Working in an area with poor cellular coverage? Employees can continue using supported time tracking features offline. Their changes sync to the cloud when connectivity returns.
WEB DASHBOARD
Manage employees, jobs, schedules, reports, and business settings from the Timeero web dashboard.
SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
Get help with setup and product questions through Timeero's phone, email, and chat support.
Whether you manage construction crews, property maintenance teams, cleaning staff, or home care workers, Timeero helps you track work hours, locations, and mileage in one place.
Download Timeero to simplify time tracking and get better visibility into your mobile workforce.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can significantly decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00069644:ios.description:
VeroSMS is a SMS Spam filter app focused on maintaining users privacy, it filters spam texts using keywords that you set and using crowdsourced data of keywords that other people in your region set.
This way none of the SMSs are sent to any server for analysis and your messages remain confidential.
# Free Features:
- Unlimited keywords for blacklisting.
- Unlimited keywords for whitelisting.
- Auto-block texts containing URLs from unknown people.
- Only blocks texts from people not in your contact list.
- SMS Spam Reporting to TRAI (India only).
# Premium Features:
- Machine learning based filtering.
- iCloud sync for any keywords you add.
- Auto-filtering of spam based on keywords that other people in your region add.
- Basically does all the work for you. Just unlock premium and forget, all crowdsourced keywords will be periodically updated in background.
For info on how to enable SMS Spam reporting extension open this in your browser: verosms.com/reportspam
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: https://verosms.com/privacy

bluejetty:00155427:ios.description:
The players may assume the role of Hong Kong, Tibet, Uyghurs (East Turkestan), Kazakhs, Mongolia, Manchuria, Taiwan or Cathaysian Rebel factions, establishing Organizations in 269 territories in the Cathayan Continent to overthrow the Communist regime!
Or you can choose to lead the Communists to defeat all enemies, and resume the century-long march of the Communist revolution to the other side of the land and sea!
A War Saga of Our Everyday World
400 years ago, dispensing fealties and brute force, House of Aisin Giro from Manchuria conquered the four realms of the Cathayan Continent within a century. Under Aisin Giro’s divide and conquer, the fates of the four realms - the grasslands of Tartaria, deserts of Turkestan, Snowfields of Tibet, and the fertile farmlands of China - were entwined together in the form of United Empires.
110 years ago, Aisin Giro stepped down from the throne after a military coup in the year of the white pig. Without the imperial overlord, the four realms went their separate ways.
After 40 years of intermittent warfare, the Communists conquer China proper under the "United Front" (collaborate with less antagonistic rivals to defeat major enemies) strategy. The Communists also tried their utmost to conquer as many of Aisin Giro’s vassals and annexed lands as possible, forging a new mega state: The People’s Republic.
The seeds of hatred bloomed into a reconquista of the east, from whence the Seventy Years’ War unfolded - a long-term hybrid war fought between those with the grim determination to uphold a ‘united’ republic and those who wish to revive their old independent states.
Around a decade ago, the Communists regressed to heavy-handed, reckless and inept governance, while also trying to expand their scope of influence. Malicious ethnic cleansing and an obstreperous military resulting in widespread corruption, embezzlement, exploitation, slaughter and defilement.
The Republic becomes a ghost of its former glory, but the world still awaits determined strategists who would go up against the Communists, while other major powers of the world remain undecided.
Taiwan, a remnant of Aisin Giro’s previous colonies, stands their ground in the face of Communists’ might. Fending off the persistent aggravation of the Communists, Taiwan stays vigilant from across the strait.
Could Taiwan stay safe by not provoking the Communists, keeping away from matters in the Cathayan Continent? Or should they refrain from repeating the same mistakes of the last thirty years which allowed the Communists to grow into the behemoth it is today?
Taiwan has yet to come to a conclusion, but the war is still at hand.
A Simulation for Rebels
There are 9 playable Factions (Hong Kong, Tibet, Uyghurs, Kazakhs, Mongolia, Manchuria, Taiwan, Cathaysian Rebels or the Communists) in the game for the players to choose from.
The player may choose a revolutionary faction; as its member, the player needs to pacify internal strife, negotiate for foreign support, establish resistance organizations, deplete the Communists’ resources through peaceful and forceful means, in order to hasten the "Great Flood" that will befall the Communists to uproot the reg.

bluejetty:00022080:ios.description:
Wisconsin Public Radio App: 
The Wisconsin Public Radio App allows you to listen to WPR’s Ideas Network, News and Classical Network, and 24 Classical Network live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the WPR streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to WPR with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from WPR even while traveling!
• Integrated program schedules for every WPR stream! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to WPR in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access WPR’s programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The Wisconsin Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
WPR News
• Catch up on all WPR news headlines in a single easy to read screen. Click to read the entire story or share with a friend.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Wisconsin Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at WPR and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support WPR by becoming a member today!
http://www.wpr.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00156755:ios.summary: The ultimate collection of word games to keep your brain active and your reflexes sharp. Enjoy Word Search, the newest addition, to improve your word finding skills. It features a larger board and a list of words to find by connecting adj
bluejetty:00156755:ios.description:
The ultimate collection of word games to keep your brain active and your reflexes sharp. Enjoy Word Search, the newest addition, to improve your word finding skills. It features a larger board and a list of words to find by connecting adjoining tiles in any direction. Go on an Adventure to use your word finding skills to achieve goals and pass levels. Be a Survivor to see how long you can last before the letters overflow the board. Measure your skills with Timed rounds versus your best scores or one of your friends.
What players are saying:
"Very addictive, works your brain."
"Help! I'm addicted to Word Falls! I can't stop playing!"
"Excellent Brain exercise"
"Great game. Fast, easy and fun"
Come join the fun!
Word Falls is a fast action word game that challenges your brain and your reflexes.
- Search the puzzle board for words.
- Spell words by dragging your finger to connect adjacent letters in any direction even diagonal.
- Keep the letter tiles from overflowing your board as they drop.
- Drag falling letter tiles to avoid tall stacks and to drop them in strategic locations.
- Activate special letter tiles by including them in the words you spell.
- Challenge your brain, your reflexes, and your spelling as you race against time searching for words and stacking falling letters.
- Challenge your friends to a game any time, anywhere.
Play a competitive game online to see how your scores stack up against the world. Challenge your Word Fall friends to a game via a user name search, play games with random opponents, or invite a Facebook friend. 
Brag about your results on Twitter or to your Facebook page.
Activate your brain as you quickly search the stationary letter tiles to spell words by connecting letters in any direction including diagonal. The same letter tile can only be used once per word, but you can change directions as you drag to connect any direct neighbors of the tile you are currently touching. 
Keep your reflexes sharp and your brain alert as the letters drop. Drag tiles as they drop to avoid tall letter stacks and to find a better position to spell words you have found in your search. When a letter drops on top of a stack that is at the top of the puzzle board, your game is over.
Challenge your brain, challenge your reflexes, challenge your friends.
Word Falls, where words fall into place...sometimes.

bluejetty:00042369:ios.description:
A cute pedometer by Caho, an illustrator who draws cute girls with gentle colors and a fluffy touch, is now available!
Caho's cute pedometer displays the distance walked, calories burned, and time walked based on health care data, and can be synced with all the historical data on your iPhone. Because you can also enter your weight by date, it is also a recommended application for dieting.
[Function]
Synchronize step count data from healthcare every month (all data in the device)
This app is linked to Health App/HealthKit and displays the data based on healthcare data.
Displays the distance walked, calories consumed, and time walked based on the number of steps taken (automatic calculation when data cannot be obtained).
More accurate calculation if you use AppleWatch.
The weight can be entered for each date.
You can easily check how much you have accomplished your goals.
Graphs to check changes in weight, number of steps, etc.
Step Ranking
Please use Caho's cute pedometer to help you stay on track with your diet.
-- Premium Features...
- Hide ads
Banner ads and full screen ads will be removed.
- No restrictions on wallpapers
All wallpapers are available.
-- Automatic Continuity Billing --
Restore when changing models
When you change your phone, you can restore the paid version you previously purchased for free. Please log in to iTunes on your iPhone/iPad device with the same AppleID as when you purchased the app (from the paid version).
Confirmation and cancellation
Select "Recommendations" at the bottom of the AppStore app -> Select your Apple ID -> Select "Show Apple ID" -> Select from "Manage" in your subscription. From this screen, you can check the timing of the next automatic update and cancel/set the automatic update.
Automatic continuation billing
The free trial is valid for the first time only. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period, you will be automatically charged after the 2-week free trial ends.
If you do not cancel the automatic renewal at least 24 hours prior to the end of the contract period, the contract period will be automatically renewed. Automatic renewal billing will be done within 24 hours prior to the end of the contract period.
Points to note
Those who have been billed within the app cannot cancel by any other method than the above.
Please note that we do not accept cancellations for the current month.
You will be charged via your iTunes account.
Terms of Use

bluejetty:00086680:ios.description:
Making your life easier with wireless connectivity. The MyCentsys Pro mobile app from Centurion Systems enables you to conveniently set up your or your client’s CENTURION SMART gate or garage motor using your phone. The app connects wirelessly to the operator, giving you quick and easy access to its bouquet of features and saving you time and effort. The intuitive interface is incredibly easy to use, with a user-friendly graphic front-end and built-in tutorials delivering the ultimate SMART experience.
Main features
• Configure all operator settings intuitively from your phone
• Step by step gate limit and configuration wizard
• Over-the-air firmware updates
• Detailed diagnostics and real-time display of system health (for example battery voltage and mains on/off)
• Backup and Restore NOVA transmitters using MyCentsys Cloud
• Manage NOVA transmitters from your phone (custom name, add, edit, delete, disable)
• Quick access to technical support
• Text-to-speech functionality
• Access to device event logs (for example last remote pressed, collisions detected)
• Seamless integration with SMARTGUARDair wireless access control keypad
• Multiple custom gate triggers (mode of operation, speed and autoclose)
• Adjustable safety parameters such as gate sensitivity to obstructions
• Powersaving Mode
• Easily back up and restore settings

bluejetty:00069111:ios.description:
舒尔特方格是全世界范围内最简单，最有效也是最科学的注意力训练方法。
练专注，也练眼力——一款可以自己调玩法的舒尔特方格。
舒尔特方格是经典的注意力训练方法：在打乱的方格中按顺序找到目标，眼睛扫视、大脑定位、手指点击，反复练习可以提升视觉广度、注意稳定性和反应速度。
六种玩法，不止数字
- 标准：2×2 到 8×8 共 7 种格子，从小到大依次点击，难度随格子数增加
- 古诗：把诗句拆进方格，边找边记
- 成语：在方格中按顺序找出成语，边玩边积累
- 单词：把单词和释义做成方格，练反应也记单词
- DIY：自己录入内容，课文、生字、公式都能拿来练
- 速算：10 以内加减、20 以内加减、100 以内加减、100 以内进退位、九九乘法、表内除法 6 个等级，限时四选一，记录每道题的平均用时
按自己的习惯练
- 方块背景：默认 / 白底 / 彩色
- 字号：小号 / 标准 / 大号 / 特大，支持粗体
- 选中状态：选中、消失或不选中，适配不同训练方式
- 10 种点击音效，可开关语音播报和震动反馈
看得见的进步
- 今日、7 天、30 天、近一年四种时间范围
- 训练局数、累计时长、平均正确率、累计字数与单词
- 连续打卡天数、按天趋势图和玩法分布图
- 完整历史记录，每一局的玩法、时长和成绩都能回看
其他
- 纯本地数据，不注册也能用
- 支持分享成绩
专注力不是天生的，是可以练出来的。从 3×3 的方格开始，每天几分钟，坚持一段时间就能感觉到变化

舒尔特全免费使用！升级 PRO版可移除广告，可按需选择！
舒尔特支持按月或按年订阅；也支持一次买断方式获取专业版权限。
订阅价格可能因地而异。订阅将通过您的 iTunes 账户进行扣款。
订阅会自动续订，除非您在当前订阅期结束至少 24 小时以前停止自动续订。当前订阅激活后不可取消。

bluejetty:00177431:ios.description:
Stay updated with The Hindu News app, the definitive source for breaking news and comprehensive coverage from India and the world. Whether it's political news, business updates, cricket and other sports coverage, latest technology updates, or current events, The Hindu delivers live, accurate and reliable news directly to your device.
Don’t fall for sensationalised or fake news shared online. Read and share accurate updates with friends and family through The Hindu News app. Download it today!
News Coverage
Breaking News
Get instant notifications on breaking news stories as they happen. No matter where you live, you can be the first to know about major events and developments from Indian shores and around the globe with express live blogs and articles.
Politics
Stay informed about the latest political news updates India, including elections, policy changes, government decisions, and political events.
Business and Economy
Understand the economic landscape with our detailed business news analysis. From market trends to financial reports, stay updated on the latest Market & Business News, India News, Stock Market, Finance, Sensex - BSE India, Nifty- NSE India, economy and corporate news. Learn about shares and make informed decisions before investing your money.
Current Events
Follow stories on social issues, policy changes, significant global events and daily current affairs for UPSC and other competitive exam preparations.
Technology
Stay ahead of the times with updates of India’s latest gadgets, innovations, and tech trends from around the globe. Read reviews, analyses, and news on innovations and cutting-edge technology.
Sports
Follow your favourite sports and teams with our extensive sports coverage. Get live scores, match reports, and expert analysis on cricket, football, tennis, and more.
International News
Get a global perspective with news from around the world. Keep yourself updated on the latest geopolitical events from Russia-Ukraine war, Israel-Palestine conflict.
Local News
Get latest city news and updates on local events, issues, and community news that matter to you, With hyperlocal news coverage coming from Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Kolkata and many other cities. 
Trending Topics
Stay updated on what's trending today. Discover the most talked-about stories, trending news and engage with current hot topics.
ABOUT THE PUBLISHER:
THG PUBLISHING PRIVATE LIMITED: Today, The Hindu Group has a slew of print and digital publications. Some of the top publications include:
The Hindu (English news daily)
The Hindu ePaper & Businessline ePaper
Businessline (Business daily)
Frontline (Fortnightly national magazine)
Sportstar (Sports magazine)
SUBSCRIPTIONS
• The Hindu premium access is now available as recurring subscriptions that renew after the durations of 1 month (₹299 / $4.99), and 1 year (₹2399/$49.99). The All Access Pass, which gives your premium access to not only The Hindu and its epaper but also BusinessLine, Frontline and Sportstar, is also available as recurring subscriptions charged every 1 month (₹399 / $7.99), and 1 year (₹2799 / $79.99).
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00014782:ios.description:
Your iPhone is a fully capable point of sale.
Accept any card or digital wallet instantly with Tap to Pay on iPhone, or send a payment request by text and collect before you're back at your desk.
Hold your phone near a customer's card, Apple Pay, or any contactless wallet. Payment confirmed.
Send a payment request via text message. Your customer follows a link, pays from their own device, and the transaction is recorded immediately. No app required on their end.
Running without a signal is not a problem. Offline mode stores transactions securely and processes them automatically when your connection is restored, without losing a sale.
For businesses with repeat customers: store a card on file and charge in seconds. No re-entry, no friction, no delay at the counter or in the field.
Beyond tap and text, SwipeSimple supports Bluetooth card readers, terminals, registers, invoice delivery by email or SMS, and shareable payment links – every method your customers use to pay, handled from one place.
Pre-load your full item catalog with modifiers, pricing, and tax rates. Checkout is fast, accurate, and consistent across every transaction. Adjustable tipping, item-level discounts, and digital receipts are built in.
Real-time reporting gives you an immediate view of sales performance, top items, and transaction history. Manage inventory levels, track employee sales, and configure staff permissions.
Trusted by 125,000+ merchants across the United States.
SwipeSimple is built to get your business running in minutes and keep it running from anywhere, at scale.
Download the app for a complimentary demo.
For a SwipeSimple account, visit home.swipesimple.com.

Makeup and clothing stylist Chloe decides to conquer Hollywood with her boyfriend, but events take an unpredictable turn when she finds out about her pregnancy
bluejetty:00023325:ios.description:
Choose clothes, hairstyles, makeup and more in an exciting match-3 puzzle game!
Makeup and clothing stylist Chloe decides to conquer Hollywood with her boyfriend, but events take an unpredictable turn when she finds out about her pregnancy! Find out how her boyfriend reacted to the pregnancy and go through this journey together with Chloe! 
Apply your makeup and styling skills to the people she will meet on her way. Ready for a makeover challenge? Play Family Town and get down to business!
Take part in the life of a beautiful quiet place and its inhabitants together with her! 
Decorate houses in a small town, improve the appearance of people, add a little beauty to the streets using unique game tools.
Do you want to contribute to the life of this small town? Try a dream makeover!
HOUSE DECORATION AND RENOVATION
Moving forward Chloe applies her magical makeover skills to surrounding homes. The streets are filled with joy and style as she goes on. 
HAIR MAKEOVER
Chloe proves to be style savvy and can fix one’s hair effortlessly! Choose a new haircut or color and go ahead. 
MAKEUP DESIGN
Want to test your makeup artist skills? A small American town is full of ladies looking for a little beauty upgrade.
HOME FASHION & DRESSER
Teach locals how to dress up for events and makeover their style. Happy customers will come back again and again. They covet fashion every day now!
Take part in this exciting fashion makeover integrated into a fun match-3 puzzle game! 
It’s a full makeover that includes makeup, hair, clothes, houses and more. You are the one who decides what fits best. Family Town is a cozy fashion designer game with levels that won’t make you feel bored. Try different styles and decorate the whole town according to your taste!

bluejetty:00136049:ios.description:
Discover Lotus Flow, the all-in-one wellness app designed to make healthy living feel simple, natural, and enjoyable.
Whether you’re new to yoga, getting back into fitness, or already experienced, Lotus Flow adapts to your level and goals. With guided workouts, structured programs, and easy-to-follow classes, you can build a routine that fits your lifestyle.
Practice with expert instructors who bring together yoga, pilates, tai chi, mindfulness, stretching, mobility, and home workouts in one app. Improve flexibility, balance, strength, posture, and overall wellness with classes designed for everyday life.
[ YOGA CLASSES FOR ALL LEVELS ]
Explore guided yoga classes for beginners, intermediate users, and advanced practitioners. Find sessions based on your goals, focus area, or available time. From morning stretches to calming evening flows, there’s always a class that fits your day.
[ SPECIAL PROGRAMS & SKILLS ]
Build new skills safely with structured programs and progressive classes. Practice handstands, improve flexibility and splits, try wall pilates, or explore chair yoga, tai chi, and face yoga.
[ FITNESS & WORKOUT CLASSES ]
Lotus Flow is more than a yoga app. Enjoy workouts focused on core strength, arms, lower body, cardio, HIIT, posture, and fat burning. Whether you prefer quick home workouts or longer guided sessions, every class helps you feel stronger and more active.
[ TAI CHI & GENTLE MOVEMENT ]
Discover calming tai chi sessions designed to improve balance, coordination, mobility, and relaxation. Gentle flowing movements support stress relief and body awareness for all experience levels.
[ MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS ]
Support both body and mind with guided mindfulness practices, breathing exercises, stress relief sessions, and meditations for sleep, focus, and relaxation.
[ PLANS THAT GROW WITH YOU ]
Follow structured yoga, pilates, stretching, tai chi, and fitness plans designed to evolve with your progress.
[ CUSTOM CLASSES & POSE LIBRARY ]
Create your own home wellness routine with more than 450 yoga poses, including tutorials, benefits, and guidance for every level.
[ MAIN FEATURES ]
• Personalized onboarding and smart plan recommendations
• 450+ yoga poses with detailed guidance
• Hundreds of yoga, pilates, tai chi, stretching, and workout classes
• Progress tracking, streaks, and reminders
• Offline downloads for workouts anywhere
• Chair yoga, face yoga, wall pilates, and tai chi routines
• Flexibility, mindfulness, mobility, and balance sessions
• Beginner-friendly experience with guided instruction
[ OTHER FEATURES ]
• Siri Shortcuts support
• Apple Health integration
• Multi-device support for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV
• Save favorites and build your own class library
• Weekly new content and workout programs
[ YOUR WELLNESS, YOUR WAY ]
Whether you want quick workouts, calming yoga flows, gentle tai chi sessions, or routines for seniors, Lotus Flow helps you move in a way that feels right for you.

bluejetty:00077457:ios.description:
Documa introduces a new era of document management, blending next-level capabilities with effortless usability. It’s perfect for students, lawyers, doctors, business professionals, and anyone who deals with forms or documents. Streamline the way you handle, edit, and share—whether it's homework, contracts, medical forms, or business proposals. It’s the future of document management right in your pocket!
SCANNING MADE SIMPLE
Documa does the hard work for you. Its advanced AI recognizes form elements in scanned documents, placing cursors or checkboxes exactly where needed. Whether it’s a downloaded PDF or a freshly scanned document, filling it out is now as easy as a tap.
E-SIGN ON THE GO
Add your signature to documents with ease. Save multiple signatures for future use or create a new one on the spot. Documa makes e-signing simple and swift!
TEXT EDITING AND FORMATTING
Add plain text to your documents, move it around, edit, change color, size, or alignment with intuitive controls. Documa gives you the freedom to modify text as you desire, ensuring your documents look just the way you want.
PDF EDITOR - FREE AND FLEXIBLE
Documa is your free PDF editor, allowing you to draw, highlight, add lines, circles, rectangles, or import images. The intuitive interface ensures that editing PDFs is a hassle-free experience.
SMART FORM CREATION
Creating custom PDF forms is a cinch with Documa. Start from scratch or edit existing documents, adding text fields, checkboxes, and more. The forms you create are compatible with popular PDF readers, making sharing and collaboration easy.
EXPORT OPTIONS GALORE
Choose how you want to share your documents—as PDFs, JPEGs, or text files. Documa compiles all your scans and creations into one PDF or a collection of JPEG or text files, all ready for sharing.
ADVANCED EDITING
- Apply filters, rotate, or crop documents using perspective cropping to get the perfect angle.
- Mark up documents, change colors, highlight, or add text and input boxes.
- Explore a multitude of tools to make your documents stand out.
SNAP TO PERFECTION
Utilize grid snapping and object snapping to align text, images, and other elements precisely. This feature is perfect for creating neat, professional-looking documents from scratch.
OCR—TURN PHOTOS INTO TEXT
The Optical Character Recognition (OCR) feature transforms photos into editable text. This is a perfect tool for converting photos of text into usable content. Try the picture scanner feature today!
DESIGN TOOLS
Documa comes loaded with intuitive design and markup tools:
- Draw, highlight, redact, or clean up documents to convey your ideas clearly.
- Change fonts and colors, add form elements, and make your document look polished and professional.
DOWNLOAD NOW
Don’t let paperwork slow you down. Download Documa now and revolutionize the way you handle documents. More than a pdf scanner app, it’s a comprehensive document management solution ready to make your life easier, whether you're filling out tomorrow’s homework or signing your next business contract.
Read our privacy policy at https://www.documa.net/privacy

apple-macos:6758833314.description:
Pentip is a notebook for people who take a lot of notes, and who write some of them by hand and type the rest.
FIND WHAT YOU WROTE BY HAND
Search your notes and Pentip reads your handwriting, along with typed text, text frames, imported PDFs and the answers in PDF forms. Search the whole library, or jump from match to match in the document you have open. Handwriting is recognised in all ten languages Pentip speaks, Arabic and Turkish included. Searching costs nothing extra.
TYPE AND HANDWRITE ON THE SAME PAGE
Type straight onto the page and your text flows from one page to the next, the way it does in a word processor. Then pick up your Apple Pencil and draw on that same page. No mode to switch. The Pencil draws, the keyboard types where the cursor is, and your finger scrolls. Typed text can hold tables, charts, maths graphs and lists inside lists, and any words can link to a website, another note or a single page.
YOUR DRAWINGS MOVE WITH YOUR TEXT
Every pen stroke remembers the line of text it was drawn beside. Add a paragraph weeks later and the arrow you drew still points at the same sentence, even once that sentence has moved onto the next page.
TOOLS THAT FEEL RIGHT
Pen, brush, highlighter and a precise eraser, all with Apple Pencil pressure and tilt. Draw a shape, hold still at the end, and Shape Snap turns it into one of more than 30 clean shapes, from arrows to stars. The ruler doubles as a protractor, and squeezing an Apple Pencil Pro opens colours and sizes at the tip.
STICKERS AND COVERS
More than 500 stickers, 3D ones included, in any colour or a holographic foil, plus labels you write on and stickers made from your own photos. Notebooks get covers too: one of 53 designs, a photo of your own or a plain material like linen or leather.
FLASHCARDS AND WHITEBOARDS
Write flashcards by hand or type them, then study in order or shuffled, and the cards you find hard come back sooner. A whiteboard grows as you draw, and its mini map takes you anywhere on it.
WORK ON YOUR HANDOUTS
Import a lecture PDF and mark it up like paper, or scan pages straight in with the camera. Tap a form field and type into it, right to left included. When your lecturer sends a corrected version, swap it in and every note stays where it was.
READ IN THE DARK WITHOUT CHANGING YOUR WORK
Smart Dark draws a light document dark while you read and write it. Your exports stay exactly as you made them.
BIG DOCUMENTS, TEN LANGUAGES
Notebooks of any length, paper templates, five layers and sections that keep several canvases in one file. Pentip speaks Arabic, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish and Turkish, and sets text direction for each paragraph, so an Arabic note sits correctly next to an English source.
Export to PDF or as an image, and sync across your devices with iCloud. Pentip runs on iPhone and Mac too. Pentip Pro adds unlimited documents, iCloud sync, export, Shape Snap, stickers and the designed and photo covers.
